jobs.title: Founding Engineer
jobs.description:
About 3Y Health

3Y Health is building the operating system for healthcare practices, an AI-native platform that helps clinicians start, run and grow their practice. We work as a managed services organization (MSO): along with the software, our operations team runs the back office for the clinics we partner with, including billing, insurance and compliance. We currently serve applied behavior analysis (ABA) therapy practices and are expanding into speech, occupational and physical therapy, and psychiatry.

About the role

Members of Technical Staff own features end to end. You'll work with the clinicians and operators who use what we build, scope the problem, design and build the solution across the stack, deploy it and follow how it performs in production. Our engineering team is flat, with no sub-teams, so you'll work across the whole platform. We build with AI coding agents every day and expect you to do the same.

What you'll do

  • Design and build AI agents and automated workflows for clinic operations, such as insurance benefits verification, prior authorizations, patient intake, claims and clinical documentation

  • Build features for clinicians, patients and families, and our internal operations team, on web and mobile

  • Take ambiguous problems from 0 to 1, working with operators and clinicians to define the problem, write the spec and ship a first version

  • Design the services, data models and APIs behind your features and manage the infrastructure as code

  • Own your services in production: deployments, monitoring and incident response

  • Write evals for model-facing features and track the metrics of the workflows you ship

  • Work with protected health information (PHI) safely, with least-privilege access, no PHI in logs and auditable changes

  • Build and maintain the skills, plugins, MCP integrations and review bots our engineers use with Claude Code and Codex

Our stack

  • Backend: Python (our primary language for new services), Kotlin with Hasura (GraphQL) on our established platform, plus TypeScript (NestJS) and some Go

  • Frontend and mobile: React, Next.js, React Native

  • Data: PostgreSQL (including pgvector), Snowflake

  • Workflows and contracts: Temporal, gRPC/Protobuf

  • Infrastructure: AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS), Terraform, GitHub Actions, Datadog, LaunchDarkly

  • AI: Claude and OpenAI models, Claude Code and Codex, with our own skills, plugins, MCP integrations and an AI code-review bot

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of experience building and shipping production software

  • Recent, hands-on experience using or building AI harnesses: the layer around a model or coding agent (project instructions, tools and MCP servers, skills, hooks, subagents, evals), not only calls to a model API. You can show what you set up or built.

  • At least one personal project you built and published on the web, live and usable by anyone, ideally a SaaS with payments working (e.g. Stripe). Share the link when you apply.

What we're looking for

  • A track record of owning products or features end to end, from an unclear problem to a system people depend on

  • Strong full-stack skills in Python and TypeScript, with experience across frontend, backend, databases and cloud infrastructure

  • Comfort working in a large, established codebase

  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs, including tool use, agent orchestration, structured outputs, retrieval and evals (LangGraph, an agents SDK or similar)

  • Daily use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. You know how to set them up for a codebase (project instructions, skills, MCP servers, hooks, subagents), run several tasks in parallel and review their output carefully. If you haven't heard of Claude Code, this role is likely not a fit.

  • Good product sense and the ability to make solid UI decisions without a dedicated designer, using our component library

  • High agency: you unblock yourself, look for context and ask questions when you need to

  • Clear written communication. The team is distributed across time zones and most decisions happen in specs, PRs and tickets.

Nice to have

  • Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry (HIPAA, payer and claims workflows, EHR integrations, HL7/FHIR)

  • Temporal or another durable workflow engine

  • React Native

  • Running LLM evaluations or safety checks on model output in production

  • Having built your own agent harness, MCP server or plugin for a coding agent

  • Open-source work or internal tools that other people use

If you meet all the must-haves and most of the rest, we'd like to hear from you, even if you don't check every other box.

Location and employment

This is a full-time employee role, remote and based in Toronto, Ontario. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

We use AI tools to help screen and assess applications for this role.

jobs.title: Manager, DC Commercial Diligence
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the worldâs largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.

Vultr Cares

  • 100% company-paid insurance premiums for employee medical, dental and vision plans.

  • 401(k) plan that matches 100% up to 4%, with immediate vesting

  • Professional Development Reimbursement of $2,500 each year

  • 11 Holidays + Paid Time Off Accrual + Rollover Plan

  • Commitment matters to Vultr! Increased PTO at 3 year and 10 year anniversary + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year

  • $500 stipend for remote office setup in first year + $400 each following year

  • Internet reimbursement up to $75 per month

  • Gym membership reimbursement up to $50 per month

  • Company paid Wellable subscription

Join Vultr

Vultr is seeking a Manager of DC Commercial Diligence to support commercial due diligence across our data center acquisition pipeline. This is a hands-on underwriting role: for every site Vultr pursues, whether an operator colocation lease, a powered shell, a lease-to-own structure, or a powered land purchase, you will work the data room directly, build out findings, and bring a well-supported point of view to the Senior Manager on whether the deal is what it claims to be. You will build fluency across power availability and energy commercial terms, counterparty and lease economics, and the deal model, and your work will directly inform the Go/No-Go recommendations and negotiating positions the Senior Manager brings to investment gates on transactions worth tens to hundreds of millions of dollars. Your job is to be constructively adversarial to every deal: the diligence function exists to find what the seller's materials do not say.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support commercial due diligence end to end for active acquisitions: review documents in the data room, maintain the findings register, and prepare evidence-based materials for investment gates alongside the Senior Manager

  • Diligence power under guidance: interconnection queue position versus contracted capacity, utility and ESA terms, tariff structure, curtailment provisions, demand charge pass-throughs, and power-on forecast credibility, flagging where bankable capacity and marketing figures diverge

  • Diligence counterparties: operator financial health and credit, guarantor structure, lease terms including minimum power obligations, escalations, expansion rights, termination provisions, and service level commitments

  • Build and maintain components of the deal model: total development cost, fit-out and NRC comparisons, yield, tax and incentive assumptions, and sensitivity to power cost and ramp scenarios, under the Senior Manager's review

  • Verify seller claims against primary sources: utility confirmations, interconnection studies, executed versus draft agreements, title and site control instruments

  • Draft Go/No-Go packages, risk registers, and challenge questions for operators; run day-to-day RFI cycles through resolution

  • Support the Senior Manager, Director, and Acquisitions Managers with diligence-derived data and analysis; do not carry deal negotiation

  • Escalate findings transparently through the Senior Manager, including adverse findings that may be unwelcome to the deal team

  • Coordinate with external counsel and consultants on legal, environmental, and specialty workstreams under the Senior Manager's direction

  • Help pre-qualify pipeline sites toward proposal-ready status so sales never offers an unvetted site

  • Apply and help refine repeatable diligence frameworks, checklists, and data room standards across deal types

  • Track diligence performance metrics: cycle time per deal, findings volume and severity, and post-close issue rate

Qualifications

  • 3-6 years in data center, energy, or infrastructure transactions with hands-on exposure to due diligence: you have worked in data rooms and contributed to investment views, even if final sign-off sat with others

  • Working familiarity with power markets: interconnection processes and queue mechanics, utility tariffs, energy services agreements, and power purchase agreement structures as applied to data centers

  • Solid understanding of data center lease structures, operator economics, and mission-critical delivery commitments

  • Strong financial modeling ability in Excel: comfortable building and maintaining components of a development cost, returns, and scenario model

  • Demonstrated attention to detail in finding discrepancies in deal materials: capacity claims that did not hold, unexecuted agreements presented as commitments, terms with hidden exposure

  • Able to synthesize a large document set into clear, evidence-cited findings for review by senior stakeholders

  • Comfortable managing multiple concurrent diligences in a fast-moving deal environment, with guidance from the Senior Manager

  • Bachelor's degree required; coursework or certification in finance, engineering, or energy valued

Preferred Experience

  • Infrastructure private equity, investment banking, or project finance deal teams; hyperscaler energy or site acquisition; IPP or utility origination; data center operator corporate development

  • Exposure to behind-the-meter generation and natural gas supply arrangements (firm transport, MDCQ, balancing)

  • Familiarity with the GPU/AI infrastructure ecosystem and hyperscale construction processes

Compensation

$110,000-$135,000

Final compensation will vary depending on years of experience, background/skill set, location, and applicable laws.

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (United States)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer to join the Customer Solutions team. You will be the technical authority embedded with our most complex customers, guiding them through deployment, architecture, onboarding, and the adoption of agentic development workflows. You bring deep hands-on experience from prior roles and use that depth to advise, design repeatable patterns, and drive customer outcomes end to end. You operate autonomously, own the technical success of your customers, and bring their experience back to shape how Coder builds and delivers.

This is not an execution-only role. You are equally comfortable doing deep technical work with a customer and stepping back to design the repeatable pattern behind it. You are energized by ambiguity, motivated by customer outcomes, and capable of influencing organizational change alongside the technical work.

Â 

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the primary technical authority for post-sales customers, guiding deployment architecture, environment design, and adoption of Coder across both human and AI development workflows

  • Own onboarding engagements end to end, ensuring customers move from contract to productive adoption with speed and confidence

  • Lead Get Well engagements where architecture decisions, rollout patterns, or organizational dynamics are limiting customer health or growth

  • Help customers implement the technical and organizational changes required to adopt agentic development practices at scale

  • Design and document repeatable delivery patterns across onboarding, architecture, and adoption that can scale across customer segments

  • Design and recommend reference architectures tailored to each customer's cloud environment, security posture, and organizational constraints

  • Translate customer environment complexity into clear guidance on networking, ingress, identity, and infrastructure patterns

  • Anticipate technical and operational risks, escalate to the right internal stakeholders, and track issues through to resolution

  • Contribute to technical documentation, architecture guides, how-to resources, and statements of work that extend your impact across the customer base

  • Capture structured product feedback from customer deployments and advocate directly with engineering and product teams for roadmap and usability improvements

Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5 or more years of experience in a Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Architect, Platform Engineering, or equivalent post-sales technical role, with a demonstrated track record of guiding enterprise customers through complex technical deployments

  • Proven hands-on experience from a prior role designing and deploying cloud infrastructure on at least one major provider: AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure; you have done the work and can speak to it with specificity

  • 2+ years experience deploying or operating AI coding agents in a production or near-production environment: you understand how agent loops execute, where credentials live, and what governance and audit requirements look like in an enterprise context

  • Ability to articulate the architectural difference between workspace-local agent tooling and a centralized agentic harness, and to explain why that distinction matters to a security or compliance stakeholder

  • 2 or more years of production experience with Kubernetes: cluster design, workload scheduling, networking, storage, and operational lifecycle

  • 2 or more years of experience with Terraform or equivalent infrastructure-as-code tooling; you understand how enterprise teamsâ structure, version, and maintain IaC at scale

  • Solid understanding of Linux systems administration, including networking fundamentals: ingress controllers, proxies, load balancers, and DNS resolution in cloud-native environments

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipeline design and DevOps practices; you understand how code moves from commit to running workload in an enterprise context

  • Working knowledge of cloud security and identity: IAM patterns, network segmentation, secrets management, and compliance-relevant controls

  • Understanding of observability practices including logging, metrics, and tracing across distributed systems

  • Demonstrated ability to design repeatable delivery patterns, not just solve one-off problems

  • Comfort working through organizational and workflow change alongside technical change with customers

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills: you can hold a room with a senior infrastructure team and produce a clear architecture document without those being separate skills

  • High customer empathy: you understand that the best technical solution does not always fit a customer's constraints, timeline, or organizational reality

  • Self-directed, analytically minded, and comfortable operating with full autonomy in a startup environment

Â 

Bonus tacos if you have

  • (Tacos? If you need an ice-breaker, ask how we say thanks by giving tacos!)

  • Experience at both early-stage startups and larger software organizations

  • Background as a Software Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or Platform Engineer before moving into a customer-facing role

  • Familiarity with regulated environments: air-gapped deployments, network isolation, SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, or DORA requirements

  • Experience with disaster recovery design and multi-region availability patterns

  • Cloud cost optimization experience, including rightsizing, reserved capacity, and FinOps practices

  • Experience with Tailscale or similar overlay networking tools

  • Kubernetes certification (CKA, CKAD, or CKS)

  • Open-source contributions

  • Experience with Backstage.io or similar internal developer portals and platform tooling

  • Prior work on or alongside a developer platform or platform engineering team

  • Experience introducing new operating models or delivery patterns across post-sales or go-to-market teams

  • Experience with LLM gateway or proxy infrastructure (LiteLLM, OpenRouter, or equivalent) in a multi-team or enterprise context

  • Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, session audit requirements, or SIEM integration for AI workloads

  • Experience designing human-in-the-loop breakpoints or escalation patterns for autonomous agent workflows

About Us

At The Global Talent Co., we provide opportunities to work with leading innovative technology companies worldwide, offering stable employment, competitive compensation, career growth, and access to a community of 25,000+ like-minded marketing professionals.

About the Company

You will be joining a lean, AI-first digital publisher that runs research-led review and comparison websites in the trading space. The teamâs edge is verified, evidence-based research that helps traders make better decisions, built on a strict editorial standard where ratings canât be bought and every claim is checked. The next step is turning that research into an audience, and this hire is the person who builds it.

The Role

As Social Media & Community Manager, you will build the audience for a fast-growing publishing project in prop trading. Traders ask their hardest questions on X, Reddit and YouTube: which firm pays out, what a challenge really costs and which rule will end an account. Youâll own the channels end to end, turning verified research into posts, threads, graphics and video that traders actually want to watch and share, and growing a community around it. X is the priority for brand exposure and Reddit is where the community is built, with YouTube, Instagram and Facebook alongside.

Youâll work closely with the Senior Project Manager, who agrees priorities with you and oversees the editorial standard across the project. Within those goals, how you get there is your call: you pick the formats, the hooks and the tools, and youâre judged on results. jobs.title: VP of Brand and Communications
jobs.description:
About Oscilar

Oscilar is building the Agentic Risk Platformâ¢ for banks and fintechs, reimagining how financial institutions manage fraud, credit risk, compliance and onboarding in the AI era.

Our platform brings decisioning, data and AI agents together in one system, so risk teams can make better decisions in real time and automate increasingly complex work. Agent Hub gives them 30+ specialized AI agents across fraud, AML, credit, onboarding, sanctions and disputes.

Oscilar is trusted by 100+ fintechs and financial institutions, including SoFi, MoneyGram and Nuvei, and makes tens of billions of risk decisions a year. ARR has grown 15x in the last 2 years.

Oscilar was founded by Neha Narkhede, co-creator of Apache Kafka and co-founder of Confluent, which went public at a valuation of about $10 billion and later agreed to be acquired by IBM for $11 billion.

The Role

We're hiring our first VP of Brand and Communications to lead Brand, PR and Communications and make Oscilar the defining name in agentic risk.

You'll own how Oscilar shows up in the market: the story we tell, the voice we tell it in, and where it gets heard. That means directing our PR to land Oscilar in Tier 1 publications and keep a steady drumbeat of coverage around every launch and milestone; defining a brand voice and guidelines that make us instantly recognizable as the agentic risk platform; launching brand campaigns that get financial services leaders talking; and turning our founder's industry profile into reach with the buyers we sell to.

This is a player-coach role. You'll set the strategy for brand, PR and comms, and personally get the first versions of the most important work out the door. You'll lead our PR and comms lead, our creative lead and our PR agencies from day one, hire your first team member soon after joining, and build the team as results come in. You'll also build the playbook for an AI-native brand function, using agents and automation so a small team can do far more than its size suggests.

You'll report to Tomas Lobo, VP of Marketing and Growth, and work closely with our CEO and executive team, Product Marketing, Growth, Events and Design. This is a high-ownership role with direct impact on Oscilar's growth and reputation.

What You'll Own

Brand Strategy & Category Leadership

  • Own Oscilar's brand strategy end to end, and make Oscilar the defining name in agentic risk.

  • Work with our founders to sharpen the agentic risk narrative, and turn it into a point of view the market repeats back to us.

  • Turn executive alignment into a cohesive brand voice and brand guidelines, and make sure the brand shows up consistently across the website, sales, content, social and events.

  • Evolve the brand as the company grows: new products, new markets and new audiences.

  • Own the brand budget and investment plan, and decide where each dollar builds the most awareness and trust.

  • Make sure Oscilar shows up in AI search and LLM answers, not just traditional search and media.

PR & Communications

  • Set the bar for what great PR looks like, and direct our agencies (including Highwire) to get there.

  • Land Oscilar's story in Tier 1 publications such as Fortune and the Wall Street Journal.

  • Build a steady drumbeat of earned media around product launches, customer stories, company milestones and timely news.

  • Build lasting relationships with the media, analysts and industry voices that shape our market.

  • Run PR as the long game it is, while making sure Oscilar shows up in today's conversations.

  • Own crisis communications readiness and the corporate narrative around major company moments.

  • Partner with People on our employer brand, so the story we tell the market also attracts great talent.

Social Strategy

  • Own Oscilar's social strategy across founder-led, executive-led, employee-led and company channels.

  • Make each channel amplify the others, so a single story travels from Neha to our executives, our employees and the company page.

  • Build an employee advocacy program that turns our team into a distribution channel.

  • Measure social by reach and engagement with the buyers we sell to, not vanity metrics.

Founder & Executive Presence

  • Manage Neha's presence across social media, video, media, podcasts and events, building on her 50K followers and her standing in the industry.

  • Own her roadmap of speaking, media and social moments, so she shows up in the right places at the right time.

  • Build the platforms that make Neha and our executives and experts the voices people seek out on AI, fraud, credit and compliance.

Content & Thought Leadership

  • Set the long-term content strategy that builds Oscilar's authority in AI and risk: original research, data assets, signature franchises and executive points of view.

  • Bring Product Marketing, PR and content together around one shared plan, so every launch and campaign tells part of the same story.

  • Build content that compounds over time and becomes the reference point for our industry.

Brand Campaigns & Programs

  • Launch fast, high-ROI brand campaigns alongside long-term programs. Our first is the Agents of Risk awards program.

  • Run several bets in parallel, set clear goals for each, measure results, and decide quickly what to scale or stop.

  • Turn what works into flagship programs, partnerships and experiences that become recognized across financial services.

Team & AI-Native Operations

  • Lead and grow our PR and comms lead, our creative lead and our agency partners from day one.

  • Build the Brand, PR and Communications team over time, adding your first hire soon after joining and growing the function as results come in.

  • Build an AI-native function: automate brand, PR and social workstreams with agents so a small team can do far more.

  • Define the function's priorities, operating rhythm and how we measure brand impact.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: You've set the brand and PR strategy, are directing our agencies with a clear point of view, and have early wins on the board: earned media around our launches, a brand voice the company has adopted, and the first brand campaigns live and measured.

  • First year: Oscilar is recognized as the defining name in agentic risk. We have Tier 1 coverage and a steady drumbeat of earned media, a social presence that reaches the buyers we sell to across founder, executive, employee and company channels, and flagship programs the industry looks forward to.

  • Long term: You've built a high-performing, AI-native Brand, PR and Communications team, and brand has become one of Oscilar's biggest competitive advantages.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in brand, PR and communications, including leading brand and PR or comms at VP or Head-of level at a successful, sales-led B2B SaaS company.

  • Deep PR judgment. You've directed agencies to Tier 1 coverage and know what great looks like.

  • You've built a brand voice and guidelines that teams actually used, and you can take a messy draft and make it sharp.

  • You've run fast, measurable brand campaigns alongside long-term programs.

  • You're a hands-on player-coach: proactive, responsive, and quick to ship rather than theorize.

  • You're AI-native and have automated real marketing work with AI tools or agents.

  • You've managed experienced people and agencies, and aligned teams such as PMM and content on one plan.

  • You've owned a brand budget and managed creative teams and agencies across PR, design and video.

  • Clear, concise communication and strong creative instincts.

Bonus Experience

  • Selling to fintech, financial services, payments, identity, security or other risk and trust buyers.

  • Running a founder-led social program, especially for a technical founder.

  • Launching an awards program or other industry-recognition campaign.

  • Building a brand or comms function from scratch, or leading through a major moment such as an IPO or large announcement.

Why This Role Is Unique

  • Build from scratch, without the typical startup risk. You'll build Oscilar's brand function from the ground up at a company that already has product-market fit and has grown ARR 15x in 2 years.

  • A proven, second-time founder. Work directly with Neha Narkhede, who co-created Apache Kafka and co-founded Confluent, taking it to a roughly $10 billion IPO and an $11 billion acquisition agreement with IBM.

  • A manager who has done this before. Tomas Lobo helped build Samsara from $1M to close to $500M in ARR in about 5 years.

  • A category to name. Help define agentic risk, a new category at the intersection of AI, risk and financial infrastructure.

  • Room to build. A VP title, a seat with the founders, a PR partner already in place, and room to hire and build your team.

Benefits

  • Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages, including a 401k plan.

  • Flexibility: Remote-first culture.

  • Health: 100% employer-covered comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance with a top-tier plan for you and your dependents. (US)

  • Balance: Unlimited PTO policy.

  • Culture: Family-friendly environment; regular team events and offsites.

  • Development: Unparalleled learning and professional development opportunities.

  • Impact: Help make the internet safer by protecting online transactions and building the infrastructure powering the future of financial risk.

Help launch a new program and identify the next ones with Product and Partnerships.

Advise Product and Partnerships on program design, opportunity sizing and utility proposals. You will not draft formal regulatory filings.

Guide and review the work of co-op and junior analysts. This role has no direct reports.

Within 60 days, you know the established program well enough to run it without the team's involvement.

Registrations, nominations, tests, events and quarterly settlements are on time and accurate, and your manager reviews rather than does.

New program registrations are submitted on time with no missed deadlines, and enrolled MW is at or near target.

Baseline and performance methodology is agreed with Engineering and Product before the first dispatch.

Required

3 to 5 years of hands-on energy markets experience in demand response or a closely related area (registrations, performance calculations, settlements), in any ISO or utility program.

Advanced Excel or Google Sheets: trackers, baseline-versus-metered-load calculations, and settlement reconciliations that others can audit.

Basic SQL: read-only queries with joins, aggregations and filters to pull site, interval and dispatch data.

Basic Python, with familiarity with Pandas, to process interval data across many sites and automate repetitive registration and settlement prep.

Clear written communication, including plain-language explanations of program rules and professional correspondence with utilities and ISOs.

Ownership: you make judgment calls on ambiguous program rules, know when to escalate, and build process where none exists.

Availability during core Eastern hours and during test and event windows. PJM, the utilities and all program deadlines run on Eastern time.

jobs.description:

The ideal candidate has built and operated high-scale consumer iOS applications end to end, has been the engineer other iOS engineers come to for architecture and tooling, and is excited about modernizing a mature Swift codebase while keeping it shipping every week. Rather than owning one feature surface, you will partner with the product client teams, server engineering, and design to raise the engineering bar across the whole app.

Responsibilities

Own the architecture of Raya's iOS codebase: set the patterns and best practices for state management, SwiftUI adoption, navigation, networking, and concurrency, and solve the hard client-side lifecycle problems that span teams.

Drive modernization of a large, long-lived Swift codebase: modularization, SwiftUI alongside UIKit, Swift concurrency, and deliberate management of tech debt. Write the tech specs, make the trade-offs explicit, and sequence the work so it ships incrementally.

Build the shared foundation other iOS engineers build on: design-system components, shared libraries, networking and persistence layers, and the dev harness (build times, CI, test infrastructure, release tooling).

Build and roll out the AI-collaborative development tooling iOS engineers use every day, and set the standards for how we use it on the client.

Improve client production health infrastructure: crash and performance monitoring, alerting, release quality, and the security posture of the app.

Partner with server engineering on API design and client-server state sync, and with the product client teams so new features land on solid patterns.

Raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code review, mentorship, and clear written specs.

Requirements

5+ years of professional iOS development experience, with strong proficiency in Swift, UIKit, and MVVM.

Strong experience with RxSwift or similar reactive programming frameworks, and with Redux-style state management patterns.

A track record of shipping consumer mobile apps to large audiences, with strong judgment on architecture, performance, and user experience.

Experience owning client platform or infrastructure work that other engineers depend on (modularizing a large iOS codebase, build and CI systems, shared libraries, design systems, or release tooling) and driving its adoption.

Proven ability to lead projects from concept through launch, balance speed and quality, and own what you ship after it ships.

You use AI coding tools in your daily work, help the team adopt them, and look for opportunities to improve the engineering harness.

What Sets You Apart

Deep experience with SwiftUI alongside UIKit and with Swift concurrency (async/await, actors, strict concurrency), including migrating a mature codebase to them. CoreData a plus!

Experience with Xcode build performance, Swift Package Manager or Bazel/Tuist, and CI/CD for iOS at scale.

Has built developer tooling, agents, or evals that other engineers adopted: code review agents, lint and architecture rules, test generation, or LLM-powered dev harnesses.

Occasional comfort or interest in shipping production backend code (Node.js/TypeScript) alongside the client, and designing the APIs mobile clients depend on.

Experience with mobile security: device trust, certificate pinning, secrets handling, or security remediation on the client.

Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 100,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

The Opportunity

We build the platform that helps high-performing real estate agents stand out in their market. Our own brand has to be the best example of an agent's aspiration for brand design. As we enter our next stage of growth, we're looking for a Creative Director to lead our in-house brand design team and set the creative standard for everything our customers and the market see from us.

You'll lead the design team and decide what great looks like on every surface. You'll have the authority to say a piece isn't ready, and the judgment to explain why in terms a designer can act on. You'll report to the SVP of Partnerships, Brand, and Community, and you'll work with our CEO on the work that carries the brand.

You'll do well here if you can spot the gap between good and great, close it with clear feedback, and still ship on the committed date. You use AI to get more out of a small team, and you hold every asset to the same standard whether an employee, a freelancer, or an agency made it.

What You'll Own

The creative standard

  • Write and publish a quality standard with real examples for each surface, including web, email, video, social, and events, within your first 90 days.
  • Review work and give specific feedback that raises it in a single round of revisions.
  • By day 90, the CEO and SVP, Brand review your team's output and agree that 90% of randomly selected pieces meet the bar.

A brand system that morphs

  • Own a brand system that flexes to the standards of each channel and context, so what good looks like differs by surface while the brand remains unmistakably one brand.
  • Bring every surface up to the new standard by month 6, from website and product imagery to newsletters, YouTube, and our offices.

The team

  • Lead, coach, and grow a small design team of fewer than five direct reports.
  • Decide where in-house talent, freelancers, and outside firms each fit, and hold all of them to the same bar.

Predictable, well-run delivery

  • Run design intake and delivery so requesters always know what is coming and when. By month 6, at least 90% of requests ship by the committed date.
  • Get at least 85% of assets approved within one round of revisions, and end day-before creative notes on delivered work.
  • Keep the team aligned to business priorities, and flag requests that are not aligned early and often.

How You'll Work

You'll work closely with Brand, Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, and Product. You'll take feedback from senior leadership and partner teams, and you'll give it back just as directly. Politics have no place here, and the best work wins the argument.

What We're Looking For

Experience

  • 8+ years in design, with experience leading design teams.
  • A portfolio of luxury or premium brand work that spans web, brand, and motion.

Leadership and mindset

  • Exacting taste and the judgment to tell great work from good work.
  • The ability to define a quality bar, explain it, and coach others to it.
  • Full ownership of the output of the entire design function, including vendors and freelancers.
  • Comfort influencing senior stakeholders, including the CEO.

Technical foundation

  • Command of brand systems across web, email, video, social, and events.
  • Strong process and operational habits for intake, prioritization, and review.

Location

This is a remote role open to candidates in the United States, with a preference for New York, Los Angeles, or Austin.

Join us in shaping the future of real estate
Â 
The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.
Â 
We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.
Â 
Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.
Â 
More than 20,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.
Â 
Luxury Presence has earned a spot on BuiltInâs Best Places to Work list every year since 2020. Our founder and CEO was named a 2024 HousingWire Tech Trendsetter, and weâve won multiple Tech100 Awards. Inman has also honored us twice: with the 2025 Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform and the 2026 title of Best Proptech Company.
Â

jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Employment type: Full-time
Experience: 4+ years
Reports to: Chris Stella, VP Growth

About Lifeforce

We are in the early stages of a generational shift in how people approach their health. No longer satisfied with the reactive, fragmented care offered by the traditional healthcare system, millions of people are taking a more proactive approach. They want to understand how their bodies work, take control of how they feel and perform, and invest in living longer, healthier lives. Lifeforce is leading this shift as the world's largest longevity medicine program.

Founded alongside clinical and scientific leaders from Cleveland Clinic, Massachusetts General Hospital, and Harvard Medical School, Lifeforce brings together the diagnostics, expertise, and treatments people need to understand and optimize their health, both today and for decades to come. Our comprehensive program combines advanced diagnostics, expert clinicians, dedicated health coaches, and personalized supplement, pharmaceutical, and lifestyle protocols. All delivered from home, at the price of a gym membership.

Overview

Lifeforce is hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own every message a lead or member gets from us after the first click. You'll run email, SMS, push, and in-app messaging across the full journey: turning leads into members, getting new members through their first diagnostics and clinician visit, keeping members engaged with their protocols, and bringing back the ones who drift.

This is a hands-on role. You will build the journeys, write and test the messages, set up the segments, and read the results yourself. You'll use AI tools to move faster on copy, personalization, and analysis, and you'll build a lifecycle program that scales as our membership, clinician network, and Ultimate Longevity Center (ULC) locations grow.

You'll work closely with growth, product, clinical, coaching, and member experience teams. Paid acquisition brings people to the door. You make sure they walk in, stay, and get results.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Nurture & Conversion

Build and run nurture journeys that turn leads from paid, organic, and referral channels into members. Work with the growth team to match messaging to the ads, landing pages, and offers that brought each lead in. Test offers, timing, and content to raise lead-to-member conversion.

Onboarding & Activation

Own the new-member journey from sign-up through first lab draw, results review, and first clinician and coach visits. Cut drop-off at each step by finding where members get stuck and fixing it with clear, timely messages. Partner with member experience and operations so messages match what members actually see and do.

Retention, Engagement & Win-Back

Build programs that keep members engaged with their protocols, follow-up diagnostics, and coaching. Drive adoption of supplements, prescriptions, and other offerings where they fit a member's plan. Run churn-prevention, win-back, and referral programs.

Segmentation, Testing & Analytics

Build segments and triggers from member behavior, lifecycle stage, and program data. Run a steady testing roadmap across subject lines, content, channels, timing, and offers. Own lifecycle reporting: conversion, activation, retention, churn, and revenue by journey. Use AI tools like Claude to draft and personalize content, analyze results, and speed up production.

Platform & Compliance

Own our lifecycle platform setup, data flows, templates, and deliverability. Work with clinical and compliance teams to keep every message accurate and compliant with HIPAA, TCPA, and CAN-SPAM. Document journeys and processes so the program can scale without adding headcount.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner with growth on full-funnel strategy and shared conversion goals. Work with product on in-app messaging, onboarding flows, and member data. Bring member insights back to marketing, product, and clinical teams.

What Success Looks Like

  • In your first 90 days: you've audited our current journeys and data, launched a rebuilt lead nurture and new-member onboarding journey, and set up clear reporting on conversion and activation by stage.
  • In your first year: you're running a full lifecycle program from lead to long-term member, with a steady testing cadence, measurable gains in lead-to-member conversion, activation, and retention, and journeys that scale to new markets and ULC locations.

Qualifications

Required

4+ years of lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing experience in a consumer subscription, DTC, or membership business. Hands-on experience building journeys in a platform like Braze, Customer.io, Iterable, or Klaviyo. Strong copywriting skills across email, SMS, and push. Comfort with data: segmentation, A/B testing, cohort analysis, and reporting. SQL is a plus. Regular use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to speed up content and analysis. Clear written and verbal communication. Self-directed and effective in a fully remote environment.

Preferred

Experience in digital health, telehealth, wellness, or healthcare. Working knowledge of HIPAA, TCPA, and CAN-SPAM requirements. Experience with Segment, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or a similar data stack. Experience at a startup or high-growth company. Experience building a lifecycle program from scratch.

Traits for Success

  • Passionate about health, wellness, longevity, or human performance.
  • Writes clearly and cares about the member on the other end of every message.
  • Tests everything and lets the data decide.
  • Comfortable doing the detailed work, not just planning it.
  • Raises problems early and comes with a proposed fix.
  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

What We Offer

  • Remote working environment
  • Company-provided computer and other required equipment
  • Generous benefits package including Healthcare, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • Complimentary Lifeforce Membership for Full Time Employees

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Please note that job scams are on the rise. If you are contacted for this role, it will be from a team member with an email address domain of @mylifeforce.com. Our company does not use Microsoft Teams and will never ask you to disclose your banking information.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Revenue Enablement
jobs.description:
Software development is changing fast, and code is no longer written by humans alone. Secure Code Warrior is the AI Software Governance platform that gives organizations visibility into how their software is created, strengthens developer capability, and reduces risk before code reaches production. Built on a decade as the world's leading secure coding training platform, we're trusted by enterprises worldwide. We're a venture-backed company with offices in Australia, the United States, Belgium, Iceland, and the United Kingdom.
Â

We're looking for a self-starter to own revenue enablement for our global go-to-market team across the US, EMEA and APAC. You'll make sure every seller, BDR, sales engineer and customer success manager can explain what we do, run a sharp discovery conversation with a CISO or VP of Engineering, handle the tough objections, and win against the competition.

This role sits in Product Marketing, so you won't just run programs â you'll build the content yourself: product and competitive enablement, objection handling, onboarding and sales plays. You'll work within a small, fast-moving product marketing team where your work shows up in the field within days, not quarters.

What you'll do

Get the field ready for every launch. Turn new products and capabilities into talk tracks, demo paths, short videos and AI-driven self-training modules, so the field knows the story before customers ask.

Make discovery and objection handling a strength. Build discovery guides for the three people in every deal: the CISO or Head of AppSec, the CTO or VP of Engineering, and the Head of AI Governance. Keep a living objection library grounded in real calls, and run the practice that makes it stick.

Track the competition and find where we win. Follow competitor moves and market trends, mine win/loss data and call recordings, and bring that evidence to Product Marketing to sharpen our messaging. Build battlecards and sales plays backed by proof we can show a customer.

Build learning paths and certifications. Create role-based learning paths and certifications for AEs, SEs and CSMs, so everyone is ready before they pitch something new.

Own onboarding, globally. Run one onboarding program for every new GTM hire, from Sydney to San Francisco to Belgium. Set clear ramp milestones and keep making it faster.

Listen first, then build. Spend time with sellers, BDRs, sales leaders, SEs and customer success to understand what they actually need. Test drafts early, ask for feedback and iterate. Measure what gets used and what helps win deals, and retire what doesn't.

Show up at the big moments. Help shape enablement for Revenue Kickoff and product launches across all three regions.

Who you are

A self-starter. You see what needs doing and do it. You don't need a detailed brief or a big team behind you, and you're happiest building something from a blank page.

A collaborator who asks before building. You'd rather spend an hour with a seller than a week guessing. You ask for feedback early and often, you deliver what the team needs, and you never build in a vacuum and hand it down.

Decisive, with conviction. Listening doesn't mean building by committee. You know which feedback to act on and which to set aside, and you'll move on instinct with limited input rather than wait for consensus. Strong opinions don't knock you off course: you stick with what you know will work, and you say no, kindly and clearly, to what won't.

Crisp and clear. You can turn a complex technical product into something a seller can say in 30 seconds and a CISO will care about. You write tight and cut what doesn't earn its place.

Energized by pace. Our market moves every week. Priorities shift, new competitors appear, AI changes the rules. You find that exciting, not overwhelming, and you know how to ship something good fast and improve it later.

Curious about AI. You don't need to be an expert today, but you're excited to make AI part of how you work. We'll invest in your skills, and you'll help us figure out how AI can make enablement faster and better.

What you bring

6â9 years in revenue or sales enablement, sales engineering, product marketing or another customer-facing role at a B2B software company

3+ years in cybersecurity, application security or DevSecOps, with a real understanding of how CISOs, AppSec leaders and engineering executives evaluate and buy

A portfolio of enablement content you built yourself â talk tracks, demo scripts, battlecards, training â and evidence of what it changed

Experience building onboarding and discovery or objection-handling programs for Enterprise and mid-market sales teams

Comfort with technical topics: the software development lifecycle, code security and AI/LLMs

Experience enabling teams across time zones, with a strong instinct for content people can use on their own

Familiarity with a qualification methodology such as MEDDPICC or Command of the Message, and tools like Salesforce and Clari

Nice to have

Competitive intelligence or product marketing experience

A background as a sales engineer or seller

Experience at a fast-growing company where you were the first or only person in your function

Why you'll like it here

Wide scope, real impact. You'll own enablement end to end and see your work change deals quickly.

A direct line to messaging. What you learn in the field shapes how SCW talks about itself.

Backup when you need it. You'll work alongside a Product Marketing team and SCW's AI Center of Excellence, which will help you build your AI skills and workflows.

A market that matters. AI is changing how software gets built, and security leaders need help keeping up. You'll be helping them do it.

Location

This is a remote role based in the US. We strongly prefer candidates in the Pacific Time zone, so you can work with teams in EMEA in the morning and APAC in the afternoon. Some travel for Revenue Kickoff and regional events.

You're joining us at an exciting stage of our journey, and youâre a key piece to what comes next. Expect real room to create impact and deliver on your ideas. The pace is quick and the bar is high; in return, you get genuine ownership and the kind of growth that only comes from building something that matters.

We also know you do your best work when you're rested and energized. Flexibility here runs on trust: we trust you to deliver when it counts, and we trust you to take the time you need to recharge. With teammates around the world, your hours can flex to fit your life, backed by generous leave and work-from-home options that help you make work work for you.

You'll join a tight-knit team that values humility and giving back, both to the community and to each other. Making the world a little brighter as we make it more secure is part of being a Warrior.

We live and work by the Warrior Code. It means getting feedback you can trust, shared without fear. It means no genius jerks: how you treat people counts as much as what you deliver. We do what we say we'll do, we celebrate the wins properly, and we do the right thing even when no one's watching. Come as you are, bring your best, and we'll do the same.

Practical experience setting up and troubleshooting conversion tracking with Google Tag Manager, GA4, and advertising platform pixels or conversion tags.

A strong understanding of core paid media metrics, including CPC, CPM, CTR, conversion rate, CPA, and ROAS, and experience analyzing campaign data and turning findings into actionable optimizations.

Familiarity with audience targeting, retargeting, and campaign testing methodologies, and an understanding of marketing funnels, attribution, and how paid media contributes to lead generation and customer acquisition.

Attention to detail, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities at once.

Bonus if you have:

Experience running paid media campaigns for B2B SaaS, hosting, PaaS, or other technical products, and familiarity with WordPress or cloud platforms.

Experience with CRM, marketing automation, and attribution or reporting tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Looker Studio, Dreamdata, or HockeyStack.

Knowledge of advanced conversion tracking, including enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports, and server-side tracking, plus a basic understanding of HTML, JavaScript, cookies, and how tracking tags work on websites.

Experience optimizing landing pages and collaborating on conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives.

Proficiency in other languages and experience managing non-English paid media campaigns

Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to improve campaign workflows, analysis, and creative development.

Annual remote expense budget.

Flexible PTO.

Paid parental leave.

jobs.title: Client Acquisitions Specialist, Inside Sales
jobs.description:
At Koala Health, we are disrupting pet healthcare by making medication simple, delightful, and accessible. Having successfully launched our pre-sorted pharmacy delivery service, we are expanding rapidly and building the next generation of pet care solutions.

We are looking for driven, competitive, and growth-minded Client Acquisition Specialists to fuel our next phase of scale. In this high-volume outbound sales role, you will connect directly with pet owners, pitch our high-value services, overcome objections, and drive direct conversions. If you are hungry to build a high-earning sales career, master modern pitch strategies, and advance quickly in a fast-growing startup, this is your launching pad.

Â 
This role may require weekend availability.Â 

What You'll Do

  • Drive revenue growth through high-volume outbound outreach to warm leads.
  • Deliver compelling value propositions, pitching Koala Health's solution to pet owners nationwide.
  • Master objection-handling and sales execution to consistently meet and exceed weekly conversion targets.
  • Manage and track your sales pipeline within our CRM, ensuring tight follow-ups and clean record-keeping.
  • Partner with sales leadership to refine outreach scripts, share pitch tactics, and sharp-tune conversion strategies

What You'll Need (Requirements)

  • High school diploma or equivalent; weekend availability required (with two designated weekdays off).

  • 2+ years of experience in sales, phone-based client acquisition, or target-driven customer engagement.

  • High coachability, strong resilience, and an eagerness to build elite sales skills.

  • Persuasive written and verbal communication skills with a natural ability to build fast rapport.

  • Tech-savvy with comfort navigating CRMs and modern sales tools in a remote environment.

Why You'll Win With Us

  • Uncapped Earning Potential: Competitive base pay plus a performance-driven commission structure designed to reward top closers.

  • Accelerated Career Advancement: Fast-track promotion opportunities into Senior Sales, Team Lead, and Account Manager roles.

  • Continuous Skill Development: Hands-on sales coaching, script training, and pitch development from industry leaders.

  • Remote-First Culture: Work from home with a supportive, highly energetic team that celebrates big wins.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (with partial dependent coverage), 401(k), and generous PTO.

Koala Health is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Sales Enablement Director
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sales Enablement Director based in the United Kingdom.

We are looking for an experienced Sales Enablement Director to drive sales excellence and strengthen the performance of enterprise revenue teams in a fast-growing cybersecurity environment. This senior individual-contributor role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution, providing direct coaching and practical guidance to sales professionals, sales engineers, partners, and managers. You will design and deliver impactful enablement programs, improve onboarding and continuous learning, and equip teams with the tools and knowledge needed to succeed. Working closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Revenue Operations, you will help align go-to-market strategies and strengthen commercial execution. You will also leverage AI-powered technologies and data-driven insights to measure performance, improve sales readiness, and accelerate productivity. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a highly technical industry dedicated to protecting critical infrastructure and connected environments worldwide.

Accountabilities

Provide strategic and hands-on coaching to sales representatives, sales engineers, partners, and managers to improve sales execution, strengthen performance, and accelerate revenue growth. Design, implement, and manage role-specific enablement programs, including onboarding, certification, continuous learning, career development, and skills advancement initiatives. Develop and maintain sales enablement resources, including playbooks, battlecards, messaging frameworks, talk tracks, discovery guides, objection-handling materials, and best-practice documentation. Drive sales readiness and execution excellence by reinforcing consistent sales methodologies, improving field capabilities, and supporting successful sales motions. Monitor enablement effectiveness through adoption rates, proficiency assessments, readiness indicators, and sales performance metrics, translating insights into continuous program improvements. Optimize the use of modern enablement technologies, including AI-powered coaching tools, conversation intelligence platforms, learning management systems (LMS), CRM solutions, and content management systems. Lead change management initiatives to encourage the adoption of new sales methodologies, processes, tools, messaging, and collaborative selling practices. Partner with Product, Marketing, Sales, and Revenue leadership to support product launches, competitive positioning, go-to-market initiatives, and evolving market opportunities.

Requirements:

8â10 years of proven experience in sales enablement, supporting quota-carrying enterprise and/or commercial sales teams within complex B2B technology environments. Strong understanding of sales methodologies, revenue operations, enterprise sales processes, and the challenges associated with technically complex sales cycles. Demonstrated experience designing and delivering onboarding, continuous learning, skills assessments, certification, and professional development programs. Proven ability to coach and develop sales professionals through live customer calls, active opportunities, deal reviews, role-playing exercises, and other practical learning approaches. Experience supporting technical sales teams, including Sales Engineers, Solutions Consultants, presales professionals, and other customer-facing technical roles. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to measure program adoption, sales readiness, behavioral change, and business impact through relevant performance indicators. Excellent facilitation, coaching, presentation, written communication, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with senior executives. Ability to create clear, concise, and practical sales resources, including playbooks, discovery frameworks, competitive guidance, messaging, talk tracks, and objection-handling materials. Familiarity with modern sales enablement technologies, CRM platforms, learning management systems, AI-powered coaching solutions, conversation intelligence, and content management tools. Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, manage organizational change, and drive alignment across distributed teams. Experience in cybersecurity, Operational Technology (OT), Industrial Control Systems (ICS), IoT security, critical infrastructure, industrial technology, cloud security, or other complex enterprise software sectors is highly desirable. A proactive, adaptable, and hands-on approach, with the ability to operate independently while collaborating effectively across a global organization.

Competitive compensation package tailored to the candidate's location and experience. Comprehensive health and wellness benefits adapted to the country of employment. Financial benefits and support designed to promote long-term employee well-being. Flexible working arrangements that support work-life balance. Unparalleled flexible time-off policy. Opportunities to work in a global, innovative, and technically advanced cybersecurity environment. The opportunity to contribute to solutions protecting critical infrastructure and major organizations worldwide. An inclusive and collaborative workplace that values diversity of thought, background, and experience.

jobs.title: Account Director (Network Testing & Planning)
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Director (Network Testing & Planning) based in the United Kingdom.

We are seeking an experienced Account Director to drive revenue growth and expand strategic customer relationships across the UK, Ireland, and selected major European accounts. In this senior commercial role, you will lead sales strategy and business development for a portfolio of mobile network testing, planning, and optimisation solutions. You will be responsible for growing existing accounts, securing new customers, and building a sustainable pipeline across the telecommunications ecosystem. Working closely with technical, marketing, product, and sales teams, you will develop compelling value propositions and deliver solutions that address complex customer challenges. You will engage with mobile network operators, service providers, infrastructure companies, and other key industry stakeholders. This is an exciting opportunity to influence the evolution of next-generation networks, including 5G, IoT, and emerging connectivity technologies, within a collaborative and globally distributed environment.

Accountabilities:

Take full ownership of territory revenue targets, sales pipeline development, and forecasting across the UK, Ireland, and assigned strategic European accounts. Develop and execute comprehensive territory and account plans aligned with business growth objectives and commercial priorities. Expand existing strategic customer relationships through account penetration, upselling, cross-selling, and the development of new business opportunities. Identify, prospect, and acquire new customers across the mobile network testing, planning, optimisation, and broader telecommunications ecosystem. Build and maintain strong relationships with senior commercial, technical, and operational stakeholders within target accounts. Understand customer business objectives, technical challenges, and operational requirements, translating them into compelling commercial opportunities and tailored value propositions. Develop robust business cases demonstrating measurable customer benefits, supporting larger-scale engagements and long-term partnerships. Manage the complete sales lifecycle, from prospecting, qualification, and discovery through solution development, proposal preparation, negotiation, and contract closure. Identify competitive displacement opportunities and position alternative network testing and planning solutions to increase market share. Explore new market segments and addressable opportunities, including private networks, neutral hosts, infrastructure providers, engineering service companies, and adjacent telecommunications markets. Develop and leverage strategic partnerships and channel relationships to strengthen market coverage and create additional routes to market. Collaborate with Solution Engineering teams on technical qualification, product demonstrations, customer evaluations, and proof-of-concept (PoC) initiatives. Work closely with Inside Sales and Demand Generation teams to identify target accounts, generate qualified leads, build pipeline, and accelerate sales opportunities. Maintain accurate CRM records, ensuring clear visibility of opportunity status, pipeline coverage, customer engagement, next steps, and revenue forecasts. Apply disciplined sales methodologies and opportunity qualification processes to ensure predictable growth and consistent commercial performance. Strengthen customer and partner relationships to generate repeat business, increase engagement value, and establish sustainable revenue streams.

Requirements:

Demonstrated success in B2B technology sales, with a proven track record of managing and achieving revenue targets and sales quotas. Significant experience selling to telecommunications operators, network equipment vendors, or organisations operating within the broader mobile network ecosystem. Strong understanding of mobile network technologies and the processes involved in planning, deploying, testing, optimising, and operating mobile networks. Proven ability to develop existing strategic accounts while successfully identifying and acquiring new customers. jobs.title: Security Engineer, Offensive Security
jobs.description:
Role Description

As anÂ Offensive Security Engineer within Dropbox Security, you will investigate how attackers could compromise our products and infrastructure, including AI-enabled applications and agentic systems. You will help identify meaningful attack paths and improve the controls intended to prevent, detect or contain them.

This is a hands-on offensive security and threat research role with broad scope and meaningful impact. You will contribute to investigations and multi-phase red team exercises, help prioritize work based on risk, develop attack techniques, and build tooling and automation that expand the reach of our security testing. You will apply practical AI security knowledge alongside broader offensive security skills across applications, cloud infrastructure, and identity systems. Working closely with experienced researchers and partners across Product Security, Detection & Response, Threat Intelligence, Privacy, and engineering, you will help translate technical findings into clear business risk, recommend practical improvements, and validate their effectiveness through retesting. Sound judgment, clear communication, responsible execution, and ownership of your work are essential to the role. You will contribute to the Red Teamâs tools, research methods, and testing practices while developing your own areas of expertise, investigating emerging technologies, and helping advance Dropboxâs offensive security capabilities. You will have opportunities to deepen your skills, publish research, take on increasingly complex projects, and see your work influence security decisions across Dropbox.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes whatâs expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute offensive security assessments by defining objectives, scope, rules of engagement, and safeguards, adapting your approach as new evidence emerges.
  • Investigate unfamiliar applications, infrastructure, APIs, and trust boundaries to identify and trace meaningful attack paths.
  • Develop and safely demonstrate exploits and attack chains that clearly establish potential impact to Dropbox.
  • Build and improve offensive security tools, agents, automation, and testing harnesses, ensuring results are reliable, repeatable, and appropriately validated.
  • Assess security risks across AI-enabled applications, agents, tool integrations, and supporting infrastructure, including the responsible use of AI-assisted research techniques.
  • Partner with security, privacy, legal, and engineering teams to communicate risk, strengthen prevention and detection capabilities, address root causes, and verify improvements through retesting.

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in offensive security, vulnerability research, red teaming or closely related security engineering, or equivalent demonstrated capability.
  • A track record of independently leading complex investigations or engagements and discovering and exploiting non-trivial vulnerabilities.
  • Understanding of application security, authentication and authorisation, cloud infrastructure, APIs and software supply chains, with deep practical expertise in one or more areas and the ability to trace attack paths across systems and trust boundaries.
  • Hands-on experience attacking or evaluating LLMs, AI agents, ML systems, AI-enabled applications, or agentic architectures.
  • Familiarity with security risks in AI-enabled applications, agents and tool integrations, and the ability to investigate unfamiliar technologies.
  • Ability to write code to build or adapt offensive tools and automation, and to read and investigate unfamiliar production codebases.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing novel attacks, repeatable security evaluations or testing frameworks for AI-enabled systems, or building and validating AI-assisted offensive research capabilities.

jobs.title: Content Reviewer - United States
jobs.description:
Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

 

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment
  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness
  • Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models

 

Qualifications to succeed in this project:

 

  • Professional fluency in English
  • Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years  
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture
  • Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities
  • Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher)
  • Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred)

 

Why join the project:

 

  • Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling
  • Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains
  • Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment
  • Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset.
  • Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance
