jobs.title: Content Production Manager
jobs.description:
About Progress Partners

Progress Partners is a fast-growing technology company building and scaling next-generation SaaS and mobile platforms. We blend creativity with data-driven execution to ship high-impact products, including AI-powered tools, productivity platforms, and workflow software, used by millions of people in more than 160 countries.

Our global team of experts in software development, product design, growth, and analytics collaborates across time zones to deliver category-defining innovations. We work end-to-end across the product lifecycle: design, build, launch, and scale.

If you’re passionate about building transformative products, Progress Partners is a place to make a lasting impact.

About the Role

Hi, I’m Oleksandra, Head of Localization and Content at Progress Partners, and I’m hiring a Content Production Manager to join my team. We build consumer products ranging from utility tools to wellbeing and learning experiences, and many of them rely on rich in-app content, such as lessons, quizzes, stories, videos, and other formats, produced through a mix of AI workflows, in-house content specialists, and a network of freelancers. We’re now scaling that output across several products at once, and we need someone to own the engine full-time. You’ll run content production end to end, combining editorial judgment with strong project management to deliver high volumes of quality content on tight timelines. You’ll coordinate the work of our in-house content specialists and directly manage our freelance network, without direct reports initially.

Progress Partners builds consumer web and mobile products used around the world, from utility tools to wellbeing and learning experiences, in up to 36 languages. The Content & Localization team aims to own every word users read across our products and funnels, in every market.

We are building this team from the ground up. You'll join early, shape how we work, and see your impact directly in product and revenue metrics.

  • AI-first. We use AI to produce and localize content at scale, and humans to set the standards, judge quality and decide.

  • Craftsmanship. We hire true subject-matter experts who take pride in their craft and bring the depth and judgment AI can't replace.

  • Fast and pragmatic. We launch quickly, balance quality with speed through a risk-based approach, and improve as we learn.

  • Async and remote. We work across time zones and write things down.

  • Data-informed. We tie content and localization decisions to measurable outcomes.

This role reports to the Head of Localization & Content.

What You’ll Do

  • Plan and manage content production across products, from brief to publication.

  • Coordinate AI-assisted content pipelines, including generation, review and import into our CMS.

  • Brief, manage and review freelancers: writers, video producers, editors, instructional designers and subject-matter experts.

  • Run video production, including AI-generated video and captions.

  • Plan and track production timelines and capacity, and keep production within budget.

  • Make sure content goes through quality review, originality checks and localization on time.

  • Monitor content performance and engagement, and feed insights into what we produce next.

  • Keep production systems topic-agnostic and reusable, so we can launch new verticals quickly.

What We’re Looking For

  • 4–6 years in content production or editorial management for digital products, ideally in-app or educational content for learning or consumer apps

  • Experience managing freelancers and remote experts at scale

  • Hands-on content creation skills: you can write, edit and produce content yourself, not only coordinate it

  • Strong editorial skills and a high bar for content quality

  • Hands-on experience with AI content and video tools

  • Excellent organization, with experience running several projects at once

  • Comfort with metrics and content performance analysis

  • Strong written communication and the ability to work autonomously in a remote, async environment.

  • Comfort with ownership, transparency, and a results-driven mindset.

Nice to Have

  • Experience producing bite-sized learning content, such as courses, lessons or quizzes.

  • Instructional design experience, such as structuring lessons, learning paths or assessments.

  • Experience with CMS-based content workflows.

  • Experience producing content for multiple languages.

In Your First 90 Days

  • Take over content production for an upcoming product launch and deliver it on schedule

  • Improve our production workflow and tracking, and roll them out across products

  • Build a reliable pool of freelancers for video and other formats

  • Define content quality and originality checks for production

How We Work

We’re fully remote and distributed across time zones. We default to async, communicate in writing, and trust people to deliver outcomes, not log hours. Decisions are transparent, ownership is clear, and your work is visible from day one.


Interview Process

We've designed our interview process to be transparent, respectful of your time, and a genuine two-way conversation; we want to get to know you, and we want you to get to know us. You'll always know what stage you're at, what to expect next, and roughly how long things will take.

  • Initial screen with our Talent Acquisition Team - 30 min

  • Take-home assessment - 3 days

  • Final panel with Head of Localization and Content - 60 min

What We Offer

We believe great work starts with taking care of our people, and we want everyone on our team to have the support and resources they need to thrive, both professionally and personally. Here's what you can expect when you join our team:

  • Remote-first: live and work wherever you're happiest and most productive.

  • Flexible hours: we measure outcomes, not time spent at a desk.

  • Unlimited PTO: take the time you need to rest, recharge, and do your best work.

  • Learning & development budget: courses, books, conferences, certifications, whatever helps you grow.

  • Home office & wellness allowance: a dedicated budget to set up your workspace and support your health.

  • Meet-up budget: funds to get together with teammates in person and spend time face to face.

  • A small, senior, collaborative team where your work is visible and your decisions matter.

  • The chance to build products used by millions of people across 160+ countries.

Equal Opportunity

Progress Partners is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re serious about building a diverse, inclusive team. We welcome applications from people of all genders, gender identities and expressions, sexual orientations, ages, ethnicities, nationalities, religions, disabilities, neurotypes, family situations, socioeconomic backgrounds, and life experiences.

We hire on skills, experience, potential, and values fit, never on protected characteristics. If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, just let us know.

jobs.title: Product Safety & Certification Engineer
jobs.description:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
We are building the first AI-native platform for automated product compliance in MedTech. REMATIQ turn hundreds of page of complex regulations (like MDR and FDA guidance) into structured, actionable requirements that plug directly into our customers’ development and quality processes. The result: life‑saving medical devices reach patients faster and safer.

About the job

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you build software with and for our customers. Existing customers ask for more than the standard product does. They want further use cases, integrations with their own systems and workflows specific to their organisation. You sit with the customer's team, scope the problem and build the solution end to end. It runs at the customer as custom software or becomes a feature of the REMATIQ web app.

This is a software engineering role with customer contact, not a consulting role. You work closely with our AI Deployment Strategists, Product and the platform team.

We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week.

How you'll contribute

  • Scope with the customer: Sit with their project team and subject-matter experts, understand the workflow and its constraints, and cut the problem into something that can ship in weeks.

  • Build and ship end to end: Design, develop and deploy the solution, including backend services, integrations, AI workflows and the interface it needs.

  • Run what you shipped: Operate it in production, fix what breaks, and be the customer's technical contact for it.

  • Build integrations: Connect REMATIQ to the systems customers already use in their development and quality processes.

  • Move custom work into the product: Build features in the web app and work with the platform team to turn one customer's solution into a product capability.

  • Find the next use case: Spot further use cases while you work with the customer and scope them together with Delivery.

Our stack

We work in a modern TypeScript‑first monorepo:

  • Core: Node.js 20+, TypeScript 5+, pnpm workspaces, Turborepo.

  • Frontend: React (Vite), Tailwind CSS, and design system.

  • Backend & workflows: Express-based services, with DBOS for durable workflows.

  • Data & storage: PostgreSQL with pgvector, Prisma ORM, Azure Blob Storage.

  • AI & observability: Azure OpenAI, Langfuse, Sentry, plus logging/tracing with tools like Winston and OpenTelemetry.

  • Dev experience: AI‑assisted workflows with Cursor and Claude Code, integrated into our TypeScript‑first monorepo and review process.

What you'll bring

We are looking for a software engineer who ships production software and is equally at home in a customer's meeting room.

You may be a strong fit if you have:

  • Relevant background: 3+ years as a software engineer shipping production software, ideally including forward deployed, solutions engineering or other customer-facing engineering work.

  • Product management or team lead experience: Some experience as a product manager or team lead, where you owned scope, priorities and requirements for what is being built, is a strong plus.

  • Strong TypeScript and Node.js backend experience: You build and operate production services and can contribute to React frontends where needed.

  • Solid database fundamentals: PostgreSQL (ideally), including data modelling, migrations and performance.

  • Integration experience: You have connected a product to enterprise systems through APIs, SSO or data exchange, and have worked within a customer's IT and security constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs: You have put LLM-driven features into production and know how to make them predictable and reviewable.

  • Strong customer presence: You scope a problem with non-technical stakeholders, explain technical trade-offs clearly, and manage expectations without a project manager next to you.

  • AI-native working style: You use Claude Code or Cursor every day to move faster without compromising reliability.

  • High ownership: You take an ambiguous customer problem to production with limited guidance.

  • Willingness to travel: You work on site at customers when the project needs it.

  • Fluency in English (mandatory). German is a strong plus.

We'll be especially excited if you

  • Have worked as a forward deployed or customer-embedded engineer

  • Have built software for a regulated industry such as MedTech or pharma.

  • Have been a founder or a very early engineer at a startup.

    Why this is a great opportunity

  • Impact in a high-stakes domain – Work on compliance workflows in one of the most regulated industries, where correctness and traceability matter and the outcomes are real.

  • Bring GenAI into production – Build the systems that make LLM-driven features predictable, auditable, and reliable in safety-critical MedTech environments.

  • Real ownership – Own major parts of our platform and drive architectural decisions across backend services, workflows, and data.

  • AI‑agent‑first development – Build in an environment where tools like Cursor and Claude Code are first‑class citizens, helping you explore designs, refactor, and ship faster while you stay in control of quality and reliability.

  • Strong peers – Work with people who care deeply about craft and outcomes, in a high-ownership culture that includes teammates with founder experience.

  • Work with leading MedTech companies – Build products used by teams at BBraun, Novartis & Bayer.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Your Mission

As an Implementation Specialist at Hawk, your responsibility is to transform customer requirements into a functioning solution that helps them achieve their business objectives around transaction monitoring, customer screening and fraud detection, alongside cutting-edge AI technologies. You start with a signed contract and support the customer until go-live. This includes translating policies, regulatory obligations and risk factors into Hawk's setup, data mapping, workflow configuration, UAT support and ensuring that key project timelines and milestones are met. You support our customers in realising true value by detecting more financial crime, allowing investigators to focus on what matters instead of drowning in false positives, and adopting state-of-the-art AI technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Requirements and needs assessment: gather and analyse the customer's AML, fraud and screening requirements and advise on best-practice configuration.

  • Configuration: translate policies, screening algorithms, regulatory requirements and risk factors into Hawk's setup, covering rules, screening, customer risk rating and workflows.

  • Data mapping and integration: lead the technical deployment and integration with the customer's systems, via API or batch mechanisms.

  • Testing and go-live: support the customer through testing, UAT and sign-off, troubleshoot issues, and support a successful transition to a production environment.

  • Training and enablement: deliver training to the customer's teams from a functional as well as technical standpoint.

  • Project management: plan and run the implementation from signature to go-live on time and within scope, with documentation and regular stakeholder updates, combining hands-on work with project leadership.

  • Primary contact: be the first point of contact for implementation questions and issues.

  • Collaboration and feedback: work closely with Customer Value Partners for a smooth implementation, and bring actionable customer feedback and gaps to Product, Development and Hawk's GTM organisation.

  • Document every configuration decision and the reasoning behind it, so the setup holds up when the customer's auditor or regulator asks why a rule was set the way it was.

  • Manage each implementation task and the implementation success as an outcome you own, as directed by our Customer Value Partner, resulting in activity completion and a go-live on the dates you committed to.

Your Profile

  • 6+ years in implementation consulting or solution consulting, with at least 3 of those years hands-on implementing AML, fraud or screening solutions.

  • Subject matter expertise in AML and compliance. You are familiar with key typologies and patterns, the regulatory expectations behind them, and how monitoring programmes as well as AI get examined.

  • You can confidently stand in front of an MLRO and discuss and defend a rule set. This is a must-have, not a nice-to-have.

  • Hands-on data skills: SQL, APIs, CSV and JSON, and data modelling. You're familiar with standardised payment message formats, including SWIFT MT and ISO 20022, SEPA and card data.

  • Integration literacy. You don't write production code, but you're at home with APIs, JSON payloads, SFTP configurations as well as SSO.

  • Proven track record of taking complex implementations to go-live on time, ideally several in parallel, with banking customers or other financial institutions.

  • Stakeholder alignment. You ensure that internal and external parties both have the information they need, keep them aligned and manage expectations.

  • Able to explain complexity simply. Imagine data models for compliance leads, fraud typologies for data engineers. You do it clearly in writing and in the room, in fluent English.

  • A degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, finance or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Bonus

  • Business-fluent German, for working with our DACH customers.

  • CAMS (or equivalent) certification, or time spent in a second-line compliance or MLRO team.

  • Builds constructive relationships with customers and stays calm and under pressure Builder mentality: works independently and brings structure to ambiguity where no established process exists, taking the initiative to define one.

  • Is a resourceful problem-solver who investigates unknowns and tests system behaviour. Knows when and whom to escalate.

  • Manages expectations proactively. Flags timeline and scope risks early, quantifies them, offers phased options and aligns Sales and Customer Success.

  • Handles product gaps transparently. Clarifies the underlying (regulatory) requirement, offers workarounds with their trade-offs, feeds back to Product and doesn't commit to unconfirmed dates .

  • You use AI tools such as Claude in your daily workflow to speed up mapping, documentation and analysis, and you have opinions about where they help and where they don't.

jobs.title: Ops Strategy Manager - DE
jobs.description:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Germany is one of iwoca's core markets, with its own Operations teams across Customer Success, Credit Analysis and Collections. The DE Operations Strategy team is the thought partner to those teams. We exist to understand Operations performance, find where Ops adds the most commercial value, and make the changes that get us there. We're a small team with a startup mindset: we challenge assumptions, prototype quickly, pilot in a lean way, and scale what works.

The role

As an Operations Strategy Manager, you'll own some of the most important projects in our German Operations, from defining the problem through to rollout, across the whole customer journey from application to recovery. Projects could include:

  • Better underwriting. Redesigning how our Credit Analysts work alongside our credit models, so that their judgement systematically improves model decisions rather than working around them.

  • AI and automation in Operations. Using AI to give our teams richer customer context and remove low-value work – for example, cutting the time Account Managers spend preparing for calls, or drafting the first version of routine customer communications.

  • Smarter task distribution. Rethinking how work is prioritised and split between people and automated processes – from when an Account Manager should call a customer to which customers need a personal conversation at all – so that our teams' time goes where human judgement adds the most value.

  • Stronger recoveries. Using our growing book of defaulted loans to work out which contact strategies, payment arrangements and recovery routes lead to the best outcomes – for iwoca and for the customer.

Whatever the project, you'll ground decisions in evidence: designing and running split tests, doing your own analysis, and working with our Data Scientists to get even more out of our data. You'll work with Operations, Product and Engineering to put changes live, share recommendations directly with Operations leadership and the German management team, and be part of iwoca's wider community of Analysts and Data Scientists.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Strategy experience. You've worked in a top-tier strategy consultancy or in a strategic role at a tech or finance company.

  • Analytical foundations. You have a strong analytical background, through academic qualifications (such as a STEM degree) and professional experience.

  • First-principles thinking. You break complex problems into their core parts, challenge assumptions, and recommend well-reasoned, innovative solutions.

  • Execution. You've taken recommendations from concept to execution, with hands-on experience implementing product or process improvements.

  • Communication. You distil complex information into clear, engaging messages for a range of stakeholders – from Data Scientists and Operations Managers to C-level.

  • AI leverage. You use modern tools, including AI, to improve the quality, speed and rigour of your work, while staying responsible for accuracy and outcomes.

Bonus:

  • German language. Our customers are in Germany, so German helps day to day – but it's definitely not a requirement.

  • Coding abilities. You have experience using Python or SQL – either directly or through coding tools like Claude Code. If you haven't coded before, we'd want you to be excited to learn on the job.

  • Operational excellence. You've driven measurable improvements in a fast-growing operation.

  • Experimentation. You've designed, run and interpreted controlled experiments, including A/B tests, to inform operational or product decisions.

The salary

We expect to pay from £75,000 - £90,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

jobs.description:
Location: Paris, France (4 days onsite per week)

Employment Type: Permanent, Full-time

Salary: €100,000 – €120,000 gross/year

About the Opportunity

We are partnering with a leading European financial market infrastructure group to build a new Digital Assets division, focused on tokenisation and Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT).

The mission is to develop next-generation financial infrastructure, launch innovative digital asset products for institutional and retail clients, and bridge traditional finance (TradFi) with decentralised finance (DeFi).

This is a unique founding-style leadership opportunity within an established, highly regulated financial institution. You will have the opportunity to shape the technical vision, own the architecture, and build foundational technology from the ground up.

The Mission

You will lead the architecture of the organisation's first tokenised financial products, covering two major initiatives:

  • Tokenised Securities Platform: Building an issuance, trading and settlement platform for equities, ETFs and bonds, featuring 24/7 trading, fractional ownership and on-chain Delivery-versus-Payment (DvP) settlement.
  • Tokenised Collateral Management Platform: Enabling real-time repo transactions, CCP margin eligibility and DeFi distribution of government bonds through regulated lending environments.

Your responsibility is to translate these strategic initiatives into secure, scalable and auditable technical architectures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end architecture for digital asset solutions, integrating DLT with traditional financial market infrastructure, including trading, clearing, settlement, custody and CSD.
  • Design cross-chain architectures across permissioned networks (Hyperledger Besu, Canton Network) and public blockchains (Ethereum/L2).
  • Define on-chain compliance frameworks, including ERC-3643/T-REX token standards, KYC-whitelisted wallets, AML screening and transaction reporting.
  • Architect institutional custody and key management solutions using MPC technologies such as Fireblocks and Taurus.
  • Establish engineering standards covering code quality, architecture reviews, testing and secure-by-design development.
  • Lead threat modelling and security architecture for high-value financial systems.
  • Drive build-versus-buy decisions across blockchain infrastructure, custody and audit solutions.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Legal, Regulatory, Clearing and CSD stakeholders.
  • Remain hands-on with critical technical components and high-risk incidents.
  • Build and develop the engineering team as the platform transitions from development to production.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, including at least 3 years working on DLT or blockchain projects.
  • Strong expertise in distributed systems and blockchain architecture.
  • Hands-on experience with EVM and permissioned blockchain networks such as Canton or Hyperledger Besu.
  • Knowledge of regulated security token standards, particularly ERC-3643/T-REX or equivalent.
  • Strong understanding of smart contract security, cross-chain risks and on-chain compliance.
  • Experience designing secure, highly available financial systems operating 24/7.
  • Working knowledge of capital markets infrastructure, including DvP, CSD, CCP and settlement processes.
  • Strong leadership skills with a player-coach mindset.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.

AI Engineering Skills (Required)

  • Experience defining AI-augmented software development workflows using coding assistants, smart contract scaffolding and AI-generated test suites.
  • Ability to establish governance and security guardrails for AI-assisted code, including code reviews, secret management and licence/provenance checks.
  • Experience evaluating AI development tools and identifying practical productivity improvements.
  • Understanding of AI-powered product capabilities such as anomaly detection and operational triage, including associated risk controls.

Why Join?

  • Take ownership of the architecture for a major digital asset infrastructure initiative.
  • Build innovative tokenisation products at the intersection of TradFi and DeFi.
  • Work within an established European financial institution while enjoying the autonomy of a zero-to-one project.
  • Influence strategic technology decisions and shape the future engineering team.

Important: Candidates must be willing to work onsite in Paris, France, 4 days per week.

Salary: €100K–€120K gross annually.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About Tebi

Tebi is building a modern connected hospitality operating system that helps entrepreneurs run their business more intelligently and smoothly. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen, inventory, and payments (as well as all the data that powers it) helping to automate work, streamline operations, and give hospitality owners the clarity and time they need to focus on what matters the most: creating great guest experiences.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is build in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Spain, Italy, Denmark, Germany, Finland, and Ireland.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to build and run the systems behind Tebi’s revenue engine, from how we find and win merchants to how we onboard, retain and grow them across seven European markets.

You’ll apply skills like building enrichment flows, tracking buying signals, setting up outbound and automating workflows in HubSpot and the tools around it across the customer lifecycle, from lead enrichment and outbound to onboarding handover, customer health and expansion. You’ll report to our RevOps Lead and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Onboarding, Account Management and the Data team.

This is a hands-on role where speed matters. You’ll build with Clay, HubSpot, n8n, APIs, webhooks and AI, and take every idea from first experiment to a system the whole go-to-market team relies on. You understand what drives revenue, so you know what is worth building, and you work in short loops: ship fast, measure, learn and adapt quickly.

What You’ll Do

Build the acquisition engine

  • Build enrichment flows, ideal customer profile scoring and lead routing that turn raw leads into clear next actions for reps in HubSpot.

  • Design and automate signal tracking across the funnel, including walk-in activity in emerging markets not yet visible in HubSpot.

  • Build outbound plays and sequencing systems for sales-led and PLG motions, and run experiments to learn how best to reach customers.

  • Prototype and improve an AI outbound assistant that saves reps time, with a human in the loop.

Build the processes and automation behind onboarding, retention and expansion

  • Design and automate the Sales-to-Onboarding handover process across our toolstack, replacing manual steps and setting milestones, ownership and service levels from signed to live, with alerts when a merchant stalls.

  • Set up the retention signals and risk alerts that matter, each routed to a clear action and owner.

  • Design the expansion framework from scratch for sales-led (Account Manager-led) and PLG (automated, in-product or lifecycle) upsell, and build the plays, sequences and automation behind it in our toolstack.

  • Measure and refine these processes against pipeline, retention and expansion outcomes, and talk to reps, Account Managers and merchants about their pain points to turn what you learn into better workflows and systems.

  • Build and maintain the integrations across our toolstack, including HubSpot, BigQuery and the enrichment and outbound tools, and document system logic so it scales with the team.

What You’ll Need

  • Around 3 or more years of relevant experience in RevOps, sales operations or customer success operations, or an equivalent role in B2B SaaS.

  • Hands-on experience building enrichment flows, signal tracking and outbound systems.

  • Experience in high-velocity SaaS or an agency.

  • Good knowledge of Clay and other GTM tools, such as n8n, Make, Apollo, Instantly or similar, and comfort working with APIs and webhooks.

  • Hands-on HubSpot experience beyond admin work: workflows, lifecycle stages, properties and reporting.

  • Proven experience building workflows, sequences and lifecycle automation end to end, for both sales-led and PLG motions.

  • Experience designing and automating onboarding or handover processes, and defining health, risk and expansion signals that turn into alerts and actions.

  • The ability to understand customer pain points and translate them into plays and systems that people use in their daily work.

  • Day-to-day experience building with AI, with real workflows, agents or automations you have shipped, and a habit of testing new tools to see what works.

  • An “everything is figureoutable” mindset: you start from a blank page, ship a first version fast, learn from what happens and adapt quickly.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with BigQuery, Dataform, Metabase or comparable analytics tools.

  • B2B SaaS experience in a growing company where systems and processes are still being built, ideally across multiple countries or markets.

  • Familiarity with hospitality technology, POS, payments or merchant services.

  • Experience applying AI to outbound and customer success workflows, with attention to data quality and human review.

We’re looking for an operator who thinks commercially, builds with AI every day and moves fast: building from scratch, learning by testing, and helping every merchant get live quickly and grow with us.

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Benefits:

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Lunch in the office

  • Flexible time off

  • Team events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer - Search Features & APIs (SABR)
jobs.description:
About us

Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first e-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains.

About the team

The SABR team owns the top layer of request processing for product discovery. We own the service that first receives product discovery requests (autocomplete, search, browse & recommendations) & executes the entire business logic that drives product discovery. That service also functions as a gateway to parse incoming user requests, orchestrate calls across the internal services that do the ranking and retrieval, interpret their responses, and assemble the final response the customer sees. We also own the public configuration APIs customers use to control how discovery behaves, and the MCP layer that exposes all of it to AI agents.

Our team owns both platform & product components: Because of the positioning of our services, we take part in every architectural decision of our core product offering. At the same time, our goals are heavily influenced by direct customer feedback, because all product discovery-related features are either implemented in or integrated with our services.

All of our services are public APIs, so interface design and backward compatibility are a constant part of the job. But most of our attention goes to keeping them fast and up: we serve up to 15k RPS, fan out to many internal services on every request, and are expected to stay available and degrade gracefully when any of them fails or slows down.

The work is distributed systems in practice rather than in theory: request orchestration, failure isolation, caching, latency budgets, capacity planning, and the observability to know what is actually happening in production. The team is small enough that engineers own problems end to end, from design through on-call.

About you

You're a staff-level engineer who wants to own systems, not tickets. You've built high-traffic, low-latency Python services and carried the pager for them. You think in trade-offs: latency versus cost, flexibility versus a public API that customers can't afford to see break, the fix that ships this week versus the architecture that has to last two years. You can lead work that spans several engineers and several quarters, you enjoy mentoring others, and you're fine when a problem shows up half-defined. You don't mind being the one who reads the spec for some unfamiliar protocol, works out how it fits, and designs an integration that holds up at scale. You change your mind when someone has a better argument, you make the people around you better, and you still care about your code long after it merges.

What you will do

  • Own the technical direction of one or more of our services - architecture, performance, and reliability.

  • Lead design of new systems and public APIs, and the evolution of existing ones as traffic and feature scope grow.

  • Raise the engineering bar through design and code review, and mentor mid and senior engineers into owning bigger scopes.

  • Partner with product, other engineering teams, and solutions/support to shape what we build and to represent search constraints and trade-offs honestly.

  • Take part in on-call for the systems you own, and lead incident response and follow-through when things break.

What we are looking for

Technical

  • Substantial experience building and operating high-traffic, low-latency backend services in production.

  • Extensive Python knowledge (our primary language).

  • Experience with observability and performance work in live systems.

  • Experience designing and evolving public APIs that external customers depend on.

  • Experience designing & implementing scalable service-oriented architectures.

Beyond the code

  • Track record of leading projects that span multiple engineers and quarters.

  • Influence without authority, and willingness to change your position when someone has a better argument.

  • Clear written communication - design docs, RFCs, postmortems.

  • Good judgment about trade-offs and scope.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and loosely defined problems.

  • Ownership that extends past merge, to how the system behaves in production.

Nice to have

  • Experience with AWS

  • Background in search, ranking, information retrieval, or e-commerce product discovery.

  • Exposure to AI/LLM-facing infrastructure (MCP, agent tooling, or similar).



Benefits

🏝️ Unlimited vacation time - we strongly encourage all of our employees take at least 3 weeks per year

🌎 Fully remote team - choose where you live

🛋️ Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office

💻 Apple laptops provided for new employees

🧑‍🎓 Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year

👪 Maternity & Paternity leave for qualified employees

🧠 Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact

💵 Base salary: $110k–$130k USD, depending on knowledge, skills, experience, and interview results

📈 Stock options - offered in addition to the base salary

🎉 Regular team offsites to connect and collaborate

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group.

jobs.title: Senior HR Officer
jobs.description:
Krijg jij energie van internationale HR-vraagstukken, het uitzoeken van complexe regelgeving en het slimmer inrichten van processen? Wil jij niet alleen uitvoeren, maar ook meedenken, adviseren en verbeteren? Dan hebben wij een mooie uitdaging voor jou!

Bij Zwart zorgen we ervoor dat de wereld blijft draaien, ook als de stroom uitvalt. Met onze innovatieve noodstroom- en energieoplossingen dragen we bij aan de bedrijfszekerheid van onder andere datacenters, ziekenhuizen en industriële bedrijven in binnen- en buitenland. Zwart is een groeiende organisatie met een internationaal karakter. Dat brengt interessante HR-vraagstukken met zich mee op het gebied van internationale mobiliteit, wet- en regelgeving en klantvereisten.

Als Senior HR Officer ben jij binnen HR onder andere het aanspreekpunt op het gebied van internationale mobiliteit en compliance. Je zorgt ervoor dat internationale collega's goed voorbereid bij Zwart kunnen starten en dat onze medewerkers over de juiste documentatie beschikken om in binnen- en buitenland aan het werk te gaan. Je adviseert, coördineert, bewaakt en denkt vooruit. Daarbij krijg je volop ruimte om internationale HR-processen verder op te zetten, te verbeteren en te professionaliseren.

Waar ga jij je onder andere mee bezighouden?

  • Je bent een toegankelijk en servicegericht aanspreekpunt voor medewerkers en leidinggevenden bij dagelijkse HR-vragen en HR-processen.

  • Je ondersteunt HR Business Partners bij operationele en administratieve HR-vraagstukken en draagt bij aan een soepele uitvoering van HR-beleid en medewerkerstrajecten.

  • Je bent samen met HR Administratie verantwoordelijk voor een correcte uitvoering van HR-processen, zoals in-, door- en uitstroom, personeelsmutaties en dossierbeheer.

  • Je coördineert de HR-processen rondom internationale medewerkers en adviseert en ondersteunt bij visa, werk- en verblijfsvergunningen, kennismigrantenprocedures en overige registraties.

  • Je bewaakt klantvereisten op het gebied van HR-documentatie en compliance zodat medewerkers volgens de geldende vereisten bij onze internationale klanten aan het werk kunnen.

  • Je coördineert aanvragen, bewaakt geldigheidstermijnen en zorgt voor een correcte administratie van vergunningen, certificeringen en overige verplichte documentatie.

  • Je onderhoudt contact met interne stakeholders, klanten, externe specialisten en instanties en zorgt voor een tijdige en correcte afhandeling van vragen en dossiers.

  • Je volgt relevante ontwikkelingen in wet- en regelgeving, signaleert risico’s en knelpunten en draagt bij aan het verder professionaliseren en digitaliseren van HR-processen.


Jij bent iemand die graag ergens induikt, zaken tot op de bodem uitzoekt en complexe informatie weet te vertalen naar praktische oplossingen. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, denkt vooruit en krijgt energie van een organisatie die volop in ontwikkeling is. Daarnaast:

  • Je beschikt over minimaal mbo-4 werk- en denkniveau.

  • Een opleiding in HRM, Administratie of een vergelijkbare richting is een pre.

  • Je hebt in elk geval 7 jaar relevante HR-werkervaring in een dynamische en internationale omgeving.

  • Je hebt ervaring met of een sterke affiniteit met internationale HR-processen, internationale mobiliteit en compliance.

  • Je hebt kennis van HR-gerelateerde wet- en regelgeving en vindt het interessant om je hierin verder te verdiepen.

  • Je bent proactief, oplossingsgericht en ziet continu mogelijkheden om processen verder te verbeteren.

  • Je bent communicatief sterk en weet complexe informatie begrijpelijk over te brengen.

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

  • Je bent digitaal vaardig en ziet kansen om processen slimmer en efficiënter in te richten.

🛡️Welke garanties kun je verwachten?

Bij Zwart krijg je niet alleen een interessante HR-functie, maar ook de kans om daadwerkelijk iets op te bouwen. Onze internationale groei brengt nieuwe uitdagingen met zich mee en jij krijgt de ruimte om hier vanuit jouw expertise mede vorm aan te geven.

Je komt terecht in een professioneel, ambitieus en bovenal gezellig HR-team waarin veel kennis, ervaring en verschillende expertises samenkomen. We leren van elkaar, houden elkaar scherp en staan altijd klaar om met elkaar mee te denken. We werken hard, vieren successen en vinden humor en werkplezier minstens zo belangrijk.  Wat bieden wij jou nog meer:

  • Een contract van 32-38 uur per week.

  • Mogelijkheid tot max. 20% van je werktijd vanuit huis te werken.

  • Een salaris tussen de € 3500,- en €4500,- op basis van een fulltime dienstverband.

  • Collectieve eindejaarsuitkering.

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer voor woon-werkverkeer.

  • 30 verlofdagen per jaar bij een fulltime dienstverband, de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen en jaarlijks 1 dag voor maatschappelijke inzet

  • Arbeidsvoorwaarden conform de CAO Metaal & Techniek - Technisch Installatiebedrijf.

  • Een uitstekende pensioenregeling via het PMT Pensioenfonds, waarbij maar liefst 64% van de pensioenpremie door de werkgever wordt betaald.

  • Jouw ontwikkeling staat centraal. We bieden maatwerk in opleidingen, trainingen en certificeringen, afgestemd op jouw ambities, talenten en de behoeften van de functie.

  • Je werkt in een omgeving waar gezondheid en plezier belangrijk zijn. Of je nu mee wilt wandelen tijdens de lunch, aansluit bij de wekelijkse bootcamp of deelneemt aan één van onze activiteiten: er is altijd ruimte om collega's op een andere manier te leren kennen.

Ben je klaar om je energie in deze rol te stoppen en je skills een boost te geven?

Solliciteer en word lid van ons team!

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Du möchtest moderne Datenplattformen entwickeln, skalierbare Datenarchitekturen gestalten und die datengetriebene Weiterentwicklung einer wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe aktiv vorantreiben? Dann suchen wir Dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als:

Senior Data Engineer (w/m/d)

Als Senior Data Engineer (w/m/d) übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung unserer gruppenweiten Datenplattform. Du entwickelst stabile und skalierbare Datenpipelines, stellst eine hohe Datenqualität sicher und schaffst die technische Grundlage für datenbasierte Entscheidungen. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit unseren Analytics-, Product- und Engineering-Teams zusammen und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unserer Datenarchitektur und Datenstrategie aktiv mit.

Die Arsipa Gruppe ist eine schnell wachsende, PE-backed Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 90 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt - unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, People, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin.

Deine Aufgaben:

Datenplattform & Architektur

  • Den Aufbau, Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung unserer skalierbaren Datenplattform auf Basis moderner Warehouse-, Data-Lake- oder Lakehouse-Architekturen verantwortest Du eigenständig.

  • Robuste ETL- und ELT-Pipelines zur Integration unterschiedlicher Datenquellen entwickelst, optimierst und wartest Du kontinuierlich.

  • Moderne Datenarchitekturen und Datenmodelle gestaltest Du mit Blick auf Performance, Skalierbarkeit und eine effiziente Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen.

  • Bestehende Datenarchitekturen analysierst und optimierst Du hinsichtlich Stabilität, Wirtschaftlichkeit und zukünftiger Anforderungen.

Data Engineering & Quality Management

  • Die Qualität, Konsistenz und Verfügbarkeit unserer Daten stellst Du durch geeignete Validierungs-, Test- und Monitoring-Prozesse sicher.

  • Automatisierte Datenprozesse und zuverlässige Workflows entwickelst Du und unterstützt damit eine effiziente und skalierbare Datenverarbeitung.

  • Monitoring-, Governance- und Sicherheitskonzepte implementierst Du unter Berücksichtigung geltender Datenschutzanforderungen, insbesondere der DSGVO.

  • Technische Herausforderungen identifizierst Du frühzeitig, entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungsansätze und optimierst bestehende Datenpipelines kontinuierlich.

Zusammenarbeit & Datenstrategie

  • Eng arbeitest Du mit unseren Analytics-, Product- und Engineering-Teams zusammen und unterstützt die Umsetzung datengetriebener Anforderungen.

  • Fachliche und technische Anforderungen übersetzt Du in skalierbare Datenlösungen und sorgst für eine transparente Abstimmung mit den relevanten Stakeholdern.

  • Die Weiterentwicklung unserer gruppenweiten Datenstrategie gestaltest Du aktiv mit und evaluierst neue Technologien und moderne Data-Engineering-Ansätze.

  • Dein technisches Know-how bringst Du in die Zusammenarbeit mit Deinen Kolleg:innen ein und unterstützt den Wissensaustausch sowie die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Engineering-Standards.

Deine Startvoraussetzungen:

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Data Engineering oder in einer vergleichbaren technisch geprägten Rolle sowie fundierte Kenntnisse moderner Datenarchitekturen und Datenmodellierung bringst Du mit.

  • Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in Python und SQL sowie Erfahrung mit professionellen Engineering-Standards, automatisierten Tests und CI/CD-Prozessen zeichnen Dich aus.

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen wie AWS, Google Cloud oder Azure sowie Kenntnisse moderner Data-Engineering-Technologien wie Airflow, dbt, Spark oder Snowflake bilden Deine technische Grundlage.

  • Eine eigenverantwortliche, strukturierte und qualitätsorientierte Arbeitsweise, ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowie verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab.

Das hilft Dir, schneller erfolgreich zu sein:

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau, in der Modernisierung oder im Re-Design komplexer Datenplattformen wäre von Vorteil.

  • Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung und Optimierung skalierbarer Datenarchitekturen in datenintensiven oder stark wachsenden Unternehmensumfeldern sind wünschenswert.

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Data Governance, Monitoring, Kostenoptimierung und der Weiterentwicklung produktiver Datenpipelines wäre ein Plus.

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit cross-funktionalen Teams, im Mentoring sowie gute Deutschkenntnisse würden Dir den Einstieg erleichtern.

Unsere Benefits:

  • Attraktives Arbeitsumfeld: Dich erwarten eine marktgerechte Vergütung, 30 Tage Jahresurlaub sowie ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld in unserem zentral gelegenen Berliner Office im Rocket Tower inklusive Gym, unmittelbar an der U-Bahn-Station „Kochstraße“.

  • Strukturiertes Onboarding: Eine umfassende Einarbeitung und persönliche Begleitung durch unser Team sorgen dafür, dass Du Dich schnell zurechtfindest und erfolgreich in Deine neue Rolle startest.

  • Offene Kommunikation & Zusammenarbeit: Regelmäßige 1:1-Gespräche, All-Hands-Meetings und ein transparenter Austausch fördern die Zusammenarbeit und geben Dir Einblicke in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Unternehmensgruppe.

  • Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: Profitiere von Corporate Benefits und einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Eigenverantwortung, fachlichen Austausch und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unterstützt.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum in einer wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe: Übernimm Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Datenplattform und gestalte die technologische Zukunft einer dynamisch wachsenden Buy-&-Build-Plattform aktiv mit.

Unser Bewerbungsprozess:

  1. Kurzes Telefonat mit dem Group Talent-Acquisition-Team der Arsipa Gruppe.

  2. Fachliches Interview mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartner:innen aus dem Data- und Engineering-Team.

  3. Persönliches Kennenlernen mit dem Data- und Engineering-Team.

jobs.title: Senior Manager Fitness Club (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
As a member of the international PureGym Group with more than 2 million members, we are among the three largest fitness chains in Europe and are therefore in an excellent position to continue pursuing and achieving our ambitious goals. This enables us to make an even greater and more important contribution to the fitness and health of the Swiss population in the future.

Due to our continuous growth, we are looking for a passionate and sports-enthusiastic Senior Manager Fitness Club (m/f/d) for Region 1 (Damien Kläy) on a full-time basis.

As a PureGym Senior Gym Manager, you will take on a key role in leading and further developing your club. You will not only be responsible for tasks such as staff management and budget control but will also play a decisive role in improving performance and optimizing the member experience in your club.

The Role:

  • You are responsible for recruiting (including self-employed personal trainers), onboarding and training your team.

  • You strive for the highest standards in your club and the overall region, ensure that quality targets and guidelines are met in terms of cleanliness, health and safety and carry out regular inspections.

  • You are two times per week in the focus clubs of your region and work on improving overall performance by coaching GMs.

  • You look after and support our members in a friendly manner and spread the PureGym spirit across the entire area.

  • You ensure optimal shift staffing in your own club and the clubs in your regions by checking the shift planning on a monthly basis.

  • You analyze reports, data and market developments, define strategies taking into account the budget to achieve your goals and increase the performance of your club and the overall region.

  • You regularly help with the planning and introduction of new Group Fitness class schedules.

  • You support in the compliance control of Connect missions of the respective region.

  • You support your respective Regional Manager as his/her deputy and in his/her day-to-day tasks (the same as in your home club but on regional level).

  • You are supporting in the new openings of gyms in your region.


Requirements:

  • Your studio must not have had more than 2,500 members as of 31 October 2026. If this is the case, you can still apply for the position, but you will have to switch your club for one that meets the above requirement

  • You do not work in a newly opened gym or a gym that is about to open.

  • You have completed training or studies in the sports and fitness sector

  • You are at least since 6 months in a Gym Manager role at PureGym

  • You have a very good knowledge of French and English (at least B2), any other language is a plus

  • You have a flair for numbers and analytical thinking

  • You are flexible in terms of time, also for assignments in the evening and at weekends

  • You have a high sense of responsibility as well as an independent and proactive way of working

  • You enjoy working with people and have a high affinity for fitness, health and sales

Apply now! Let’s work together to give even more people the opportunity to live a healthier life!

jobs.title: Data Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment.


Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry.


About the role
The MLOps team at Gravis builds the data flow that turns raw recordings from our autonomous earthmoving machines (LiDAR point clouds, camera images, GNSS positions and hydraulic signals) into clean, searchable, training-ready datasets for our autonomy models.
 
As an intern, you will learn how data moves through Gravis today, explore data pipeline tools and try the most promising ones on real fleet data, and have the opportunity to help build a pipeline that runs in production on our GPU clusters and is used by our ML and robotics engineers every day, with direct mentorship from senior engineers.
 
We are looking for a motivated student or recent graduate with a background in computer science, data science or a related field and a solid foundation in Python and data processing, available to start in early 2027. 

What you will do

Data pipeline

  • Get to know how data is collected, stored, processed and labelled at Gravis today, map the current data flows, and suggest ways to improve them

  • Explore the data pipeline and orchestration tools available today (e.g., Dagster, Flyte, Argo Workflows, Airflow, Ray Data) and compare them against our requirements: data volume, multimodal sensor data, CPU and GPU processing steps, reproducibility and ease of use

  • Help build small prototypes of the most promising options and test them on real fleet data, from raw machine recordings to training-ready datasets

  • Work with our infrastructure team to set up the chosen pipeline on Kubernetes, so that it runs reliably on our on-premise and cloud clusters

  • Help add data versioning, quality checks, lineage and monitoring, so that engineers can trust every dataset and trace where it came from

    • Collaboration and sharing

  • Write up the trade-offs and present your recommendation to the team

  • Document the pipeline and help ML and robotics engineers start using it


    • What we're looking for

    We recognise that excellent candidates come from diverse backgrounds with varied combinations of skills. If you meet most of the core qualifications below, we encourage you to apply.

    Core qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in, or recently graduated from, a Master's programme in Computer Science, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field in a Swiss university 

  • Solid Python skills and hands-on experience with data pipelines or data-heavy applications, from coursework, a thesis, side projects or a previous internship

  • Good working knowledge of data processing fundamentals: batch and streaming processing, columnar file formats (e.g., Parquet), and SQL databases

  • Familiarity with Docker and working in a Linux environment

We're a positive platform for good, bringing together an incredible creative community made up by our people, our partners and our customers. This community is at the heart of our business success. We welcome differences, empower individuality and celebrate diverse skills and perspectives, creating an inclusive environment for everyone. We are FARFETCH for All.

 

PRIVATE CLIENT

We are dedicated to creating exceptional service for our most loyal Private Clients. Our global organisation brings together Personal Shopping, Client Development, Marketing, Customer Service, Operations, and Analytics. We combine a deep understanding of luxury fashion and curation with data-led, highly personalised client relationships. We understand the world of luxury fashion and lifestyle and we’re unique in our approach to building long-lasting relationships with our Private Clients, inspiring them to discover personal experiences through FARFETCH. 

 

LONDON

Our London office is located in Old Street, London’s tech hub, and is home to a wide range of teams. Our open space is ideal for collaborative work and sharing ideas. We also have a large outdoor terrace, which is the perfect spot to have a team lunch or host events. 

 

THE ROLE

As Senior Private Client Growth Manager, you will sit at the intersection of commercial strategy, advanced analytics, and operational transformation. Your mission is to accelerate sustainable growth across our global Private Client business—turning complex client, sales, and market data into clear priorities, scalable frameworks, and measurable commercial outcomes.

Leading a dedicated team (Business Analytics Lead and Private Client Operations Manager) and partnering closely with regional sales teams and global functions—from CRM and Brand Partnerships to Product and Tech—you will spot the biggest opportunities and constraints in our proposition and drive high-impact change from idea to execution.


WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Shape Global Growth Strategy: Translate global strategic priorities into actionable regional plans across EMEA, APAC, and the Americas, driving acquisition, retention, reactivation, average order value, and lifetime value for our Top and UHNWI audiences.
  • Lead Data, BI & AI Innovation: Evolve our reporting and business intelligence capabilities. Use large datasets (SQL/Python) alongside practical AI and automation tools to uncover commercial patterns, streamline workflows, and sharpen decision-making.
  • Drive Commercial & Brand Activations: Partner with Commercial, Brand Partnerships, and Marketing teams to design targeted growth initiatives for priority luxury brands—leveraging client segmentation, sales incentives, credit campaigns, and CRM activation.
  • Deliver Business Transformation: Identify major friction points in the client and sales experience, build structured workstreams with Product and Tech, and lead global change initiatives that improve sales-team productivity.
  • Enable & Empower Sales Teams: Build the governance, tools, insights, and operating rhythms that allow regional Private Client sales teams to execute consistently and effectively.
  • Coach & Lead: Manage, mentor, and develop the Business Analytics Lead and Private Client Operations Manager while influencing senior leadership across the business.

    • WHO YOU ARE
  • Commercial & Strategic Acumen: Proven track record leading growth, commercial strategy, analytics, or business transformation initiatives within a fast-paced, international organisation.
  • Technical & Analytical Depth: Highly numerate and confident working with large datasets using SQL and Python, with hands-on experience applying AI or automation to solve real business problems.
  • People & Change Leadership: Experienced manager who has built and coached analytical or operational teams, with a track record of embedding new ways of working across regions.
  • Executive Influence: Exceptional storyteller who can distil complex data into clear business cases and influence senior stakeholders without relying on direct authority.
  • Luxury Mindset: Strong understanding of digital commerce, you do not need to come from a similar background to the team, but be willing to learn and become fully embedded in the Private Client world. 
  • Flexibility: Willing to travel internationally when required

    • REWARDS & BENEFITS
  • Employee Pension Scheme 
  • Flexible Benefits Program 
  • Health Insurance & Critical Illness cover 
  • Flexible work environment- 3 days a week in the office, 2 days from home

    • EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES STATEMENT & SCAM DISCLAIMER

jobs.title: Accounts Payable Intern
jobs.description:
SwissBorg is building the future of crypto wealth management, making investing more accessible, transparent and intuitive for everyone. At the core of our platform is the Meta-Exchange (MEX). This smart routing engine connects multiple exchanges and liquidity sources to deliver optimal execution in a single, seamless app.

We're Swiss-engineered, regulated, and trusted by nearly one million users managing over $1B in crypto assets. But beyond the numbers, what drives us is the people behind every wallet and a commitment to continuously improving how they experience and interact with crypto.



Join us!

Are you studying accounting or finance, or about to finish your degree, and looking for real, hands-on experience in an international group? We have an exciting opportunity for you!

SwissBorg is a crypto wealth management platform operating through a group of regulated entities across Switzerland, France, Estonia and other jurisdictions. We are looking for a part-time Accounts Payable Intern to join our small accounting team. You will handle the day-to-day supplier invoice process and learn how accounting works in a multi-entity group, with the support and supervision of our accounting team.

This is a hands-on role. Some tasks are routine, but accuracy and consistency are what keep our financial operations running smoothly, and you'll learn a lot along the way.


You will:

  • Processing supplier invoices: checking, coding and submitting them for approval in ApprovalMax and Xero

  • Preparing supplier payments for review and approval

  • Reconciling supplier statements and following up on open items

  • Maintaining supplier master data and keeping AP records well organised

  • Acting as the point of contact for suppliers and internal teams: following up with colleagues across departments for missing invoices, approvals and supporting documents.

  • Supporting the accounting team with month-end tasks and ad hoc requests

  • Identifying opportunities to improve and automate the AP process, including with AI tools


    • About you:

  • Currently studying, or about to complete, a degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field

  • A good understanding of basic accounting principles (debits and credits, accruals, VAT)

  • Fluent English, spoken and written, is a must: it is our working language across the group. French is a plus

  • Good Excel skills; experience with Xero or ApprovalMax is a plus

  • Curiosity about AI and automation tools: ideas for automating and improving our processes are highly valued

  • Have an interest in crypto 

  • Strong communication skills: comfortable reaching out to and following up with people across different teams, and building good working relationships with them.

  • A highly organised, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently in a remote team

  • Eagerness to learn and to ask questions


    • We can offer you:

  • Hands-on experience with the accounting cycle in an international, multi-entity group

  • Guidance and supervision from an experienced accounting team

  • Fully remote, flexible hours that fit around your studies

  • Exposure to crypto and regulated financial services

    • Why SwissBorg:

    🪙 Annual BORG bonus

    ⏰ Genuine remote and flexible working

    🏖 25 days annual leave plus local bank holidays

    💻 MacBook 

    ✈ Team and company-wide retreats

    📱 SwissBorg Premium account

    🤗 BORG welcome bonus

    🔍You can learn more about us here and follow us on LinkedIn and X for company updates and check out our weekly Pow Wows!

    🤖 A note on AI in our hiring process We use AI tools at certain stages of our hiring process to help assess applications fairly and efficiently. These tools assist—they don't decide. Every hiring decision is made by a human.

    At SwissBorg, we embrace diversity. We strongly believe that getting the best outcome requires different perspectives and backgrounds. We’re committed to openness, curiosity and creating an inclusive culture because we know that diverse teams build better products and generate better ideas. We strongly encourage applications from everyone!
