jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Your Impact

Engineering has changed, and we're changing with it. We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead one or more teams into AI-native software delivery, building products used by thousands of eCommerce merchants worldwide. We're not hiring for where engineering was. We're hiring for where it's going.

You'll lead one or more engineering teams and help shape how they build software as AI reshapes the craft. You'll stay close to the work, coach your engineers, and help your teams move towards agentic workflows, with quality and security built in. We build on and around Shopify, which moves just as fast, so staying current is part of the job.

You'll work from our Leicester city centre office three days a week, with two days remote, reporting to CTO.

 

What you'll do

  • Lead, coach and grow your engineers across one or more teams, building a culture of learning and technical excellence.

  • Own your teams' delivery, working with Product, Design, QA and DevOps to ship high-quality work on time.

  • Apply the architecture team's direction, and improve the scalability and performance of your teams' systems.

  • Raise AI maturity across your team or teams against our maturity model, from prompt, context and harness practices towards agentic loops. Keep building with new tools yourself.

  • Follow our AI development standards, including review of AI-generated code, and flag tooling gaps that slow the team down.

  • Balance tech debt, reliability and feature delivery.

  • Run incident response for your teams' systems and lead post-mortems.

  • Take part in hiring, and support your engineers' performance and growth, including their AI fluency.


    • What you'll bring

  • 5+ years in software engineering, including 2+ years leading engineering teams.

  • A degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent experience.

  • A track record of delivering results with a team and improving how it works.

  • Solid experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure), microservices and API design.

  • Recent hands-on experience building working apps or tools with AI development tooling.

  • Experience with agile practices, CI/CD and incident management.

  • Clear communication, and the ability to link your team's work to business goals.

    • Nice to have:

  • Experience with agentic workflows

  • eCommerce experience, especially with Shopify

  • Laravel, PHP, React or AWS experience

    • Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We hire for potential and mindset as much as experience - if this role excites you, we want to hear from you.


    Life at clearer.io

    eCommerce is crowded, noisy and increasingly complex. At clearer.io, we're built for a different outcome: clarity you can act on.

    We connect to the stack a merchant already uses. Our AI agents enrich their catalogue, learn from their reviews and customers, and put that intelligence to work inside the tools they already own — so their products get found, trusted and chosen by shoppers and AI, without replatforming. We do this across our products: Clearer, Boost Commerce, REVIEWS.io and Influence, used by thousands of merchants worldwide.

    We're a global team with offices in Australia, the UK, Germany, Vietnam and the US, backed for the long term by PSG Equity and Silversmith Capital Partners.

    We care about doing the work properly: listening first, building second and shipping quickly where it matters. Results matter more than rhetoric.

    What guides us day to day:

  • Customers at the heart: we obsess over their needs so we can grow together

  • Purposeful progress: we don't settle - we take initiative and embrace bold thinking

  • Endless innovation: we refine, improve, and take meaningful action

  • Always open: we build trust through transparency and global collaboration


    • Clearer benefits
    Clear benefits

  • Private Medical Insurance with Vitality from day one - including private GP access, a 24/7 medical helpline and advanced cancer cover

  • Dental, optical and hearing cover

  • Mental health support - unlimited CBT (first 8 sessions without GP referral) and a confidential Employee Assistance Programme

  • 20 days PTO and 6 bank holidays - plus the full week off between Christmas Eve and New Year's Day

  • Hybrid working

  • Your birthday off - a full paid day, just for you, every year

  • Give Back Day - a paid day each year to volunteer for a cause you care about

  • Bonusly peer recognition - real-time shout-outs tied to our values, with points that convert to real rewards

  • Clearer Together - two employees who exemplifies our values wins a fully-funded 5-night trip to one of our global offices (Sydney, Berlin, Leicester, Irvine or Ho Chi Minh City)

  • Stopover - travelling near one of our offices? Once a year we'll fund a day with the local team

    • A fair shot for everyone

    We're committed to a fair and inclusive hiring experience. Hiring decisions at clearer.io are based on skills, experience and role requirements - nothing else. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just tell us; it won't affect your application.

    If you want to lead engineers through engineering's biggest shift yet, and help make eCommerce growth simpler, smarter and clearer - we'd love to hear from you. Apply now.

jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer - CDI Paris - Theodo Data & IA
jobs.description:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès
Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.
 
Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue.  En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.
 
Créée en 2016, Theodo Data & AI est l'entité Data et IA de Theodo. Notre ambition est d'accompagner nos clients dans la conception et le déploiement de leur stratégie data ainsi que la recherche et le développement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle à l’état de l’art.
L'entreprise est en pleine croissance : chaque année, Theodo Data & AI enregistre une croissance de plus de 30 % de son chiffre d'affaires, ouvrant ainsi de nouvelles opportunités passionnantes pour les Theodoers !

Tes missions :
  • Ton objectif sera de créer les solutions d’IA qui apportent de la valeur à tes clients, de la conception technique au monitoring en production.
  • Tu travailleras sur des projets d’IA traditionnels (détection d’objet, prédiction de ventes, …) et/ou d’IA générative (RAG, Agents, …).
  • Tu seras garant de livrer le produit le plus qualitatif dans les temps impartis, de faire progresser ton équipe et de l’amélioration continue.
  • Tes projets seront dans diverses industries (santé, fintech, retail, publique, …)
  • Tu travailleras dans une équipe typiquement constituée d’un Engineering Manager, pour te challenger et t’aider à réussir, de 1-3 AI engineer que tu coacheras, et d’un Product Manager.
  • Tu pourras contribuer au développement de nos convictions techniques en interne (e.g. formation, prise d’initiative, …) et en externe (conférences, articles, discussions avec les clients, …)
  • Tu progresseras et feras progresser la boite, en étant actifet en proposant de nouvelles initiatives dans la communauté tech: guildes, formations, etc.
  • Tu évolueras dans une culture fortement impactée par le lean qui encourage l’amélioration constante et met l’accent sur la valeur

    • Ton profil :
  • Tu es drivé par la qualité, aussi bien au niveau du code que de la méthodologie, et le pragmatisme des solutions apportées au client
  • Tu as une expérience significative sur au moins un hyperscaler (AWS, GCP ou Azure)
  • Tu es passionné par les sujets d’IA (traditionnelle et générative) et tu te formes régulièrement sur les nouveautés
  • Tu es aussi ouvert au data engineering : les besoins de nos clients étant évolutifs, tu pourras être amené à participer à des phases de projets sur lesquelles le besoin prioritaire portera uniquement sur la donnée
    • Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo Data & IA ?
    L’environnement:
    💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités
    🤝  Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires.
    🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…)
    🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel
     
    Le package :
    📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe
    💸 Prime d’intéressement indexée sur la croissance de Theodo
    🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…)
    🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...)
    🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an
    🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50%
    🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile

jobs.title: Chief of Staff - CDI - Theodo Data & AI - Paris
jobs.description:
Présentation Theodo Data & AI
 
Avec ses clients, Theodo conçoit, développe et déploie des produits digitaux ingénieux. Pour servir nos clients à chaque étape du cycle de vie de leurs produits, nous avons développé des entités expertes en Design, Web, Mobile, Data et IA, Cloud, Serverless. Pour répondre aux enjeux spécifiques de certains secteurs, nous avons également mis en place des entités spécialisées en retail et ecommerce, services financiers, secteur public, systèmes et services de santé.
Créée en 2016, Theodo Data & AI est l'entité Data et IA de Theodo. Notre ambition est d'accompagner nos clients dans la conception et le déploiement de leur stratégie data ainsi que la recherche et le développement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle à l’état de l’art.
 
🧐 Contexte du recrutement
Cette année, la majorité de notre croissance a été réalisée grâce à l'activation de grands comptes stratégiques. Nous échangeons avec des décideurs dont les enjeux data sont stratégiques pour le développement de leurs entreprises.
 
Pour accompagner le développement rapide de Sicara, nous cherchons un Chief of Staff qui sera le le bras droit des dirigeants et leur représentant auprès des équipes.
 
🎯 Tes missions
Ton objectif est de démultiplier l'impact des dirigeants en apportant un appui opérationnel et stratégique. Tu es aussi le garant de la bonne organisation de l'équipe de direction.
 
1) Construire la stratégie de l'entreprise avec les dirigeants (CEO / CTO) :
- définition de la stratégie à 12 mois (vision, leviers de croissance,...)
- construction de strategic review annuelle
 
2) Aider les dirigeants à faire réussir la stratégie de manière opérationnelle :
- priorisation des sujets : organiser et leader le weekly dirigeants, organiser l'agenda
- responsable des moments clés de l'équipe de direction : weekly meeting, organisation d’après-midis et de week-ends strat
- diffusion de la vision à l'ensemble des équipes via la production des supports de communication interne : monthly meeting, keynote semestrielle,…
 
3) Faire atterrir les chantiers
- identification des chantiers stratégiques de Theodo Data IA
- suivi et accompagnement des responsables
 
4) Piloter un projet niveau du groupe
- par exemple : mise en place d’un SIRH
 
🚀 Tes perspectives
En passant par le rôle de Chief of Staff, tu auras accès au coeur du réacteur de Sicara, tu comprendras de l’intérieur comment penser et déployer opérationellement une stratégie et faire réussir une boîte. Tu développeras ton réseau de C-levels au sein du startup studio M33 en travaillant sur des sujets clés. Le rôle vise à propulser sur des rôles de direction opérationnel ou financier par la suite.
 
🙌 Profil recherché
Tu as entre 3 et 6 ans d’expérience, dont une expérience significative en conseil
Tu es doté d’un esprit analytique et d’un excellent relationnel
Tu es un “doer”
Tu n’as pas peur de challenger et d’être challengé !

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive - Automotive
jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Account Executive
Type: Full-time
Experience: 5+ years
 
What about us?
 
Launched in 2023, INFINIT is a fast-growing fintech scale-up operating in multiple countries across Europe and Americas.
 
At INFINIT we are on a mission to reshape the future of SMEs with AI at the forefront. Our all-in-one operating system has banking at its core, and empowers small business owners and their teams to seamlessly manage and optimize every aspect of their business with AI agents.
 
By focussing on specific industries, INFINIT delivers tailored, high-value solutions, while building innovative AI products to further unlock significant growth opportunities for our customers. INFINIT operates globally, with ambitions to further expand its footprint to redefine the fintech landscape for SMEs worldwide.
 
Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation 🚀 
 
The Role
 
As a Senior Account Executive at INFINIT, you will own revenue generation, focusing on winning high-value, strategic new-business opportunities. You will engage with senior stakeholders, navigate complex sales cycles, and create tailored value propositions that showcase how INFINIT’s AI-driven fintech platform transforms business operations.
 
We are looking for a high-performing hunter with a strong track record of closing larger deals, managing multi-stakeholder relationships, and driving high-impact commercial outcomes.

What do we want to achieve together?
  • You will own the full sales cycle, from strategic prospecting to negotiation and closing, with a primary focus on acquiring large, high-value customers particularly automotive clients such as car dealerships
  • You will act as a catalyst for innovation in large-account acquisition, identifying new growth opportunities and emerging verticals, particularly within the dealership ecosystem.
  • You will design and execute outbound strategies tailored to key account leads, with an emphasis on automotive dealership prospects.
  • You will build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers within key account prospects understanding their unique operational needs and aligning them with INFINIT’s solutions.
  • You will collaborate closely with Product, and Customer Success teams to deliver seamless and impactful customer journeys for dealership clients.
  • You will drive commercial strategy and contribute to refining our value proposition for the automotive segment and other large verticals.

    • What do you need to be successful in this role?
  • 5+ years of B2B sales experience, including proven success selling into mid-market or enterprise accounts.
  • Demonstrated ability to run and close complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with deal sizes significantly above SMB level.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and executive-level presentation skills.A hunter mentality: proactive, resourceful, and relentless in pursuing large opportunities.
  • Experience thriving in fast-paced startup or scale-up environments with evolving processes.
  • Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail; comfortable using CRM and sales intelligence tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot).
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with Customer Success and Operations to ensure a seamless customer handover and long-term success.

    • What will you find working at INFINIT?
  • Competitive Salary and Equity: We offer highly competitive salaries and a stake in our success with share options because we're building this together.
  • Diverse and Inclusive Team: Join a dynamic and international team in excess of 8 nationalities. You'll have the chance to work with experienced professionals from around the world, fostering a rich learning environment.
  • Inspiring Mission: We are dedicated to revolutionizing business financing and making a positive impact on the European economy. Your work at INFINIT will have a lasting effect on businesses and communities.
  • Health and Well-being: Your health matters to us. You will have access to top-quality Medical & Mental Health Insurance.
  • Quality Time Together: We foster a sense of community with annual gatherings and bi-weekly office team gatherings. You're more than welcome to join us for quality time.
  • Personal Time Off: Enjoy flexibility with your personal time off.
  • Flexibility and Ownership: We trust our team and we are goal-oriented. Enjoy the flexibility of remote working with occasional central venue gatherings.
    • Diversity and Inclusion
     
    INFINIT promotes an inclusive culture that seeks equity and values different perspectives. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.

jobs.description:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager for In-House legal teams at Harvey, you are the custodian of value for a portfolio of corporate legal departments at some of Europe's largest companies — you own their mutual success plan and, with your Account Executive, their renewal. You will lead each legal function from first adoption to Harvey being embedded in how the team works, moving it along the AI maturity curve by connecting our technology and legal expertise to the General Counsel's own goals and the metrics they report to the business. You will run implementations as transformation programmes across teams, regions and tools; act as a trusted adviser to GCs, legal operations leaders and their partners in IT and procurement; and run your book as a portfolio.

What You'll Do

  • Deliver the legal team's journey: build and run a mutual success plan tied to the GC's objectives, priorities and metrics — capacity, outside-counsel spend, cycle time, consistency and risk — and deliver kickoffs, implementation reviews, QBRs and executive business reviews to a consistently high standard.

  • Drive adoption as a programme: plan and lead multi-team, multi-region rollouts with clear milestones and a steering cadence; build on proven use cases; integrate Harvey into the team's existing workflows and tools; build relationships from legal operations to the General Counsel and into IT, security, procurement and the business the legal team serves, cultivating champions who enable others.

  • Orchestrate cross-functionally: sequence Legal Engineers, Product, Solutions and Support around integrations and rollouts, and bring the voice of in-house customers back to Product and Engineering.

  • Prove value and expand: align each legal team on measurable outcomes, capture ROI evidence and value stories the GC can take to the business, and qualify expansion into new teams and regions with your Account Executive.

  • Run your book and own renewal readiness: know whether each account is in Defend, Maintain or Grow with evidence; prioritise by value, renewal timing and risk; surface risk early — including competing AI tools — and partner with your Account Executive to renew and expand our strategic partnerships.
    What You Have

  • Extensive background in strategic customer success or account management at Enterprise SaaS, legal (big law or in-house or in-house) or top tier management consulting firms.

  • History and comfort conducting change management and wide-scale adoption for large technology projects.

  • Excellent communication and strategic planning skills, and a capability of influencing stakeholders at every level, including at the executive level.

  • Results driven mindset and the ability to ruthlessly prioritize competing tasks and demanding customers seamlessly.

  • A strong commitment to be collaborative and proactive with a team-first mentality.

What We Offer

Ideal candidates for the Enterprise In-House CSM role at Harvey can demonstrate comfort and experience with the following:

  • 5+ years in customer-owning roles — Customer Success, account management, legal operations, legal-tech consulting or an in-house legal or transformation role — working with corporate legal teams or an equivalent enterprise function.

  • An understanding of how in-house legal teams work: how a General Counsel is measured, how legal operations runs change, and how legal interacts with IT, procurement and the business.

  • An AI-native way of working: you use AI and sophisticated tooling daily, can show how it has changed your own output, and have a point of view on how AI changes in-house legal work.

  • A track record of leading enterprise implementations or transformation programmes across multiple teams, regions or stakeholder groups, with measurable outcomes grounded in concrete use cases.

  • Building a business case and communicating ROI to senior stakeholders in finance and legal.

  • Confidence in technical conversations about workspace configuration, integrations, permissions and data handling, and judgement on when to bring in specialists.

  • Strategic planning and revenue-based prioritisation across a portfolio, including early identification and mitigation of risk.

  • Working cross-functionally with Sales, Legal Engineering, Product and Support teams; comfort running in-person meetings with executives.

  • Adapting seamlessly in the face of high-speed change and growth, with a strong point of view and proactive self-management.

jobs.title: Service Desk Analyst
jobs.description:
What is the job?

This is not your usual service desk job. You'll be the person our clinicians, pharmacists and office teams think of when they think of IT and, one of a very small team that makes technology work across a regulated, growing healthcare business.

Some days that means sorting a laptop for a new starter. Others it means getting a prescription printer back online before the afternoon dispatch, helping open a new office, or working out why a process keeps breaking and fixing it for good. We're a scale-up that still feels like a start-up: things move fast, priorities shift, and there's rarely a playbook. We want someone who finds that energising, not exhausting.

This role will suit a self-starter who wants to make a positive difference.

We care as much about how you work with people, how you think and how you own things than about the certificates on your CV.

What will you be doing?

  • Be the face of IT. Look after people across our offices and remote teams, in person and within the dedicated slack channel. Fix things, explain things, and leave people more confident than you found them.

  • Keep the pharmacy running. Own the reliability of the printers, scanners and devices behind prescription dispensing, where downtime directly delays patients' medicines.

  • Run identity and access well. Manage joiners, movers and leavers across Google Workspace and Microsoft Entra ID, carefully and on time, because in a regulated business access matters.

  • Look after devices. Set up, secure, track and retire laptops and phones, and help shape how we manage them as we grow.

  • Help build what's next. Get hands-on with new office fit-outs, network and security projects, supplier rollouts and tooling changes.

  • Fix root causes, not just tickets. Spot patterns, propose improvements and see them through, from automating a dull task to rewriting a confusing process.

  • Write it down. Keep guides, runbooks and asset records clear enough that someone else could pick them up tomorrow, and good enough for an auditor.

What do you need?

Behaviours

  • People trust you. You can calm a stressed pharmacist, explain a technical problem to a director without jargon, and push back politely when something isn't safe.

  • You own things. When you pick something up, people stop worrying about it. You follow through, and you say early when something is slipping.

  • You're curious. You want to know why something broke, not just how to make the error go away. You learn new tools quickly and enjoy it.

  • You're careful. You can move fast and still respect change control, data protection and access rules. You know when not to improvise.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. You can make sensible calls with incomplete information, and you'll ask when you need to.

  • You make things better. You notice friction others have stopped seeing, and you suggest and deliver fixes without waiting to be asked.

Experience

  • Hands-on experience supporting people in a busy IT role, wherever you gained it

  • Confidence troubleshooting macOS and Windows, phones, printers and peripherals

  • Experience administering cloud tools, ideally Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365 and Entra ID

  • A working grasp of networking basics: Wi-Fi, DNS, DHCP, VPNs

  • Comfort at a command line, and enough scripting to automate a repetitive task

  • Good written English for clear documentation

It would be great, but not essential, if you've also worked with:

  • Device management (MDM) for Mac, Windows or mobile

  • Healthcare, pharmacy or another regulated environment

  • Zero-trust networking (e.g. Tailscale), AWS, or infrastructure as code

  • Office moves, network installs or physical security systems

What we offer:

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + usual public holidays

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more

  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

jobs.title: Senior CRM & Lifecycle Analyst (B2C) – Marketing Automation (all genders)
jobs.description:
Analytics first: Du baust CRM und Lifecycle Marketing bei Foodji komplett neu auf, vom analytischen Fundament bis zur Integration der Systeme – datengetrieben, KI-enabled und mit hohem Iterationstempo.

In dieser neu geschaffenen Rolle verantwortest du die Segmentierungs- und Journey-Logik unserer B2C-Kommunikation. Dein Werkzeug sind Daten, nicht Pixel: Du entwickelst Hypothesen, übersetzt sie in Events, Segmente und Journey-Konzepte, wertest Tests aus und iterierst schnell auf Basis der Ergebnisse. Kampagnen und Content kommen aus dem Marketing- und UI/UX-Team, du lieferst das Wer, Wann und Warum. Rund 60 bis 70 Prozent deiner Arbeit sind Analytics, und KI-Tools wie Claude nutzt du dabei ganz selbstverständlich.

Foodji ist dabei kein klassischer Onlineshop: Jeder Foodji hat individuelle Stocklevels und Produktkombinationen. Genau das macht CRM bei uns besonders spannend. Dazu kommt eine riesige Datenbasis: Fast alle Kund:innen sind registriert und haben ein eigenes Profil. Du entwickelst die Logik für dynamische, hochgradig segmentierte Kommunikation über alle Kanäle – von der Foodji App über In-App-Messages, Push und Mail bis zum Foodji Screen direkt am Gerät – und nutzt Daten, um sie kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Deine Mission bei Foodji

  • Du legst das analytische und konzeptionelle Fundament für eine skalierbare CRM- und Lifecycle-Funktion für unsere B2C-Kund:innen.

  • Von der Hypothese über Segmentierung und Testdesign bis zur Auswertung von A/B-Tests und Kohorten: Du definierst, was wir ausprobieren, misst, was wirkt, und iterierst schnell auf Basis der Ergebnisse.

  • Welche Events lösen welche Kommunikation aus? Du definierst sie auf Basis unserer Daten, konzipierst dynamische Segmente und Journeys, die Stocklevels, Produktkombinationen und Nutzerbedürfnisse berücksichtigen, und entscheidest datenbasiert, ob App, In-App, Push, Mail oder Foodji Screen der richtige Kanal ist.

Au cœur de la croissance de Swile, l’équipe Legal intervient de manière transverse sur l’ensemble des sujets clés de l’entreprise. Elle soutient les équipes au quotidien avec une approche à la fois stratégique, pragmatique et business-oriented, afin de sécuriser le développement de l’activité tout en permettant d’aller vite.

En tant que  AML Compliance Officer Senior, tu intégreras l'équipe Compliance de Swile Payment pour devenir un des référents opérationnels sur la prévention du blanchiment de capitaux et du financement du terrorisme (LCB-FT).

Ton rôle consistera à plonger au cœur des opérations pour sécuriser la croissance de Swile, piloter le traitement des alertes LCB-FT et optimiser/automatiser nos processus de conformité dans un environnement multi-produits (régulés la Mobilité, le Wallet, et prochainement l'Expense et également non régulé comme le Titre-Restaurant).

À ce titre, tu seras notamment en charge de :

  • Traiter et analyser le flux d'alertes LCB-FT : Assurer la surveillance continue des opérations (Transaction Monitoring, screening, scoring clients personnes physiques et morales) et instruire les alertes complexes au quotidien. 

  • Piloter les investigations et les déclarations TRACFIN : Analyser les comportements atypiques ou suspects, procéder à la collecte de données approfondie et rédiger les déclarations de soupçon auprès de TRACFIN. 

  • Scale et automatisation des processus LCB-FT : Participer activement à la construction, l'affinage et l'optimisation des scénarios de surveillance et des outils (notamment l'usage d'outils comme SALV et la mise en place de briques d'IA) pour fluidifier le traitement du volume et préparer les échéances réglementaires de 2027. 

  • Participer aux reportings et exigences réglementaires : Contribuer à la rédaction et à l'envoi des reportings réglementaires (QLB, Observatoire de l'inclusion bancaire, etc.) en lien avec l'ACPR et la vision globale du risque.

    Chez Swile, la conformité n'est pas un frein mais un moteur pour scale de manière saine et durable.

    En rejoignant l'équipe Legal & Compliance à Paris, tu auras un impact direct et immédiat :

  • Un pilier opérationnel LCB-FT : Tu deviens le garant d'une analyse fine des risques sur nos flux d'argent, en apportant des réponses claires sur les dossiers sensibles et à risque.

  • Un accélérateur d'automatisation : En tirant parti de l'IA et de nos outils RegTech, tu contribues à transformer des tâches manuelles de volumétrie en processus intelligents et automatisés et auditable.

  • Un facilitateur de croissance internationale : Tu accompagnes le déploiement de produits complexes comme l'Expense sur le marché français et international (notamment en lien avec notre filiale au Brésil).

    • ✨ Tu te reconnais sur le poste si tu as …
  • Expérience : 7 à 10 ans d'expérience en conformité / sécurité financière (AML, LCB-FT), idéalement acquise au sein d'un établissement de paiement, d'un émetteur de monnaie électronique ou d'une FinTech (ex: Qonto, Shine, SlimPay...) 

  • Expertise LCB-FT & TRACFIN : Solide maîtrise du traitement des alertes de Transaction Monitoring, du screening et de la rédaction de déclarations de soupçon TRACFIN 

  • Appétence Tech & IA : Très à l'aise avec la manipulation d'outils de screening/monitoring (expérience sur SALV appréciée) et une vraie volonté d'intégrer des outils d'IA pour automatiser le quotidien 

  • Rigueur & Pragmatisme : Capacité à approfondir des sujets métiers complexes à 80% de ton temps tout en restant orienté.e business et orienté.e solution 

  • Langues & Localisation : Français et Anglais courants obligatoires (échanges réguliers par Slack/réunions avec l'équipe au Brésil).

    📍Poste basé dans nos locaux à Paris.

    Nous avons un processus de recrutement en 4 étapes : 4 étapes pour te convaincre que Swile est le bon choix pour ta future carrière.

Foleon is a leading content creation platform providing business teams with a fast and scalable way to produce highly-engaging content experiences that bring a new level of intelligence to their customer journeys.

Foleon is based in Amsterdam and New York and serves more than 1,200 global B2B brands. We value people who are bold, ambitious, collaborative, and customer-centric. Even better, the ones who know how to work hard and have fun at the same time. We’re a team of highly driven people, with a great sense of human connection and a clear focus.

Your Mission

As our Senior Product & AI Counsel, you’ll own the legal side of our product and AI proposition, working with us about one day a week on a retainer basis. It’s a new role. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering and leadership to make sure what we build and ship holds up under the EU AI Act, cybersecurity law, digital accessibility rules and GDPR.

Your Job

  • Act as our product counsel: join product syncs, review features before they’re built, and flag legal and compliance questions early.

  • Lead compliance for our AI proposition: classify our AI use cases, map our obligations as a provider or deployer under the EU AI Act, and set up the documentation, transparency and governance it requires.

  • Make sure our platform, and the content our customers publish with it, meets the European Accessibility Act and related standards.

  • Build privacy into the product by advising on GDPR questions tied to new features and data.

  • Advise on cybersecurity law, including NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and incident reporting duties, working closely with our security team.

  • Track changes in AI, cybersecurity, accessibility and privacy regulation, and turn them into practical guidance for the team.

  • Senior and independent: you make calls and own them, without someone steering you.

  • Comfortable working part-time and flexibly, and available when something urgent comes up.

Your Qualifications

  • A Master’s in Law (or equivalent) and 6+ years of experience, ideally a mix of law firm and in-house at a tech or SaaS company.

  • Hands-on experience as product counsel for software, ideally including AI products.

  • Deep working knowledge of the EU AI Act and how it applies to AI propositions in practice.

  • Experience with cybersecurity law (NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act) and digital accessibility rules (European Accessibility Act).

  • GDPR and privacy expertise is a plus, ideally at DPO level or with a certification such as CIPP/E.

  • Experience working with scale-ups on a retainer or fractional basis is a plus.

  • Fluent English. Dutch is a plus.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you thrive on complex problems and want to work at the forefront of AI? Join Cefetra Group’s new AI Innovation Hub as an AI Engineer and shape how AI creates value across our international trading business, from agents and workflows integrated with our core systems to the skills and ways of working that make them stick.

Who we are

Cefetra Group comprises several trading companies in the agricultural sector and the food ingredients industry, with leading brands in the ingredients market. Together, we employ approximately 800 people across 39 offices in 17 countries worldwide. We work closely together to provide our customers with the best possible service. Together with our suppliers, we develop strong supply chains and create value by sourcing raw materials and supplying them to the international food, animal feed and energy industries. Behind that sits real complexity: global commodity flows, volatile markets, intricate contracts and logistics, and data spread across many entities and systems. That is exactly where AI can make a decisive difference, and we are building the capability to make it happen.

The role

As an AI Engineer in the AI Innovation Hub, part of the Group Digital & Technology team, your goal is to build Cefetra Group’s AI capability and set the standard for how AI is designed and used across our entities. You’ll deliver AI solutions, from agents and workflows to knowledge bases, that teams across Cefetra Group can apply to augment their work, while helping colleagues build the skills to use them. You’ll work directly with process owners and business leaders to find where AI creates the most value. The AI Innovation Hub is just getting started, so together with the Group Digital & Technology team you’ll shape its direction from the ground up: which opportunities it pursues and how it delivers them. You’ll also work with Builders and Changemakers, colleagues in our entities who build AI solutions and drive adoption, to share what works and show business leaders what AI makes possible.

Your responsibilities include

  • Run discovery workshops to identify bottlenecks, value and exceptions. Assess use cases against readiness, team commitment, expected value and reuse potential.

  • Build AI workflows and agents using company data. Take prototypes all the way to robust, production-grade solutions that teams rely on in their daily work.

  • Integrate AI solutions with ERP, finance and operations systems, designing integrations that move safely from read-only access to controlled write-back.

  • Test solutions against real business scenarios. Set the deployment patterns, tool choices and safeguards that others across Cefetra Group build on.

  • Deliver hands-on workshops, from practical AI topics such as Claude Skills for non-technical colleagues to technical topics such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) for Builders and create materials Changemakers can use to train their peers.

  • Prepare demos of working use cases for leadership briefings.

Who you are

To succeed at Cefetra Group, you love complexity and combine deep technical curiosity with a pragmatic, collaborative approach. You work well both independently and with people at all levels of Cefetra Group. You take ownership end to end and move easily between governance, technical details and business priorities. You also meet the following requirements:

  • You have at least four years of experience in a technical, customer-facing, consulting or product role.

  • You’ve built and evaluated large language model (LLM) workflows, agents or applications in production.

  • You have hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, indexing, knowledge bases, context engineering and orchestration.

  • You follow AI developments closely, from new models to agentic patterns and protocols, and know how to turn new capabilities into practical value.

  • You have full-stack development experience with Python or TypeScript, including APIs, authentication, data transformation and enterprise integrations.

  • You’re fluent in English and have led workshops for non-technical audiences.

What we offer

A unique opportunity to help Cefetra Group grow and become part of a dynamic and entrepreneurial team within an established multinational. We’re always open to discussing your individual needs. Here’s what we offer.

  • Access to frontier AI models and the room to experiment with new tools, techniques and ways of working.

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid working, as well as opportunities to learn and develop.

  • An excellent remuneration and benefits package, including a competitive base salary, holiday allowance, an attractive bonus scheme and 28 days of annual leave.

  • An office in one of the finest locations in central Rotterdam, overlooking the Maas and the Erasmus Bridge, with plenty of social activities and excellent coffee.

jobs.title: Lead Software Planning & Delivery (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Bei Adlares machen wir Methanemissionen aus der Luft sichtbar – hochpräzise, zertifiziert und entscheidend für den Schutz kritischer Infrastruktur und den Klimaschutz. Mit unserem laserbasierten Messsystem CHARM® setzen wir den Industriestandard für die luftgestützte Gasfernüberwachung – und entwickeln aktuell die nächste, plattformunabhängige Systemgeneration (CHARM®3) sowie modernisierte Daten- und Auswerteprozesse im laufenden Betrieb.

Damit diese Neuentwicklung verlässlich gelingt, suchen wir eine Person mit hohen kommunikativen Fähigkeiten. Du stellst sicher, dass wir unsere Softwareentwicklung verbindlich planen und zum Ziel führen. Du definierst gemeinsam mit dem Produktmanagement die Ziele, übersetzt sie in einen realistischen Plan und trägst die Verantwortung für die Umsetzung. So bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson im Planungsprozess.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ziele & Anforderungen: Gemeinsam mit dem Produktmanagement, dem Leiter IT und dem PO definierst du die Ziele der Softwareentwicklung. Du holst Anforderungen bei Operations, Laser- und Hardwareentwicklern und Nutzenden ein, erkennst Lücken und Widersprüche und übersetzt Deine Erkenntnisse in klare, umsetzbare Arbeitspakete für die Softwareentwicklung.

  • Planung & Kapazitäten: Du zerlegst Vorhaben in Epics und Tasks, planst Kapazitäten realistisch – inklusive Puffer für Betrieb und Tagesgeschäft – und machst Abhängigkeiten zu Hardware, Physik und Systemintegration frühzeitig sichtbar.

  • Umsetzungsverantwortung: Du sorgst dafür, dass Zusagen eingehalten werden: Du leitest das Daily, machst Fortschritt und Risiken transparent und steuerst nach, wenn etwas aus dem Plan läuft.

  • Entscheidungen herbeiführen: Offene Fragen bleiben bei dir nicht liegen. Du bereitest Entscheidungen vor, führst sie im Team oder mit dem Produktmanagement herbei, hältst sie fest und verfolgst ihre Umsetzung.

  • Architektur im Team: Architekturentscheidungen trifft das Team gemeinsam mit der IT-Leitung. Du moderierst diese Runden, bringst die Perspektive von Aufwand, Risiko und Planbarkeit ein und überführst die Ergebnisse in den Plan – auch bei der Frage, was wir am Bestand weiterführen und was wir schrittweise ablösen.

  • Mitentwickeln: Rund 20–30 % deiner Zeit arbeitest du selbst im Code, in Reviews oder an Prototypen. So kannst du Machbarkeit und Aufwand fundiert einschätzen.


  • Planungserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Planung und Steuerung von Softwareentwicklung mit agilen und strukturierten Methoden – idealerweise in einem Umfeld, in dem Software, Hardware und Messtechnik zusammenkommen.

  • Verbindlichkeit: Du schaffst Klarheit und Verbindlichkeit.

  • Teamgeist: Unser multidisziplinäres Team aus Physikern, Software- und IT Entwicklern, Konstrukteuren und Datenanalysten bringt 25 Jahre Erfahrung in Entwicklung und Betrieb von LIDAR Systemen mit. Du bindest alle Stakeholder in den Zielfindungsprozess ein.

  • Analytisches Gespür: Du ziehst aus Gesprächen mit sehr unterschiedlichen Beteiligten das fachlich Relevante heraus und erkennst Lücken und Missverständnisse früh.

  • Entscheidungsstärke: Du führst Entscheidungen aktiv herbei, auch wenn noch nicht alle Informationen vorliegen, und hältst nach, dass sie umgesetzt werden.

  • Technisches Fundament: Fundierte Entwicklungspraxis mit Python, sicherer Umgang mit Prinzipien guter Softwareentwicklung und Verständnis für C++.

  • Wünschenswert: Erfahrung mit der Ablösung gewachsener Systeme (z. B. LabVIEW), mit Datenbanken, Messdaten und Signalverarbeitung sowie mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung. Dazu Neugier auf Spektroskopie, Laserphysik und Optik.

Was dich erwartet

We are looking for a highly structured, hands-on Senior People Operations Project & Process Manager (m/f/d) to join our European HR Operations team. You will be a driving force behind scaling, harmonizing, and digitizing our People Operations processes. Your scope is Europe, with selected global projects and touchpoints on top.

At Flix, People Operations is a team with genuine ownership, business impact, and a seat at the table. As one of the senior drivers of our process landscape, you work alongside the wider team rather than alone, and you are a trusted senior voice on how our processes and projects fit together across markets. Your work directly shapes how HR operations functions at Flix, today in Europe and tomorrow on a global scale.

Our People Operations team is going through a significant digital transformation, with AI as a central part of how we are rethinking the way we work. Multiple projects are running in parallel across European and global scope, and this role contributes directly to that agenda. You do not need to arrive with deep AI expertise, but you need to be someone who is genuinely interested in exploring what AI-driven approaches can do for People Operations and who wants to grow with us in that direction. We have the people and the knowledge to develop these capabilities together.

This role is based in Berlin (hybrid model).

About the Role

  • Process Landscape Management & Optimization: Analyze, document, and continuously advance our People Operations process landscape across Europe. Map existing workflows, identify bottlenecks, and design lean, standardized, and scalable processes with global applicability in mind, keeping documentation and standards up to date as the organization evolves. Working with the Digital Transformation and Tech teams, you translate operational pain points into clear requirements, and drive automation where it creates real value on the ground
  • End-to-End Project Leadership & Change Management: Own complex, cross-functional HR initiatives end to end, including policy rollouts, compliance frameworks, operational restructuring, and transformation projects. You (co)-lead these independently from scoping through execution to handover, set the pace and the milestones, manage stakeholders and dependencies across markets, create operational playbooks, and ensure teams transition smoothly to new ways of working
  • Central Ops Counterpart: You are the central point of contact and the representative for People Operations in cross-functional projects, most importantly with our People Partners and the Digital Transformation team, and additionally with our Centers of Excellence and other stakeholders such as Finance. You make sure People Operations has a clear, informed voice in these initiatives across Europe and at global level, and you bring the operational perspective consistently into every cross-functional conversation
  • Day-to-Day Enablement: You actively support local European People Ops Managers by delivering tangible process improvements that make their daily work faster, safer, and easier

About You

  • Experience: 5+ years in HR Operations, HR Project Management, within a fast-paced, international organization or matrix environment
  • Process Expertise: Deep, hands-on track record of designing, mapping, and implementing complex HR processes, and of being the go-to person others rely on when a process spans multiple teams, departments, and markets
  • Project Management: You (co)-lead cross-functional projects end to end and independently, manage diverse stakeholders and dependencies, and keep scope, timelines, and budgets in check without close supervision
  • Tech-Savvy & AI Mindset: You have a solid understanding of modern HRIS and HR Service Delivery tools. You make decisions based on data and are genuinely curious about what AI and automation can do for People Operations. You do not need to be an expert today, but the interest and openness need to be there. We invest in building these capabilities together

Who We Are

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel.

We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Trust, evidence, and explainability are at the core of everything we build.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer – Models in Production (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Anyone can train a model in a notebook these days. Getting it into production, keeping it accurate month after month and turning its output into decisions people actually make is a different story. That's the job.

For a renowned automotive manufacturer in Munich, we are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer who builds models that matter for a premium brand. You work with structured and unstructured data, take models all the way into production and make sure they keep delivering. Your results shape strategic decisions and the experience of customers who expect nothing less than premium.

What makes this role different

You don't build models that end up in a slide deck. You own them end to end, from the raw data to the deployed model to the insight a decision maker acts on. One client, one location, one team in Munich, with direct access to the people who use your work.

And you are the person who brings machine learning into the business. You explain what a model can and cannot do, teach colleagues how to use it and help them ask better questions of their data.

Degree or not, what counts is what you have built. If you have a proven track record of shipping machine learning applications, for example in open source, that is as valuable to us as a degree.

The goal is ambitious. Move machine learning out of experiments and into the decisions a premium brand makes every day, from strategy to the experience of its customers.

What you will do

  • Develop and implement machine learning models for premium automotive applications
  • Collect, clean and prepare structured and unstructured data so your models are built on something solid
  • Deploy models to production, monitor them and keep them performing over time
  • Turn results into clear insights that support strategic decisions and enhance the customer experience
  • Document your work and teach others how machine learning and AI can be used in their daily business

What you bring

  • A degree in a technical field with a strong focus on machine learning, or a proven track record of building machine learning applications, for example in open source projects
  • Outstanding Python skills and a real appreciation for clean, well documented code
  • Experience developing and running applications in the cloud
  • Hands-on experience taking models into production and monitoring them, ideally with MLOps tools
  • A genuine passion for machine learning and AI and their potential in real business applications
  • The ability to explain a complex topic to a manager in the morning and dig into a data pipeline in the afternoon
  • Fluent English; German is a plus, but not a must

You'll stand out if you have shipped models that are used in day-to-day business, maintained or contributed to open source machine learning projects, or worked with automotive or industrial data.

The essentials

Start on 1 February 2027 in Munich, 35 hours per week, with an engagement until the end of 2027. You will be employed by advanced engineering GmbH and work directly with our client's project team.

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Lebensmitteltechnologie, Lebensmittelchemie, Lebensmittelverfahrenstechnik, Verfahrenstechnik, Chemieingenieurwesen oder einer vergleichbaren naturwissenschaftlich-technischen Fachrichtung.

  • Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Berührungspunkte mit Nachhaltigkeits- und ESG-Themen, beispielsweise im Bereich nachhaltiger Verpackungen, Lieferantenstandards, verantwortungsvoller Beschaffung oder Zertifizierungen wie B Corp.
  • Du hast eine hohe Reisebereitschaft und bist flexibel, bei Bedarf auch kurzfristig für Vor-Ort-Termine bei unseren Partnern verfügbar zu sein.

  • Identify and size growth opportunities. Spot where we can grow, such as clients with headroom, under-used services, regions with unmet demand or gaps in supply with a clear recommendation and next step.

jobs.description:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is traceable and transparent.

We're a 180+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a $75M Series B round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over 4,000 UK businesses across 8,500+ sites, with over £75m in value returned to businesses and generators so far.

We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy.

The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards, came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100.

Learn more about us on our website.

🚀 The Role

We're hiring Product Engineers at Staff, Senior Staff, and Principal level across three of our engines: Buy, Sell and Third Party Access (TPA).

A Product Engineer at tem gets handed a problem, not a ticket. You sit inside an engine, next to the account managers, partners and customers who live with the problem. You work out what to build, build it, and stay with it after launch until you can show it moved the metric. Product sets the bet and the guidance, not the feature list, so nobody writes your tickets for you.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a people-management one. We will talk to you about which engine fits you best, and where your experience and interests line up.

Buy: Buy is where businesses pay less for clean power. It's the side of tem that runs RED for the UK businesses on it: quotes with every cost up front, bills itemised line by line, and a switch from quote to live in minutes, not days. You'd build the products and systems behind that, from tender to signed contract to a bill with nothing to hide, and make it work just as well for the next thousand sites as it does for the first.

Sell: Sell is where generators earn more for what they produce. We contract with UK solar, wind, hydro, anaerobic digestion, biomass and EfW sites, from single farms to multi-site portfolios, through broker partners and direct. You'd build the tools that get generators signed faster, show them exactly what they're earning, and get them paid on time, every time. You'd also open up new kinds of sites we can't contract today, so there's more clean power to put in front of businesses.

Third Party Access (TPA): TPA builds the new transaction rails for our partners. It lets brokers, banks, affiliates and generators sell tem's energy under their own brand, running on Rosso, our pricing engine. You'd design and build the partner APIs, branded portals, billing and settlement that make that work, and take a 0 to 1 product from pilot to production. In TPA you'll also be partner-facing, embedding with partners to get them integrated and live.

📆 In your first 12 months, you might:

  • Sit with the account managers, partners and customers in your engine, run discovery calls yourself and turn what you hear into a clear problem to solve.

  • Decide what to build and what to leave out, then design and ship it without waiting for a spec.

  • Ship work that moves a named business metric, and stay with it until you can show the number moved.

  • In TPA, help take partner integrations from pilot to production, live and working.

  • Mentor engineers around you and share what you learn with teams across the business.

🛠️ Responsibilities

  • Own discovery: Work directly with the commercial team, partners and customers to find the real problem, proactively engaging them and running calls autonomously.

  • Turn problems into outcomes: Turn subjective requirements into objective outcomes, deciding what to build, then designing and shipping it yourself.

  • Be accountable for the number: Take full accountability for the business and user metrics that move as a direct result of your technical and customer work.

  • Own it end to end: Stay with it after launch and make sure it moves what it was meant to move within the business.

  • Make the hard calls: Make sound but critical judgement calls on speed versus robustness, and on commercial risk.

  • Spread what you learn: Feed what you learn from partners and customers back into the product, with an impact across departments that aren't your own.

  • Raise the bar: Mentor engineers around you and raise technical standards, helping others accelerate into roles you used to hold.

✅ Requirements

Must-Haves

  • Proven technical leadership at Senior, Staff or Senior Staff level, with genuine, statistical evidence of leading complex, ambiguous work to real business impact.

  • Comfort operating without a spec, with several clear-cut examples of how you went against the status quo or ran without guidelines to deliver something impactful.

  • Examples of talking directly to customers and commercial teams to find the real problem, participating in (if not leading) early discovery calls and user feedback interviews.

  • Sound commercial judgement, including an understanding of the revenue impact of the risks you take and whether a headcount investment outweighs its costs.

  • Comfort being the technical voice in front of commercial stakeholders and partners, from our leadership team through to our board members and investors.

  • A hands-on, player-coach approach, and comfort in our stack: Python, TypeScript, AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, EventBridge) and event-driven architectures.

Desirable

  • Experience in energy, fintech or another regulated, high-stakes commercial domain.

  • Forward-deployed, solutions or customer-facing engineering experience.

  • API, integration and multi-tenant or white-label platform design, which is especially useful for TPA.

  • Experience taking a 0 to 1 product into production.

🎁 Benefits & Perks

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,200 per year for your remote setup.

  • Up to GBP150 or EUR150 per month for wellbeing.

🤝 Interview Process

  • First call with our Talent Team.

  • Behaviour Interview with the Hiring Manager.

  • Technical Interview with the Team.

  • Culture-Add Interview with Stakeholders.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

Compensation: £145K – £208K

As Orbem’s appointed Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit, you are responsible for occupational health and safety at all Orbem sites and client installations, from laboratories and MRI environments to the workshop.   • Safety Strategy & Systems: You own Orbem’s cross-functional OHS: risk assessments, incident management and compliance frameworks, including a legal register, standards, templates and escalation paths.

  • Projects: You lead complex, cross-functional safety projects, such as new labs and build-outs, and coordinate contractor safety.

  • Training & Mentoring: You build the training and instruction programme, document knowledge, give internal talks and mentor colleagues and the safety contacts in the teams.

  • ESG: Support the team with knowledge, advice and guidance on environmental and sustainability topics, and help develop how ESG fits into Orbem as the topic grows.

  • Authorities & Audits: You are the contact for authorities, auditors and external partners on specialist matters.

Your responsibilities include:

Keeping Orbem compliant with German occupational health and safety law, from risk assessments and training to incident follow-up and contact with authorities. You will also be focusing on the development of the OHS function at Orbem.

Your Experience and Skills

jobs.description:
Opening

WE CANNOT PROVIDE VISA SPONSORSHIP


Details

Preferred starting date: ASAP

Weekly availability: full-time (5 days/week)

Period: 6 months


About the company

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Our core expertise lies in 3D vision and graphics technologies which we deploy in a dual-use context for inspection and defence. This role will initially focus mainly on the defence context where we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Our solutions are aimed to operate with low-cost and widely available sensors and compute. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics, and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners, low TRL research with government agencies, to direct collaboration with military units. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.


Your role

You will work in our team of experienced 3D computer graphics engineers, 3D vision engineers, and robotics engineers. You will not just work on some unimportant side project, but you might actually build key parts of solutions that will be used by our customers and partners. At Fiducial, graphics is not just about pretty pictures: our rendering, simulation, and GPU pipelines sit directly at the heart of our perception and autonomy systems. Activities include:

  • Building physically-based and multi-spectral rendering and simulation pipelines (e.g. EO and thermal/IR camera simulation) to generate realistic synthetic imagery and test perception algorithms across environments and conditions

  • Developing real-time 3D visualization and flight-analysis tools for inspecting reconstructed 3D flight paths, live sensor data, multi-camera detections, and point clouds

  • Working on real-time 3D reconstruction and novel rendering representations such as Gaussian splatting and multi-camera / LiDAR point-cloud mapping

  • Building real-time terrain and satellite rendering pipelines that run directly in the loop with our visual positioning and navigation algorithms

  • Writing and optimizing GPU compute and rendering workloads (shaders, CUDA, and low-level graphics APIs) to run efficiently on both desktop and low-cost embedded hardware

What we expect from you

  • Experience with real-time software development such as game, rendering, simulation, or embedded development

  • Solid grasp of 3D computer graphics fundamentals (rendering pipelines, 3D math and transforms, shaders, ray/path tracing, or rasterization)

  • Experience with graphics or GPU compute APIs (such as OpenGL, Vulkan, WebGPU/WGSL, DirectX, or CUDA)

  • Experience with 3D scene representations or reconstruction techniques such as meshes, voxels, point clouds, or Gaussian splatting

  • Experience with modern C++ (experience with Rust is also welcome)

Big plus if you’re strong in 3D computer vision. Because our graphics work is tightly coupled with our perception stack, strong vision fundamentals will let you have an even bigger impact:

  • Familiarity with camera models, projective and epipolar geometry, camera calibration, or PnP, which is useful when matching simulated or rendered views directly to real cameras

  • Experience with 3D reconstruction or mapping pipelines such as COLMAP, photogrammetry, Structure-from-Motion (SfM), SLAM, or visual odometry

  • Interest or experience in applying rendering and GPU compute to vision problems like long-range drone detection, satellite-to-camera matching, or depth estimation

General

  • Full-time availability during the internship period.

  • A willingness to pick up and learn new concepts quickly and to self-acquire missing background knowledge.

  • A high degree of autonomy, determination and grit in making cool tech work.

What can we offer

  • 1000 euro monthly compensation.

  • 10 vacation days during internship period.

  • (Really) flexible working hours and option to work from home 2 days per week.

  • Have a direct and significant influence on highly innovative products.

  • The opportunity to iterate quickly with tight feedback loops, close to the product. We are innovating, learning is to be expected.

  • Responsibility over the things you implement, you are the expert on what you build.

The application procedure

  • If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us some information about yourself; this can be a resume, website or other source, as long as we get a clear impression of your background and skills.

  • We’ll get back to you ASAP. If we feel you could be a fit for the position, we’ll invite you for an informal introduction so we can get to know you, and equally important, you can get to know us. After this, a technical focused interview could follow.

  • If at this point we feel you are the person we are looking for, we’ll discuss the specifics (starting date and period).

  • Welcome to the team!

jobs.description:
About Atlantic

Atlantic is the first believer in founders, science and bold ideas. We lead pre-seed rounds across Europe with speed and conviction, backing ambitious founders from day one and supporting them hands-on, especially with fundraising and hiring.

As a thesis-driven fund, we have built deep expertise in four technology areas: AI & Compute, Energy & Climate, Industrial & Robotics, and Space & Security. Since 2016, we have partnered with over 150 European founders in their earliest days, including those behind category-defining companies such as Choco, GetYourGuide, Wandelbots, Softr, Harmattan, Again, Synthflow and Mirelo.

For us, there is no 'too bold' or 'too early'. Just founders venturing into the unknown.

The role

As our Finance Manager, you'll run the day-to-day of Atlantic's fund finance: across portfolio monitoring, cash flow and invoicing, fund accounting and reporting, compliance, and special projects. You'll report directly to our Head of Finance and work closely with our Partners, our fund administrator and our tax advisor.

Beyond the day-to-day, you’ll have a clear mandate to automate. The goal is to cut manual work in half and let portfolio insights surface on their own. If building the finance function of a modern VC sounds better than maintaining one, read on.

What you'll own

Automation. You develop our existing setup, and automate finance and administrative workflows wherever it adds value.

Portfolio monitoring. You collect the reporting from our 150+ portfolio companies and use AI to turn the data into insights that the team can act on.

Cash flow and invoicing. You manage liquidity planning, management fees and invoicing across our funds and management company, and support capital calls and distributions.

Fund accounting and reporting. You review the work of our fund administrator and support the preparation of quarterly LP reports, annual financial statements and tax filings.

Compliance. You keep our funds and management company compliant, from regulatory reporting to KYC/AML checks.

Special projects. You take on ad hoc projects across finance, from new reporting requirements to supporting FX management.

The mission

Fast-forward - here's what you've built:

  • Half the manual work is gone. Processes that used to eat your week now run on their own, because you automated them

  • The portfolio talks back. AI pulls the numbers from 150+ startups, spots what's moving and puts it in front of the team before anyone asks

  • Portfolio reporting is an end-to-end system. One trusted source the whole team relies on

The moonshot: Automating the full path from term sheet to financial statements. Few funds work this way today. We want to be one of the first, and you'd be the one who helps us build it.

About you

You'll feel at home here if you:

  • Learned finance where the bar is high. Maybe in fund finance at a VC or PE firm, at a fund administrator, in Big Four audit or advisory, or in a strong controlling team. 

  • Know your accounting inside out, and enjoy putting it to work on a fund

  • Think AI-first. Claude is already part of your workday, and anything you do twice, you want to automate

  • Love turning data into insight, not just reconciling it

  • Own your numbers. You work independently, follow through, and double-check because you care

  • Roll up your sleeves. You're as happy running payments today as building the automation that runs them tomorrow

  • Are curious about startups, deep tech and the founders building them

  • Speak fluent German and English

Bonus points if you've worked in or around venture capital, or built your own dashboards, BI reports or no-code automations.

jobs.title: Productmanager - Team Sellers
jobs.description:
Onderaannemers ontvangen stapels offerteaanvragen, elk met honderden tekeningen, een bestek en een hoeveelhedenstaat. Veel uitzoekwerk dus, en lang niet elke aanvraag levert uiteindelijk werk op. Dat zien we terug in elk land waar we actief zijn, van Nederland tot Denemarken. Bij 12Build ben jij eigenaar van het product dat daar verandering in brengt.

We zoeken een AI-native productmanager voor Team Sellers, het team dat 12Build bouwt voor onderaannemers en leveranciers. Je hebt een goed gevoel voor product, voelt je thuis in data en werkt al dagelijks met AI-agents. Bovenal ben je graag bij klanten en werk je graag met mensen. Zo doen we productwerk bij 12Build.

Het team en de uitdaging
Team Sellers bestaat uit jou, een productdesigner, een lead developer en developers die samen met agents werken. Jij, de designer en de lead developer sturen het team samen aan als trio. Je bedient twee doelgroepen. Onderaannemers gebruiken 12Build om offerteaanvragen van hoofdaannemers te vinden, te beoordelen en erop te reageren. Leveranciers, de fabrikanten en groothandels in bouwmaterialen, gebruiken het om vroeg in projecten te komen en hun partners te bereiken. Leveranciers zijn een relatief nieuwe doelgroep voor ons, dus er valt nog veel te ontdekken.

Er is genoeg op te lossen. Onderaannemers zijn uren bezig met de vraag welke aanvragen het opstellen van een offerte waard zijn. De informatie die ze nodig hebben, zit verspreid over documenten, e-mails en telefoontjes met de hoofdaannemer. En ze willen zien wat het platform hun oplevert. AI verandert wat we voor onderaannemers en leveranciers kunnen bouwen, en jij bepaalt mee waar het het meeste verschil maakt.

Hoe we werken
12Build werkt sinds 2026 AI-first. Designers, developers en PM’s werken allemaal met agents, en we verbeteren die workflows continu om de weg van klantsignaal naar release korter te maken. Die manier van werken is nog lang niet af, en als PM heb je veel invloed op waar het naartoe gaat.

Een paar voorbeelden van waar we nu staan:

  • Onze bedrijfskennis staat in één gedeelde repository, de brain, waar mensen en agents allebei mee werken.

  • PM’s werken met Claude, gekoppeld aan tools als Amplitude, HubSpot, Linear en Slack.

  • Een wekelijkse signal radar verzamelt klantsignalen uit die bronnen en zet ze om in Linear-issues, met het bewijs erbij.



De PM bepaalt wat we bouwen en waarom. Agents nemen elke maand meer onderzoek, analyse en eerste versies over. De tijd die dat oplevert, gaat naar het werk dat alleen mensen kunnen doen: met klanten praten, relaties opbouwen en iedereen achter één richting krijgen. Samen met de PM’s van Team Buyers en Team Growth bepaal je welke workflow we als volgende verbeteren.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je bouwt een heldere visie op waar het product voor onderaannemers en leveranciers de komende jaren naartoe gaat, en vertaalt die naar een strategie en roadmap. Die richting stem je af met de andere productteams, Commerce, Sales en Marketing, zodat het platform als geheel werkt.

  • Je bent een groot deel van je week bij onderaannemers en leveranciers en bouwt een netwerk op van klanten die met je meedenken.

  • Je managet je stakeholders. Je houdt het management en de commerciële teams op de hoogte, weegt verzoeken die botsen tegen elkaar af en legt helder uit waarom iets wel of niet op de roadmap staat.

  • Je bepaalt met je trio welke problemen we oplossen en in welke volgorde. Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor waarde en haalbaarheid: gaan klanten het gebruiken en ervoor betalen, en werkt het voor sales, marketing en customer success?

  • Je legt vooraf vast wanneer iets een succes is en meet dat daarna. Onze data-analisten ondersteunen je bij de diepere analyses. Zelf denk je in data: je leest een funnel of een retentiecurve en weet welke vraag je daarna stelt.

  • Samen met de designer werk je toe naar een heldere oplossing. De developers maken er issues van en bouwen het, en jij checkt of wat live gaat het probleem oplost waarmee je begon.

  • Je verbetert hoe het team met agents werkt. Je bouwt en onderhoudt skills, prompts en checks, en deelt wat werkt met de andere teams.

  • Je werkt met Product Marketing en Commerce aan positionering, packaging en lanceringen.


Over 12Build
Al bijna twintig jaar verbindt 12Build hoofdaannemers, onderaannemers en leveranciers. We zijn marktleider in Nederland en actief in België, Duitsland en Denemarken. Sinds januari 2026 zijn we onderdeel van de E1-groep, samen met EstimateOne en C-Link. Ongeveer honderd collega’s werken vanuit twee kantoren en vanuit huis, verspreid over Europa, met een gezonde dosis Drive, Openness en Happiness.

Sven’s tip for new 12Builders:

“Finding your own style and using it to inspire your colleagues is strongly encouraged!”


Werken bij 12Build, durf jij het aan?
