jobs.title: Stage M2 : Optimisation de l’implantation de l’offre de soins en zones rurales
jobs.description:
Optimisation de l’implantation de l’offre de soins en zones rurales

Organisme d’accueil : Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) – IMT Mines Albi

Le Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) développe des activités d’enseignement et de recherche autour de la modélisation, du pilotage et de l’amélioration des systèmes industriels et organisationnels, dans des contextes complexes et incertains (industrie du futur, supply chain, résilience, etc.).

Contexte et missions

Les inégalités territoriales d’accès aux soins constituent un enjeu majeur des politiques publiques de santé en France. Elles sont particulièrement marquées dans les territoires ruraux et isolés, caractérisés par une faible densité de population, des distances importantes aux services de santé et une démographie médicale parfois fragile. Dans ces territoires, l’amélioration de l’accès aux soins ne repose pas uniquement sur l’augmentation du nombre de professionnels de santé, mais également sur leur localisation et leur organisation territoriale.

Dans le cadre du projet de recherche MAillage Territorial pour Améliorer l’Accès aux soins dans les zones Rurales et Isolées (MATAARI), l’objectif est de développer des méthodes d’optimisation permettant de concevoir de nouvelles organisations territoriales de l’offre de soins, en tenant compte des contraintes géographiques, démographiques et médicales.

Les indicateurs actuellement utilisés pour caractériser l’accès aux soins, notamment l’Accessibilité Potentielle Localisée (APL) développée par la DREES [1], permettent de prendre en compte simultanément la demande de soins, l’offre médicale et la distance entre les populations et les professionnels de santé. Aujourd’hui, ces indicateurs sont principalement utilisés à des fins de diagnostic et de caractérisation des territoires. L’enjeu de ce stage sera de les intégrer dans un problème d’optimisation afin de déterminer les conditions nécessaires à l’amélioration de l’accessibilité aux soins.

Le stage constituera ainsi une première étape consacrée à la localisation optimale de professionnels de santé, avant une intégration ultérieure de ce problème dans les modèles de districting développés dans le cadre de MATAARI.

Dans un premier temps, le.la candidat.e développera un modèle de Facility Location Problem (FLP) intégrant notamment l’offre et la demande de soins, les indicateurs d’accessibilité, les spécificités territoriales et sociales, qui pourront être éclairées par les travaux de l’équipe interdisciplinaire en sciences humaines et sociales travaillant également sur le projet. Une attention particulière sera portée à la non-linéarité du problème.

Dans un second temps, le modèle de localisation sera adapté dans une perspective d’intégration au problème de districting territorial développé dans le projet MATAARI. Il s’agira d'identifier comment les décisions de localisation de l’offre médicale peuvent être intégrées aux décisions de découpage du territoire afin de construire un modèle hiérarchisé ou intégré.

L’objectif final est ainsi de disposer d’un modèle de localisation autonome pouvant constituer un module d’optimisation de l’offre de soins, intégrable ultérieurement aux modèles de maillage territorial développés par les autres acteurs du projet.

État de l’art

Les problèmes de localisation d’infrastructures (Facility Location Problems) constituent une famille classique de problèmes de recherche opérationnelle visant à déterminer l’implantation optimale d’un ensemble d’infrastructures afin de répondre à une demande distribuée spatialement [2], [3]

De nombreuses variantes ont été développées, notamment les problèmes de p-median, set covering, maximal covering location problem et capacitated facility location. Ces modèles ont été largement mobilisés dans le domaine de la santé pour étudier l’implantation d’hôpitaux, de centres de soins ou de professionnels de santé [4], [5]

Dans le contexte médical, les modèles de localisation doivent toutefois intégrer des caractéristiques spécifiques : demande hétérogène, capacité limitée des professionnels, accessibilité spatiale, distances maximales, concurrence entre sites et incertitude sur l’offre médicale. Une réflexion sur la définition et la mesure de l’accessibilité permettra de proposer une modélisation plus fine des interactions entre la localisation de l’offre de soins, les distances et les besoins des populations. Le problème étudié dans le cadre de ce stage se situe ainsi à l’intersection des problèmes de localisation, des problèmes d’accessibilité spatiale et des problèmes d’organisation territoriale des soins.

Une seconde dimension concerne le lien avec les problèmes de districting et de territory design [6], [7].

Alors que ces derniers cherchent principalement à construire des territoires cohérents sous différentes contraintes géographiques et démographiques, le couplage avec un problème de localisation permet d'introduire explicitement la question de l'organisation de l'offre de soins au sein de ces territoires.

Ce couplage constitue une étape importante vers le développement d'un modèle de maillage territorial adapté aux spécificités des zones rurales.

Profil recherché

Nous cherchons un.e candidat.e en M2 ou dernière année d’école d’ingénieurs, spécialisé.e en Recherche Opérationnelle, Optimisation Combinatoire, Informatique ou domaine connexe.

Compétences attendues :

  • Formalisation de problèmes complexes (PL, PLNE)

  • Compétences solides en algorithmique et programmation (de préférence Python)

  • Bonnes capacités rédactionnelles en français et en anglais pour la documentation et la communication des résultats

Modalités

Date de début : à partir de février 2027 (flexible)

Durée : 5-6 mois

Laboratoire : Centre Génie Industriel, IMT Mines Albi.

Lieu : Albi

Contact

Pour toute question concernant le stage, contactez Cléa Martinez ----- candidater, envoyez votre CV, lettre de motivation, et notes de master à Cléa Martinez (

Références

[1] M. Barlet, « L’Accessibilité potentielle localisée (APL) : une nouvelle mesure de l’accessibilité aux soins appliquée aux médecins généralistes libéraux en France », Etudes et recherche 124, 2012.

[En ligne]. Disponible sur: https://drees.solidarites-sante.gouv.fr/sites/default/files/2020-10/dter124.pdf

[2] C. S. ReVelle, H. A. Eiselt, et M. S. Daskin, « A bibliography for some fundamental problem categories in discrete location science », European Journal of Operational Research, vol. 184, no 3, p. 817‑848, févr. 2008, doi: 10.1016/j.ejor.2006.12.044.

[3] Z. Drezner et H. W. Hamacher, Facility Location: Applications and Theory. Springer Science & Business Media, 2004.

[4] W. Gu, X. Wang, et S. E. McGregor, « Optimization of preventive health care facility locations », Int J Health Geogr, vol. 9, no 1, p. 17, mars 2010, doi: 10.1186/1476-072X-9-17.

[5] A. Ahmadi-Javid, P. Seyedi, et S. S. Syam, « A survey of healthcare facility location », Computers & Operations Research, vol. 79, p. 223‑263, mars 2017, doi: 10.1016/j.cor.2016.05.018.

[6] J. Kalcsics et R. Z. Ríos-Mercado, « Districting Problems », in Location Science, G. Laporte, S. Nickel, et F. Saldanha da Gama, Éd., Cham: Springer International Publishing, 2019, p. 705‑743. doi: 10.1007/978-3-030-32177-2_25.

[7] S. Yanık et B. Bozkaya, « A Review of Districting Problems in Health Care », in Optimal Districting and Territory Design, R. Z. Ríos-Mercado, Éd., in International Series in Operations Research & Management Science. , Cham: Springer International Publishing, 2020, p. 31‑55. doi: 10.1007/978-3-030-34312-5_3.

jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers, qui développe deux solutions : N2F et Vertical Expense.

Tu seras amené(e) à travailler plus particulièrement sur Vertical Expense, notre solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais qui accompagne les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans leur transformation digitale.

Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…).

En tant que Support Operations Specialist, tu rejoindras la Team Customer Success & Delivery. Véritable point de contact de nos clients, tu les accompagneras dans l'utilisation de notre solution en assurant le traitement, le suivi et la résolution de leurs demandes. Tu auras aussi un rôle clé dans le pilotage de l'activité support, en interne comme auprès des clients.

Tu auras pour mission de :

  • Veiller au respect des niveaux de service (SLA) et relancer les équipes de niveau 2 et 3 si nécessaire.

  • Formaliser la base de connaissances (FAQ, guides, tutoriels) et structurer les macros de réponse.

  • Utilisation basique de Base de données (via phpMyAdmin).

  • Maîtrise de Mantis (gestion des tickets).

  • Utilisation de base documentaire et procédures internes.


Ce qu'on va attendre de toi :

  • Tu es diplômé(e) d'une formation Bac+2 à Bac+3 (informatique de gestion, gestion de projet, école d'ingénieur ou équivalent).

  • Tu justifies d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience en support logiciel B2B, idéalement dans un environnement SaaS, avec une vraie dimension pilotage : priorisation et suivi des tickets, reporting, actions d'amélioration.

  • Tu as déjà animé des points réguliers avec des clients.

  • Tu comprends les environnements SaaS (web et mobile), tu possèdes des notions d'API et de SSO, et tu sais réaliser des requêtes SQL simples.

  • Tu fais preuve d'un bon esprit d'analyse, de rigueur et de méthode pour diagnostiquer, qualifier et suivre les demandes.

  • Tu sais prioriser tes activités et gérer plusieurs sollicitations en parallèle.

  • Tu as un excellent sens du service client et tu apprécies d'accompagner les utilisateurs dans la recherche de solutions.

  • Tu communiques avec aisance, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, et tu sais vulgariser des sujets techniques.

C'est un plus si :

  • Tu parles anglais.

  • Tu as déjà participé à la création ou à la mise en place d'une FAQ.

  • Tu connais les écosystèmes ERP ou SIRH.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Rejoindre une entreprise en croissance, avec une base clients qui se développe et des contextes d’utilisation variés.

jobs.description:
ImaginePartners recherche, pour l’un de ses clients, un opérateur télécom actif dans le domaine du cloud, un ou une Architecte Backup pour structurer et piloter sa Product Unit Backup.

Vous définissez l’architecture de sauvegarde et de restauration du cloud privé et pilotez l’équipe de moins de 10 ingénieurs DevOps chargée de la mettre en œuvre. La Product Unit s’appuie sur des solutions open source pour maîtriser les coûts, préserver l’indépendance technologique et répondre aux enjeux de souveraineté des données.

Modalités de la mission

  • Contrat — Freelance

  • Démarrage — Immédiat

  • Localisation — Châtillon / Saint-Denis / Rennes

  • Télétravail — Possible 2 jours par semaine

  • Durée — 6 mois renouvelable

Vos missions

Architecture et restauration

  • Définir la stratégie de sauvegarde, d’archivage et de restauration des environnements Proxmox VE et Kubernetes, avec Proxmox Backup Server et Velero.

  • Évaluer et éprouver les solutions open source, notamment Plakar, à travers des preuves de concept.

  • Définir les objectifs de perte de données admissible (RPO) et de délai de reprise (RTO), ainsi que les politiques de rétention, de chiffrement et d’immutabilité.

  • Contribuer aux plans de continuité et de reprise d’activité (PCA/PRA) et aux tests de restauration.

  • Maintenir les dossiers d’architecture et d’exploitation (DAT, HLD/LLD, schémas, matrices de flux), formaliser les standards et défendre les choix techniques devant les instances de gouvernance.

Pilotage de la Product Unit

  • Structurer et lancer la Product Unit Backup, définir sa feuille de route, son catalogue de services et son organisation.

  • Prioriser les travaux, répartir la charge, suivre les déploiements et les migrations et accompagner la montée en compétences de l’équipe DevOps.

  • Travailler avec les équipes produit, sécurité, réseau, stockage et cloud, ainsi qu’avec les fournisseurs et les communautés open source.

  • Suivre le taux de succès des sauvegardes, la conformité et les temps de restauration. Contribuer à l’automatisation et à la veille sur la cyber-résilience.

Profil recherché

  • 8 à 10 ans d’expérience en infrastructures, dont au moins 3 ans comme architecte ou référent technique, avec une expérience confirmée du pilotage d’équipe ou de projets.

  • Maîtrise indispensable de Proxmox VE et de Proxmox Backup Server.

  • Expérience de Kubernetes et de Velero. Connaissance de Plakar ou forte appétence pour cet outil.

  • Maîtrise des architectures de sauvegarde (3-2-1, immutabilité, air gap, déduplication, chiffrement). Pratique de Linux, du cloud privé et du stockage objet compatible S3.

  • Connaissances DevOps (CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, GitOps) et pratique de l’automatisation (Ansible, Terraform, Bash ou Python).

  • Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles, leadership, pédagogie et capacité à défendre des choix techniques.

La connaissance de VMware ou KVM, les contributions open source et l’anglais technique sont appréciés.

  • Indiquez votre statut.

  • Précisez votre localisation et le ou les sites sur lesquels vous pouvez intervenir.

  • Décrivez une réalisation avec Proxmox VE et Proxmox Backup Server en précisant votre rôle dans la conception et la mise en œuvre.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel.

We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Trust, evidence, and explainability are at the core of everything we build.

We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community.

Our Values

Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding, and we strive to understand different viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Before we take action, we ensure we truly grasp the challenges, perspectives, and goals. 

Know the Why: We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. We take meaningful action with urgency, but never at the expense of thoughtful consideration. 

Innovate & Iterate: We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail. With deep understanding and a clear purpose, we can develop creative and bold solutions to tackle challenges.

Own the Outcome: We are empowered to take initiative and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes. When we execute, we take responsibility for our decisions, measure the success of our innovations, and learn from the results.

Who You Are

We are looking for an experienced Senior Engineering Manager with a demonstrated ability to lead and grow distributed teams of strong engineers working remotely around the world. You enjoy the pace of a growing company, stay close to what your teams are building, and help the people around you take on more ownership.

Our ideal candidates are passionate about building products that help engineering teams ship better software, faster. They follow closely how AI is changing the way software gets built, and they want to help Develocity lead that change.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and empower several teams, working closely with their team leads, to deliver outcomes that matter to our users and the business, from long-term planning through to execution
  • Spot early risks to releases, team performance, or the business, and plan how to address them
  • Stay close to the technical work through design discussions, investigations, reviews, and guidance
  • Communicate clearly and early with other teams, departments, and stakeholders to meet release deadlines and business objectives
  • Cultivate a supportive team environment that encourages transparency and collaboration; support the personal and professional growth of everyone on your teams
  • Make the most of AI tools in your own work, and support your teams as they find new ways to build with AI

Minimum qualifications

  • 5+ years in a technical leadership role (3+ years in an Engineering Manager role)
  • Have managed more than one engineering team, working alongside team leads
  • The technical depth to serve as a partner to your engineers; you can challenge technical direction and identify risks early
  • Experience with a JVM-based product
  • Proven track record of leading complex initiatives that ship customer-facing products
  • Strong product and business mindset, coupled with a get-things-done attitude
  • Self-motivated and self-managing, with excellent organizational skills
  • Experience in leading and growing software teams and engineers
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills
  • A genuine interest in how AI is changing software development, and hands-on experience using AI tools in your own work

Preferred qualifications

  • Expertise in developer tooling, developer experience, or developer productivity
  • Experience managing remote, distributed teams
  • Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up
  • Experience with AI-powered developer products, such as agents or MCP servers

What We Offer

  • Work on a widely used product with a clear vision for the future
  • Contribute to how software teams build and ship in the age of AI agents
  • Close interactions with customers from leading tech organizations
  • Close collaboration with experienced and dedicated peers and engineers
  • Room to grow your leadership scope
  • In-person meetings, such as our annual company offsite and team meetings
  • Work from home in a remote-first environment 
  • Competitive salaries and equity grants

Location

  • Remote, Europe-friendly timezone, with working conditions allowing seamless collaboration with your colleagues through email, chat, and video calls

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Full-Stack Software Engineer, Internship

Open position, Berlin

Internship, 3 months

Location: Berlin (hybrid)

Start: January 2027, or as soon as you can

Format: Full-time internship, 3 months

Level: Bachelor, Master's or PhD student, or equivalent work experience

Who we are. Zeitgeist Labs is the applied research institute of the future in Berlin. Founded by scientists from Stanford, MIT, Max Planck and Charité with experience at McKinsey and in previous startups. This is a unique opportunity to join an early-stage company at its inflection point.

Problem we solve. Governments, foundations, NGOs and universities spend trillions every year on programs meant to improve people's lives. The industry that measures whether any of it works is slow and manual: months of fieldwork, hand-coded interviews, a 300 page report that lands 2 years after the program ends. The physical sciences are being accelerated by AI co-scientists. The social sciences are not, yet. In an age of ever-increasing complexity, we are building the tools that allow researchers to tackle the hardest scientific questions of our time: how societies work, and what actually changes them.

In short. You own problems end to end, working directly with the founders. Understand them, build the solution, test it, ship it. No ticket-passing.

What you'll do.

  • You work directly with the founders on the system our clients use every day. You own problems end to end: understand them, build the solution, test it, ship it. No ticket-passing.

  • Build and improve across the whole stack, from the research dashboard to the data layer to LLM output handling, every change shipped with a test

  • Build the architecture that turns thousands of data points, interviews, surveys and papers into insights

  • Extend how we collect data: interview agents, surveys, document ingestion

  • Run evals when a model or prompt changes and help decide what ships

How we work.

We are a human-in-the-loop AI company. Everyone here runs a fleet of agents; the human sets the direction, makes the calls and verifies the result. Claude Code is our daily driver, specs come before code, every change ships as a pull request with tests and docs. We care about creativity, critical thinking and solution orientation, not about knowing one particular framework.

Who we're looking for.

  • Self-driven: you have finished things on your own, a shipped app, a side project with users, a tool people actually use

  • Critical thinker: you question what you read, including what an agent wrote for you, and can explain why a solution is right

  • Wants ownership over comfort: small team, short path from your decision to the customer

Bonus points if you have.

  • Built a user-facing app in some flavour of JavaScript

  • Written and debugged your own SQL

  • Called, orchestrated, monitored and evaluated LLMs in something you built

  • A solid understanding of the German language

We are BetterDoc, a digital health company with more than 200 employees in Cologne and Basel. We support patients with serious illnesses and complex diagnoses in finding the right specialists for their health concerns. To do this, we bundle, structure and analyze quality-relevant data from the healthcare sector. Since 2012, we have supported more than 100,000 patients. We have been part of the Otto Group since 2022 and work closely with our sister company Medgate, one of Europe's leading telemedicine providers.

You study medicine and are already exploring what AI can do? With us, you bring both together. You test prompts for real data requests, review AI outputs with your medical knowledge and help build small prototypes. And you see how they turn into products.

Our team

Medical Science is the medical core of BetterDoc. We turn medical knowledge into products: structured data, decision logic and, more and more, AI. Our physicians build prototypes themselves and take them live together with Product and Engineering. As a working student, you are part of this team.

We are looking for a working student (m/f/d) to join us as soon as possible, based in Cologne or remote.

Your mission

Day-to-day work

  • Maintain our medical database: Keep our medical database up to date through targeted research, structured data preparation and systematic validation.
  • Analyses and reporting: Contribute to analyses of medical data for internal decisions.
  • Improve processes: Help develop and automate the workflows and concepts around our database.

AI and prototypes

  • Develop prompts and prototypes: Write and test prompts and build small tools together with the team, for example with Claude, Python, SQL or Google Apps Script.
  • Review AI outputs medically: Assess the results of our AI applications, help build test and reference datasets, and find errors before they reach patients.
  • Structure medical knowledge: Turn medical information into structured data and classifications such as ICD, OPS and SNOMED CT.
  • Work with the product team: Bring your medical perspective to the development of our internal systems with Product and Engineering, and see how a prototype becomes a product.

Your profile

  • You study medicine and are enrolled at a German university, ideally in the clinical phase.
  • You have a soft spot for AI: You already use tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor, and maybe you have even built something of your own.
  • Technical curiosity: First experience with SQL, Python or databases is a plus, not a requirement.
  • You are confident with spreadsheets in Excel or Google Sheets.
  • You work carefully, in a structured and precise way and keep track even of larger datasets.
  • Fluent German and good English.
  • You enjoy working in a team and also independently.

What BetterDoc offers you

  • AI tools and time to experiment – Work with modern AI tools such as Claude and Claude Code, with room to try out new ideas.
  • Learn from physicians who build – Work closely with our Medical Science team and discover a career path beyond the clinic.
  • Flexible alongside your studies – Your hours fit around semesters, exams and clinical electives. Remote work is possible.
  • Make a real impact – Help patients find the right specialists more easily.
  • A strong backing – Work for a successful digital health company, supported by Medgate and the Otto Group.
  • Further benefits – Office in the heart of Cologne (dogs welcome), team events, modern hardware, subsidized Deutschland-Ticket, Urban Sports Club contribution, corporate benefits and a company pension plan (bAV) with a 30% employer contribution.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel.

We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Trust, evidence, and explainability are at the core of everything we build.

We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community.

Our Values

Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding, and we strive to understand different viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Before we take action, we ensure we truly grasp the challenges, perspectives, and goals. 

Know the Why: We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. We take meaningful action with urgency, but never at the expense of thoughtful consideration. 

Innovate & Iterate: We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail. With deep understanding and a clear purpose, we can develop creative and bold solutions to tackle challenges.

Own the Outcome: We are empowered to take initiative and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes. When we execute, we take responsibility for our decisions, measure the success of our innovations, and learn from the results.

Who You Are

We are looking for an experienced Senior Engineering Manager with a demonstrated ability to lead and grow distributed teams of strong engineers working remotely around the world. You enjoy the pace of a growing company, stay close to what your teams are building, and help the people around you take on more ownership.

Our ideal candidates are passionate about building products that help engineering teams ship better software, faster. They follow closely how AI is changing the way software gets built, and they want to help Develocity lead that change.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and empower several teams, working closely with their team leads, to deliver outcomes that matter to our users and the business, from long-term planning through to execution
  • Spot early risks to releases, team performance, or the business, and plan how to address them
  • Stay close to the technical work through design discussions, investigations, reviews, and guidance
  • Communicate clearly and early with other teams, departments, and stakeholders to meet release deadlines and business objectives
  • Cultivate a supportive team environment that encourages transparency and collaboration; support the personal and professional growth of everyone on your teams
  • Make the most of AI tools in your own work, and support your teams as they find new ways to build with AI

Minimum qualifications

  • 5+ years in a technical leadership role (3+ years in an Engineering Manager role)
  • Have managed more than one engineering team, working alongside team leads
  • The technical depth to serve as a partner to your engineers; you can challenge technical direction and identify risks early
  • Experience with a JVM-based product
  • Proven track record of leading complex initiatives that ship customer-facing products
  • Strong product and business mindset, coupled with a get-things-done attitude
  • Self-motivated and self-managing, with excellent organizational skills
  • Experience in leading and growing software teams and engineers
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills
  • A genuine interest in how AI is changing software development, and hands-on experience using AI tools in your own work

Preferred qualifications

  • Expertise in developer tooling, developer experience, or developer productivity
  • Experience managing remote, distributed teams
  • Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up
  • Experience with AI-powered developer products, such as agents or MCP servers

What We Offer

  • Work on a widely used product with a clear vision for the future
  • Contribute to how software teams build and ship in the age of AI agents

About Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the most rapidly expanding industries in the world: a complex, always-on, three-sided marketplace that impacts millions of people every day.

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

The Team

BizOps is the team that keeps its finger on the pulse of business performance: continuously, rigorously, and across multiple dimensions at once. We turn raw operational and financial data into actionable intelligence, surfacing what is happening, why it is happening, and what to expect next, for the operators, executives, and functional teams who run the business day to day.

We are not a reporting function that produces outputs on request. We work continuously, proactively watching, delivering, and questioning whether the signal is real, acting as "first responders" to surprising deviations from expectation and using what we learn to drive faster, better decision-making for the business at large.

Our work spans the full stack of analytics: from the warehouse models that make metrics trustworthy, to the monitoring systems that catch problems early, to the reports and dashboards that make performance visible, to the deep-dive investigations that explain what the numbers mean and what we should do about it.

We anchor our analysis to the right reference points: how performance compares to plan, to prior periods, and to what we'd expect, and we bring causal rigour when the business needs to know whether an action actually worked.

The culture within the team is informal, fast-paced and entrepreneurial. Given the growth of the business and the level of senior stakeholder exposure, progression in the team can be fast.

The Role

Deliveroo is hiring a Senior Data Scientist to join BizOps, based in our London HQ (hybrid, minimum three days per week in the office).

This role is largely project-based: starting from a strategic or performance question, you'll combine data, business context, and structured problem-solving to provide the insights that drive decision-making at a global level with senior stakeholders. You will own delivery end-to-end, from the messy, ambiguous question to a rigorous, trustworthy, and actionable answer.

You'll be equally comfortable building the systems that make performance visible and going deep on the investigations that explain it. One week you might diagnose why a key market has moved away from plan; the next, identify the drivers behind a change in customer or operational performance; the next, build monitoring that helps teams spot and understand emerging issues earlier.

Success in this role requires building effective working relationships across Deliveroo, particularly with international markets, as well as the Data Science, Operations, Commercial, and Finance teams.

 

What You'll Be Doing

  • Answer the questions that matter, continuously. Maintain a rigorous view on business performance: Are we on track against our goals? What's changed? How does this compare with what we expected? What should we expect next? Then go further: Why is it happening, what matters most, and what should we do about it?"

  • Own delivery end-to-end. Independently identify, define, and deliver impactful work aligned with business goals, operating with minimal guidance to ship fast, high-quality solutions.

  • Navigate ambiguity. Deconstruct broad, ambiguous problem spaces into structured analytical roadmaps, and understand how your work intersects with adjacent systems and teams.

  • Build for scale, not one-offs. Build the pipelines, models, dashboards, monitoring, and investigative tooling that make performance visible and reliable. Automate wherever possible; redoing analyses by hand is slow and error-prone.

  • Measure impact with discipline. Design measurement strategies from simple A/B tests to quasi-experimental designs (synthetic control, difference-in-differences, event studies) when trials aren't feasible, always with conservative, assumption-explicit language.

  • Be a first responder. Surface deviations before they become escalations, and be just as willing to give the confident "this is noise, no action needed" as the alarm.

  • Communicate to influence. Translate complex findings into clear, simple, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences that shape roadmaps and decisions.

  • Raise the bar. Contribute to the broader Analytics community, improve shared approaches and best practices, and help build data literacy across the business.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate brings strong expertise in some of these areas and the curiosity to grow in others:

  • Experience in an analytical or data science role, such as data analytics, data science, forecasting, planning, strategy analytics, or a similar discipline. Experience in logistics, e-commerce, marketplaces, or another fast-moving, customer-focused business is useful but not essential.

  • Proficiency with SQL and a scripting language such as Python or R, alongside experience with BI or visualisation tooling such as Looker, Tableau, or similar.

  • Comfortable using modern AI-assisted tools to work efficiently while maintaining high standards of accuracy and reproducibility.

  • A pragmatic approach to problem-solving: you can balance analytical rigour with speed, adapt your approach to the importance of the decision, and focus effort where it will have the greatest impact.

  • Effective problem-solving: you can take an ambiguous question, identify the underlying problem or decision, develop hypotheses, and use data and business context to reach a clear point of view.

  • Experience with experimentation and/or causal inference is a strong plus: the ability to unpick insights and steer strategic decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills, in person, in writing, and in code, with the ability to translate business needs into analytical problems and complex findings into simple recommendations.

  • Driven, hard-working, and agile. BizOps sits at the centre of a fast-growing business; we move quickly to scale at pace.

  • London-based, with a minimum of three days per week in the office.

jobs.title: Machine Learning & AI Internship
jobs.description:
WHY this position is important

Pennylane builds the financial management and accounting platform used by SMEs and accounting firms in France, Germany and Spain. As a product-led company, we invest first in the product, and AI is now at the core of it.

The ML & AI team (about thirty people in Paris, part of the Data organisation) builds the AI inside the product. Its first priority is Autopilot: automated accounting production with the accountant in control. Autopilot reads documents, books entries, matches bank transactions, reviews client files and prepares VAT returns with as little human intervention as possible.

These tasks raise real ML problems. Answers must be exact, every client is different, accounting constraints can be checked automatically, and we have millions of real examples corrected by accountants. This internship is a chance to work on one of these problems with real data, real users and a direct path to production.

HOW you will contribute

You will join the ML & AI team, within a Tech organisation of more than 400 people. You will work on one main topic for the whole internship, protected from day-to-day work, with a dedicated tutor.

Every topic follows the same path:

  • Evaluation first: in the first weeks, you agree with your tutor on a frozen evaluation set and the metrics that matter.

  • A baseline in production: you ship a simpler first version that the team can put into production, around months 1 to 3.

  • Then go further: you improve it and explore more advanced approaches. Research topics are designed to lead to a publishable result.

You will own the topic end to end: understanding the problem with accountants and product teams, defining success metrics, building, measuring and presenting your results.

Topics for 2027

Here is an overview of the topics we want to staff in 2027. We agree on the final topic and your tutor with you.

  • Reading invoices and new types of documents with compact vision-language models (VLMs): fine-tuning, supervision from e-invoices, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.

  • Knowing when the AI is right: calibrated confidence, selective automation and model routing for automated accounting decisions.

  • Evaluating accounting agents: an open benchmark of long-horizon accounting tasks on simulated client files, with verifiable scoring.

  • Learning from accountants' corrections: turning feedback into editable rules, with non-regression guarantees.

  • Bank reconciliation: matching one transaction to several documents, as learned graph optimisation.

  • An AI agent for Autopilot support tickets: from investigation to a pull request. This is an applied topic for profiles who prefer building systems close to production.

  • Data foundations for AI: evaluation datasets, data quality and monitoring, and agents that let teams query and use data on their own.

AI will be part of how you work

You will use coding assistants and AI agents every day: to explore the codebase and data models, write Python and SQL, run experiments, write tests and debug.

We expect you to give agents the right context and to check their output. You own the result, not the agent.

OUR CULTURE

You will join a hands-on engineering culture, where two technical co-founders are still among the most active contributors to the codebase.

You will work with ML and AI engineers, data specialists, software engineers, product managers and accountants. You will have strong mentorship and a lot of ownership: freedom to test ideas, challenge existing approaches and build things from scratch, with an R&D mindset.

The goal is not a demo. It is something the team can trust, reuse and ship.

YOU'RE THE RIGHT CANDIDATE IF YOU

  • Are in the final year of a Master's degree or engineering school in machine learning, computer science, statistics or applied mathematics. Research internships of at least 4 months are also considered.

  • Have strong ML foundations and solid Python, and have already trained, fine-tuned or evaluated models in academic, personal or professional projects.

  • Care about evaluation: clean baselines, reproducible experiments and metrics that reflect the real problem.

  • Are comfortable with real-world data: SQL, analysis, messy and imbalanced datasets.

  • Already use AI ambitiously in your projects and can explain how you verify its output.

  • Communicate clearly and enjoy working in a multidisciplinary team. No accounting knowledge is required, only curiosity.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION

  • Duration: 5 to 6 months (final-year internship).

  • Start date: March or April 2027.

  • Location: Paris office, at least 3 days per week on site, together with your tutor.

  • Supervision: a dedicated tutor from the ML & AI team.

  • Resources: GPUs, API access to frontier models, real data under GDPR-compliant conditions, and our existing evaluation infrastructure.

  • After the internship: an opportunity to join Pennylane full-time on a permanent contract.

HOW TO APPLY

Please send us:

  • Your CV.

  • Links to relevant projects: GitHub repositories, technical reports, notebooks or papers.

  • A few lines on your motivation and the topics that interest you most.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 6 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1200 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1,250,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

 

Our electronic invoicing track represents a core strategic priority for Pennylane. This dedicated team is responsible for developing our comprehensive electronic invoicing offering for our accounting firm partners and their SME clients (Small and Medium-sized Enterprises), accelerating client acquisition, enhancing customer satisfaction, and establishing operational excellence within this segment.

 

As our cross-functional initiatives expand, we now require robust frameworks for end-to-end process management, data-driven performance analytics, and a relentless focus on operational efficiency and scalability. We are seeking an exceptional, impact-oriented Strategy & Operations professional who will be instrumental in building these critical capabilities and propelling our electronic invoicing track toward market leadership.

 

Why this role matters at Pennylane

 

The Strategy & Operations role will serve as the critical link between our strategic vision and day-to-day execution, working directly with the General Manager for the track. You will help translate ambitious goals into actionable, measurable roadmaps, establish best-in-class metrics, and develop the operational infrastructure needed to scale the business rapidly and sustainably.

 

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with significant opportunity for leadership and professional growth. 

 

Your responsibilities

 

Strategic planning and execution

- Partner with the product leadership to define, prioritize, and implement operational roadmaps aligned with business objectives

- Design and establish scalable operational frameworks that support our growth

 

Data-driven decision making

- Lead comprehensive analyses to identify market opportunities, operational inefficiencies, and growth levers

- Develop actionable insights and recommendations based on quantitative and qualitative research

 

Project leadership

- Spearhead strategic initiatives and pilot programs from ideation through implementation and measurement

- Identify and manage complex, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities

 

Cross-functional orchestration

- Serve as the operational nexus between the track and horizontal teams including care, sales, and the other product teams impacted by the electronic invoicing reform

- Facilitate effective collaboration and alignment across organizational boundaries

 

Performance management

- Own the OKR process for the track, ensuring clarity of objectives and accountability for results

- Design and implement robust tracking mechanisms to monitor performance against key metrics

- Proactively identify performance gaps and develop action plans to address them

 

Who we’re looking for

 

Experience

- 5+ years of experience in Strategy & Operations or a related field, with a strong record of scaling business operations in dynamic environments

- Proven track record of translating strategic initiatives into executable operational plans and projects, delivering measurable business impact

- Proficiency in SQL (or willingness to learn) and modern data analysis tools to drive decision-making independently

 

Core competencies

- Strategic vision: ability to connect business objectives with operational requirements while maintaining focus on long-term goals

- Analytical excellence: skilled at distilling complex data into actionable insights that drive business outcomes

- Project management rigor: experience leading cross-functional initiatives from conception to implementation

- Communication and influence: exceptional ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and persuade diverse stakeholders

- Problem-solving orientation: demonstrated ability to identify root causes and develop innovative, practical solutions

⚠️ This role is Paris-based only, and unfortunately we're not able to offer a fully remote setup.

You'll need to be fluent in both French and English for this role.

Recruitment Process

- Screening interview with Barbara - Senior Recruiter (30 mins)

- An interview with Antoine - General Manager RFE (1h)

- A Business Case to prepare at home and to present (1h)

- A final interview with Eric - VP Strategic Initiatives (45 mins)

 

What do we do to make your work life easier

 

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

jobs.description:
About Plasma

Plasma is building the primary account for global money.

Money used to belong to a country. Increasingly, it belongs to a person or business moving through many countries. People and businesses now earn, spend, save, hire and invest across borders. Traditional banks cannot serve this new world.

Our first product, Plasma One, is a global money account: a place to receive, hold, send funds in seconds, earn yield and spend with a card in the local economy.

Underneath is the Plasma network, built from first principles for stablecoin payments. Stablecoins make dollars faster, cheaper and more reliable to move.

The opportunity is to become where all global money lands first: where income arrives, balances grow, payments move, businesses operate, and new financial products are built.


The Team & Our Story

We are a global team of founders, operators and engineers, obsessed with building the best products. We work at the cutting edge of financial innovation, using stablecoins to create tools for consumers and businesses.

We operate with trust, clarity, and ambition: own your craft, move with urgency, contribute beyond your lane, back your teammates, debate rigorously, and keep raising the bar for what great means.

The role

  • You inherit a live product with real spend, and you own the paid engine that scales it across Plasma One and Plasma Business. Channels, budget, creative and measurement all sit with you.

  • Own the cost of acquisition of valuable users and managing our paid advertising motion end to end.

  • Deploy many variations of ads, platforms and angles to test high performing creative and formats driving users into both custom funnels and direct to app while measuring downstream events.

  • Take us beyond our crypto-native audience. Find the audiences, messages and formats on Meta, Google, TikTok and YouTube that bring in people who fund and keep spending, then scale the ones that work.

  • Run the campaigns yourself. You build them, launch them, read the results and decide where tomorrow's budget goes. New creative, new audiences and new angles every week, with a clear read on what worked and why.

  • Look past the click. Work with product and design on landing pages, onboarding, lifecycle and referrals so a new sign-up becomes a funded account and a regular user.

  • Build the paid function. The tracking, reporting and playbooks you set up become what the team runs on, and as channels prove out you help hire the specialists who scale them.

The Bar

  • Regional market expertise. You know how to work on an acquisition strategy that differs between countries and markets

  • Deep, hands-on experience running paid acquisition at a consumer app or fintech, especially paid social and search, with real budgets and real accountability for the outcome.

jobs.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer GAIA
jobs.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

 

🛠️ About our Simulation Teams

You'll be joining the Simulation team (Simulation Evaluation & Validation), working on Gaia — Wayve's world model. Gaia is trained on large-scale driving video to predict future frames from past context, functioning as a simulator that generates synthetic scenarios and operates in closed loop with the driving model itself. The team partners closely with Research, Applications, Core Simulation Engineering, and Cloud/Infrastructure to turn model improvements into measurable downstream impact on the driving stack.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Own and lead parts of large-scale training for Gaia (language- or video-style training at scale), from experimentation through productionised training runs.

  • Contribute to and influence model architecture decisions — not just applying existing models.

  • Partner across sub-teams: Research (model development), Applications (adapting models to use cases), Core Simulation Engineering, and Cloud/Infrastructure.

  • Translate product and evaluation needs into model improvements (e.g. better long-horizon prediction, scenario generation quality, failure-case coverage).

  • Mentor and set technical direction, raising the engineering and research quality bar across the team.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • Leading and executing Gaia's post-training and closed-loop pipeline — fine-tuning and aligning the world model through post-training experimentation and targeted data curation.

  • Pushing Gaia's autoregressive generation towards longer, more stable rollouts, and making the model deployment-ready (inference time and reliability included).

  • Contributing to broader model architecture and training-strategy decisions where they intersect with pre- and post-training and the application layer.

  • Partnering closely with research, applications, simulation engineering, and cloud/infrastructure teams to translate post-training improvements into measurable downstream impact.

  • Providing technical leadership through mentorship, review, and setting high engineering/research standards.

 

🙌 You should apply if

Essential:

  • You have hands-on experience post-training/fine-tuning large-scale models (language, video, or other foundation models).

  • You have experience with world models, autoregressive generation, and long-horizon generation.

  • You have experience with diffusion/flow models and a solid understanding of 3D vision.

  • You have a strong understanding of model architecture and can contribute meaningfully to architectural/training decisions.

  • You have strong hands-on engineering skills with modern ML stacks (e.g. PyTorch), including debugging and performance/reliability-minded development.

  • You have 5+ years of relevant industry experience (advanced degrees are valued, but depth of applied experience matters more).

Desirable:

  • Experience with inference optimisation or deploying large models under latency/compute constraints.

  • Experience improving data/training pipelines and working across infrastructure constraints (distributed training, efficiency, reliability).

  • Proven technical leadership — tech lead ownership, mentoring, or setting direction across an area.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews (Programming/Pytorch debugging and hiring manager interview; 2 hours total)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Systems & domain-specific interviews; 3 hours total)

  • Final interview: Mission & values alignment (45 mins).

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

 

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Yubo is the instantly social, social app: the leading real-time social discovery platform where you can meet new people for friendship, crushes and community. Our mission is to help young adults find community - whoever they are, wherever they are and whenever they feel social. That's why we’re building a more spontaneous and human social world, one based on interaction, exploration and possibility.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow. Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission.

As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

We also work closely with the broader technology industry to share our knowledge and NGOs create industry-leading child protection standards.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role

Growth at Yubo moves fast, and we don’t plan on stopping anytime soon ! More channels, more markets, more experiments to run, and we need brains (and hands…) to make it happen. We're bringing in a third Growth Manager to grow the team's capacity and add a perspective on Gen Z that comes from living it, being molded by it.

Sounds like you? You’ll like what comes next.

We’ll get you started by getting hands-on with every channel we operate, learning how each and every single one of them works before claiming your own piece of the portfolio. From there, a whole new world of possibilities opens up: push creative testing further, chase down new partners, help us uncover growth where we haven't looked yet, and more.

You'll work shoulder to shoulder with the rest of the Growth team (that includes Creative), Product, and Data, all pulling in the same direction. If you want a role where your instincts, ideas, and results speak for themselves, this is it.

Your responsibilites

  • User Acquisition & Paid Media Optimization: Manage and optimize a significant performance marketing budget across key acquisitoin channels, programmatic networks & emerging platforms. Scale acquisition and reactivation across multiple countries. Improve media buying, targeting, and creative to boost ROAS, using incrementality tests and attribution models. Help deploy automation and AI tools.

  • Creative Optimization: Collaborate with the creative team to ideate, produce and scale creative concepts that resonate with our Gen Z audience. Own creative testing and iteration to improve the scale, efficiency and longevity of winning ideas.

  • Growth Marketing: Support a multi-channel strategy that combines paid and brand marketing to drive organic, viral and referral loops. Contribute to ASO and lifecycle marketing to boost retention and monetization.

  • Data-Driven Growth: Partner with Product, Data, and Engineering to optimize funnels. Build dashboards and A/B testing processes. Stay ahead of privacy and adtech trends (e.g SKAN, AdAttributionKit).

  • Collaboration: Work with senior growth team members, share best practices, and foster a culture of experimentation and data-driven decisions.

Tools we use

  • MMP: Adjust

  • Market intelligence: Sensor Tower and Creative Ad Libraries

  • Acquisition channels: TikTok, Meta, Snapchat, Google Ads, Apple Ads

  • Programmatic networks: AppLovin, Moloco

Who you are

  • You have around 3 years of solid, consolidated experience in growth marketing or user acquisition for a B2C consumer app.

  • You have a genuine, native affinity with Gen Z culture and what makes it tick.

  • You have experience or a strong connection with the US market, whether through studies or product marketing experience.

  • You've scaled growth investment on at least one major social media platform and know how to read the results.

  • You know how to collaborate with creative teams: identifying what works, and clearly explaining why.

  • You have experience working with a martech stack, including custom audiences, conversion APIs, and MMP & SDK implementations and updates.

  • You're autonomous, result-oriented, and bring strong business acumen to your decisions.

Within a month, you will

  • Get to know Yubo's product, mission, and the Growth team's ways of working.

  • Meet your key stakeholders across Growth, Creative, Product, and Data.

  • Get onboarded on our tools and marketing stack, including Adjust, Amplitude and more

  • Start learning how each of our acquisition channels currently operates.

Within 3 months, you will

  • Fully own a portfolio of channels and campaigns to optimise in line with our performance guidelines

  • Work to automate campaign and creative optimisation process

  • Improve our usage of custom audience strategies across all channels

Within 6 months, you will

  • Scale your portfolio to reach our strategic growth objectives

  • Seek opportunities to further improve our growth operations by deploying AI tools

  • Assist in developing our retargeting workflows for a more diversified approach

What we offer

  • We also cover fees for external professional events and meetups (Android Makers, etc…)

  • Great health insurance coverage for both you and your family by Alan, fully paid for by Yubo !

  • Numerous benefits for parents: additional parental leave, easy access to nurseries and daycare facilities in France.

Our approach to privacy & safety

As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts.

Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact.

You own the impact: Step up, adapt, and make it matter

Unconventionally Smart: Hack with intent, borrow smart, build better

Be Bold & Resilient: Raise your head, break barriers, keep moving forward

One team, one mission: No egos, no passengers, just shared wins

 

Trust & Flexibility: Our hybrid model calls for only two office days a month; the rest is up to the rhythm that works best for you.

 

Enjoy Top-notch Benefits

Culture is central at Yubo, hence the numerous benefits:

Cool Workplace: enjoy our amazing Parisian office and our many hybrid work options

Team Activities: participate in get-togethers, events, and team-building activities

jobs.description:
Account Executive, Payments (Existing Merchants)

Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might be in the right place!

We are looking for an Account Executive, Payments, who is responsible for driving the adoption of Lightspeed Payments within Lightspeed's existing merchant base in France. This is a dedicated cross-sell/upsell position focused on transitioning current Point of Sale (POS) customers to our proprietary, integrated payment processing solution.

Lightspeed Payments has been continually invested into since launch in 2019, integrating a number of unique value drivers into the combined POS-payments solution. Building off of success our new business teams have experienced in selling the combined POS-payments solution, we are scaling our ability to sell payments into our existing merchant base, many of which became clients before we scaled Lightspeed Payments.

This position reports to the Global Payments Sales Manager and is part of the Global Payments GTM team.

Your Mission

The primary responsibility is to meet and exceed sales targets for Lightspeed Payments adoption among existing merchants.

  • Pipeline Management: Generate and manage sales opportunities using leads sourced from Account Managers, direct phone/email outreach, and follow-up on company-led marketing campaigns.

  • Sales Execution: Manage the complete sales cycle from initial qualification and value presentation through pricing negotiation and contract closure.

  • Customer Launch: Partner with Onboarding teams to ensure a smooth transition and launch for merchants adopting Lightspeed Payments.

  • Internal Expertise: Serve as the internal Subject Matter Expert (SME) on payment processing for other units, providing guidance and training as required.

  • Product Feedback: Collect and relay merchant feedback regarding the payments product to the Product Management teams.

  • Reporting: Maintain accurate records of all sales activities, pipeline status, and opportunity notes in Salesforce.com.

  • Other Duties: Handle additional duties and responsibilities as defined by management.

What you’ll be bringing to the team

  • Payments Experience: Direct experience (3+ years) in the payment processing industry.

  • Sales Closing Role: Demonstrated experience (3+ years) in a closing role focused on technology or solution sales.

  • Opportunity Development: Proven ability to proactively generate and qualify new opportunities.

  • Target Achievement: Documented history of success in a revenue target or quota-based environment.

  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. French language skills are considered an asset.

What’s in it for you?

  • Genuine career growth opportunities based on performance within a company that's continuously expanding

  • Work with highly skilled people who are as passionate about sales & marketing as you are

  • An environment that encourages initiatives and leadership

  • Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact

  • Fun activities with your teammates & social events throughout the year

  • Opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed culture, a true Canadian tech success story

... and further

  • Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)

  • Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health

  • Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counseling you need - each employee gets access to this platform

  • People Experience - Our PX benefit allows you to work from pretty much anywhere in the world for 60 days a year

  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

  • Transit benefit if you travel by public transport to the office

  • Lunch reimbursement on the days you work from our Paris office

  • Healthy snacks and after work organized by the company

  • Health insurance with attractive guarantee plans

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Head of Hardware, you own that hardware end to end: electrical, firmware, and the mechanical integration that holds it together, from the first schematic to devices running on factory floors.

You lead the team that builds it. Today that is about six engineers on robotics, three on EMG sensing, and three on camera systems, plus contractors, and it will grow quickly. Our Electrical Engineer and Embedded Engineer roles report to you. You set the architecture they build against, and you still build alongside them.

This is a founder-shaped role, not a management seat. We are looking for someone who has carried a product from a blank page to customers with real skin in the game, wants to build both the thing and the team that builds it, and would rather design than review. If that sounds like you, you will want to do it again at the earliest stage.

What You Will Do

  • Own the hardware roadmap for Shift and Atlas data capture: wearables, sensor rigs, camera systems, and prototype robots. What we build, in what order, and why.

  • Set the system architecture across electrical, firmware, and mechanical: sensors, compute, power, wireless, and enclosures. Make the trade-offs, and make them stick when disciplines disagree.

  • Stay on the bench: schematics, layout reviews, board bring-up, and a scope in your hands when the team is stuck. On the days it matters, you are the best electrical engineer in the room.

  • Lead and grow the team: hire, set the bar, run design reviews, and give engineers ownership of whole subsystems rather than tickets.

  • Guarantee data quality end to end: EMG and EEG front ends, camera pipelines, IMUs, and synchronization across many devices, so that what reaches the ML team is clean, time-aligned, and trustworthy.

  • Take designs from prototype to small-batch production: DFM, component and EMS vendors, test fixtures, certification, and field reliability.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with ML and deployment. Your hardware decides what the training data looks like, and you will be on the floor where it is captured.

  • Run contractors and partners without losing ownership of the result.

Requirements

  • You have taken at least one product from zero to shipped, with significant ownership of the outcome: as a co-founder, CTO, first hardware hire, or the lead who owned the whole device. Not one subsystem, not one phase. Ideally a wearable, at a tier-one hardware company known for shipping at scale.

  • Electrical engineering is your home discipline. You have designed boards that shipped, across mixed-signal, power, wireless, and high-speed digital, and you can still do it today.

  • You think in systems. You understand how an electrode choice, an enclosure tolerance, and an ADC sample rate interact, and you can hold the mechanical and firmware conversations as a peer, not a customer.

  • You have led engineers: hired them, grown them, and kept a team shipping through 0-to-1 ambiguity. Typically 6+ years in hardware, but we care more about what you shipped than how long it took.

  • A strong understanding of how hardware decisions affect data quality. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you design accordingly.

  • Experience taking hardware to small-batch production: DFM, vendor and EMS management, test, and certification.

  • Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice.

  • High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. A 0-to-1 hardware program takes the hours it takes, in person and at pace, and you have chosen that before.

  • Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care.

Nice to Have

  • Wearables, smartwatches, drones, robotics, AR/VR, or defense wearables on your résumé.

  • Camera systems: sensor selection, MIPI and ISP pipelines, and multi-camera synchronization.

  • Low-power and battery design, BLE or Wi-Fi, and antenna integration in small enclosures.

  • Enough mechanical fluency (CAD, tolerances, and materials) to challenge the mechanical team’s choices and be right some of the time.
